body: A SURVEY RELEASED THURSDAY BY DELL COMPUTER CORP. SAID MORE AND MORE AMERICANS ARE GOING ONLINE THIS YEAR TO SEND HOLIDAY GREETINGS TO THEIR FRIENDS AND RELATIVES. ACCORDING TO DELL'S TECHKNOW GENERATION 2000 SURVEY BASED ON INTERVIEWS OF 1,001 RANDOM COMPUTER USERS, 61 PERCENT SAID THEY HAVE A FAMILY WEB SITE OR ARE INTERESTED IN CREATING ONE. "IT'S VERY POPULAR," SAID MARK FELDMAN, A SENIOR PRODUCER AT YAHOO GEOCITIES, ONE OF THE BIGGEST SITES OFFERING FREE SPACE FOR PERSONAL WEB PAGES. "KIDS ARE ALL ONLINE. THEY'RE ONLINE AT SCHOOL, THEY'RE ONLINE EVERYWHERE. SOMETHING LIKE HOMEPAGES FOR THE HOLIDAYS ARE GIVING PARENTS AN OPPORTUNITY TO BE ONLINE WITH THE KIDS," FELDMAN ADDED. INTERNET EXPERTS SAY DESIGNING FAMILY HOMEPAGES FOR SPECIFIC OCCASIONS IS A GROWING TREND IN THE unitedstates AS MORE HOUSEHOLDS GET CONNECTED AND WEB DESIGN GETS SIMPLER. IT'S NO LONGER NECESSARY TO TYPE IN COMPLICATED CODES OR LEARN COMPUTER LANGUAGES. USERS CAN BUY WEB DESIGN SOFTWARE OR USE ONE OF SEVERAL ONLINE SERVICES THAT OFFER FREE SPACE AND PROGRAMS. INTERNET COMPANIES ARE TAKING ADVANTAGE OF THE TREND. "WE'RE TRYING TO MAKE IT EASIER FOR THEM TO DO ONLINE," SAID FELDMAN. DELL AND HOMESTEAD. CO., ANOTHER PERSONAL WEB PAGE SITE, OFFERED 2,000 DOLLARS  TOWARD A NEW COMPUTER TO THE OWNER OF THE MOST CREATIVE FAMILY HOLIDAY PAGE. HUNDREDS HAVE ENTERED THE CONTEST. "WE'RE MAKING SURE THAT CUSTOMERS CAN EASILY TAKE ADVANTAGE OF TECHNOLOGY," SAID JANET MOUNTAIN OF DELL'S CONSUMER PRODUCT DIVISION.

title: MEE122302HKE -- JORDAN LIBERALIZES OPENING OF INTERNET CAFES
body: THE JORDANIAN GOVERNMENT HAS LIBERALIZED THE PROCEDURE FOR OPENING INTERNET CAFES TO ENABLE A LARGER SEGMENT OF THE SOCIETY TO GET ACCESS TO THE INTERNET. JORDANIAN BUSINESSMEN WHO WANT TO OPEN INTERNET CAFES ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED TO GET SPECIAL LICENSES FROM THE PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS DEPARTMENT (PPD), THE SEMIOFFICIAL JORDAN TIMES REPORTED THURSDAY. PPD HEAD ABDULLAH ETMOUM SAID ANYONE WITH AN INTEREST IN OPENING AN INTERNET CAFE WILL NOW ONLY FOLLOW THE USUAL PROCEDURES FOR STARTING ANY OTHER BUSINESSES, SUCH AS A GROCERY OR BOOK STORE. IT USED TO TAKE A MONTH OR SO TO GET A LICENSE FROM THE PPD DUE TO THE LOW EFFICIENCY OF THE BUREAUCRATIC PROCEDURES. INTERNET CAFES HAVE MUSHROOMED FOR THE PAST FEW YEARS IN THE KINGDOM, THOUGH OFFICIALS CAN NOT PROVIDE AN EXACT NUMBER OF INTERNET CAFES AS NEW ONES ARE OPENED EVERY DAY. INDEPENDENT ESTIMATES PUT THE NUMBER OF COMPUTERS LINKED TO THE INTERNET IN THE COUNTRY AT MORE THAN 20,000, AND AUTHORITIES RECEIVED SOME 50 APPLICATIONS TO OPEN INTERNET CAFES EVERY MONTH. JORDAN, WITH A 4.7 MILLION POPULATION, IS ONE OF THE FEW ARAB COUNTRIES WHICH HAVE SHOWN ALMOST COMPLETE TOLERANCE TO THE INTERNET, AND VIRTUALLY ALL WEBSITES EMERGE UNCENSORED TO INTERNET CUSTOMERS OF THE KINGDOM. THE GOVERNMENT TOOK THE ACCESS TO THE INTERNET AS A MEANS OF GETTING THE NEW GENERATION ACQUAINTED WITH THE INFORMATION AGE AND AS PART OF ITS PREPARATIONS FOR EDUCATION IN THE 21 CENTURY. THE EDUCATION MINISTRY IS PLANNING TO PROVIDE 3,000 COMPUTERS TO 200 PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN AMMAN, AND ALL THESE COMPUTERS WILL BE CONNECTED TO THE INTERNET, OFFICIALS SAID. AN ADDITIONAL 75 SCHOOLS OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL ARE ALSO EXPECTED TO GET THE INTERNET SERVICE FROM NEXT YEAR.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: AS THE NEW MILLENNIUM'S DAY APPROACHES, MANY CHINESE PEOPLE INTEND TO SEND ELECTRONIC CARDS TO FRIENDS THROUGH THE INTERNET RATHER THAN TRADITIONAL PAPER CARDS. LI YI, A STAFF MEMBER AT A BEIJING-BASED COMPANY, HAS THE HABIT OF SURFING THE INTERNET, AND HE NOW HAS ONE MORE THING TO DO -- SEND ELECTRONIC CARDS TO HIS FRIENDS. HE SAID IT ONLY TAKES HIM ABOUT TWO MINUTES TO LOG-ON, CHOOSE A CARD, FILL OUT THE FORMS, SELECT PICTURES, AND SEND IT. IT WAS MUCH MORE TIME-CONSUMING TO MAIL PAPER CARDS YEARS AGO.  "I SOMETIMES GOT FRUSTRATED BECAUSE THE CARDS AND ENVELOPS WOULD COST ME HALF A DAY," HE SAID. MA BINBIN, A DESIGNER AT THE ART STUDIO OF SOHU, ONE OF CHINA'S LARGEST SEARCH ENGINES (HTTP:// WWW.SOHU.COM), TOLD XINHUA THAT HIS COMPANY'S WEBSITE IS VISITED ABOUT SIX MILLION TIMES A DAY AND MORE THAN HALF OF THE VISITORS CLICK THE BUTTON FOR FREE ELECTRONIC CARDS ON THE WEB PAGE. MA SAID THAT BY THE END OF LATE JULY, ABOUT FOUR MILLION CHINESE PEOPLE HAD ACCESS TO THE INTERNET AND THAT HE BELIEVES THIS FIGURE HAS DOUBLED IN DECEMBER.  "THE NUMBER WILL CONTINUE TO RISE AS THE GOVERNMENT HAS RECENTLY CUT THE FEES FOR INTERNET TIME, AND THE NEW MILLENNIUM IS COMING," HE ADDED. OFFICIAL STATISTICS SHOW THAT 4,000 PAPER CARDS USE THE WOOD OF A FULL-GROWN TREE, AND A TON OF PAPER PULP WILL USE 15 TO 16 TREES 10 METERS HIGH AND 20 CENTIMETERS IN DIAMETER. EXPERTS SAY, IT IS TOO MUCH FOR CHINA, A COUNTRY WITH A HUGE POPULATION OF MORE THAN 1.2 BILLION AND A TINY FORESTED AREA OF LESS THAN 14 PERCENT OF ITS TERRITORY.  THEY ADDED THAT THERE IS ALSO POLLUTION BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE CHEMICALS USED IN PAPER PRODUCTION. MA SAID, "ELECTRONIC CARDS CAN NOT ONLY HELP PEOPLE SAY HELLO TO EACH OTHER VIA THE INTERNET, BUT ALSO SAVE TREES AND EVEN THE PLANET, SO MANY PEOPLE CALL THE ELECTRONIC CARD A 'GREEN CARD'."

title: SMALLER U.S. COMPANIES LAG BEHIND BIG COUNTERPARTS IN E-COMMERCE EFFORTS
body: A NEW SURVEY RELEASED WEDNESDAY FOUND THAT 23 PERCENT OF "MIDDLE MARKET" COMPANIES IN THE unitedstates HAVE AN E-COMMERCE WEB SITE. THIS IS IN CONTRAST TO LARGE COMPANIES, 38 PERCENT OF WHICH HAVE AN E-COMMERCE WEB SITE, ACCORDING TO THE SURVEY CONDUCTED BY THE YANKEE GROUP, A GLOBAL INFORMATION SERVICES COMPANY THAT COLLECTS, INTEGRATES AND DELIVERS FINANCIAL, ECONOMIC AND MARKET RESEARCH INFORMATION. THE YANKEE GROUP DEFINES THE "MIDDLE MARKET" AS COMPANIES WITH MORE THAN 500 EMPLOYEES AND REVENUES BETWEEN 100 MILLION AND ONE BILLION unitedstates DOLLARS, AND IT ESTIMATES THERE ARE 12,000 TO 15,000 SUCH COMPANIES IN THE unitedstates. WHILE SOME OF THESE E-COMMERCE IMPLEMENTATIONS HAVE BEEN SUCCESSFUL, ACCORDING TO THE SURVEY, 45 PERCENT SMALLER COMPANIES SURVEYED REPORTED THAT THEIR E-COMMERCE EFFORTS HAVE BEEN UNSUCCESSFUL AND THEY NEED THIRD-PARTY HELP. THE PENETRATION OF BASIC TECHNOLOGIES SUCH AS LOCAL AND WIDE- AREA DATA NETWORK AMONG MIDDLE MARKET COMPANIES IS HIGH, WITH 80 PERCENT OF THEM REPORTING CLOSE TO FULL PENETRATION; BUT THEIR ADOPTION OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY IS NOT AS ENTHUSIASTIC. THE YANKEE GROUP SURVEYED 300 MIDDLE MARKET COMPANIES FOR ADOPTION, TRENDS PERCEPTIONS, BUDGETS AND BUYING BEHAVIOR IN E- BUSINESS, VOICE/DATA CONVERGENCE AND DATA NETWORK/E-COMMERCE OUTSOURCING. THESE TECHNOLOGY AREAS ARE REGARDED AS CORNERSTONES FOR FUTURE BUSINESS GROWTH AND COMPETITIVENESS. THESE COMPANIES HAVE BEEN SLOW TO ADOPT ADVANCED TECHNOLOGIES THAT LEVERAGE THE INTERNET AND VOICE/DATA CONVERGENCE, ACCORDING TO THE YANKEE GROUP. THEY ARE USING THE INTERNET AS A "GETTING CONNECTED"TOOL. THE VAST MAJORITY OF COMPANIES REPORTED THAT GIVING EMPLOYEES INTERNET ACCESS AND USING THE INTERNET TO CONNECT REMOTE WORKERS TO THE CORPORATE NETWORK AS THEIR TOP TECHNOLOGY PROJECTS FOR 2000.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: ONLINE SECURITIES TRADING BY PRIVATE INVESTORS IN ASIA-PACIFIC MARKETS WILL ACCOUNT FOR AT LEAST 20 PERCENT OF ALL RETAIL EQUITY MARKET TRANSACTIONS IN THE REGION BY 2003, A unitedstates MARKET RESEARCH FIRM PREDICTED MONDAY. IN FACT, ACCORDING TO THE STUDY OF DATAQUEST, A SUBORDINATE OF THE WORLD'S PREMIER TECHNOLOGY ADVISOR GARTNERGROUP, 70 PERCENT OF RETAIL BROKERAGES HEADQUARTERED IN ASIA-PACIFIC WILL OFFER REAL- TIME ASIAN STOCK MARKET TRADING FACILITIES VIA SECURE WEB SITES BY 2002. THROUGH 2002, HOWEVER, LESS THAN 50 PERCENT OF BANKS BASED IN THE REGION WILL BE ABLE TO LEVERAGE THEIR INTERNET BANKING SYSTEMS TO SUCCEED IN CONSUMER ELECTRONIC COMMERCE SERVICES. FINANCIAL SERVICES ORGANIZATIONS IN THE REGION'S LEADING MARKETS WILL BE REQUIRED TO HANDLE UNPRECEDENTED RETAIL TRANSACTION VOLUMES OVER THE INTERNET IN THE NEXT FIVE YEARS, THE RESEARCH FIRM SAID. ACCORDING TO DATAQUEST, THE MARKETS OF JAPAN, SOUTH KOREA AND TAIWAN WILL BE HOME TO THE BULK OF WEB-BASED SECURITIES TRADERS AND ONLINE RETAIL BANKING CUSTOMERS FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT THREE YEARS. HOWEVER, THE EMERGING MARKETS IN THE REGION, INCLUDING INDIA AND MALAYSIA WILL CONTINUE TO FACE ONLINE SECURITIES TRADING AND PERSONAL E-BANKING OBSTACLES CAUSED BY REGULATORY HURDLES AND THE LACK OF AN INTERNET-CONCERNED INFRASTRUCTURE. BECAUSE OF THE SHEER DEMAND FOR SECURITIES TRADING OVER THE WEB, DATAQUEST SAID, MOST ASIAN BROKERS WILL SHIFT THEIR RETAIL BUSINESS TO THE INTERNET OVER THE NEXT FIVE YEARS. AS IN NORTH AMERICA, MANY BROKERAGE CUSTOMERS IN THE REGION MAY ABANDON TRADITIONAL BROKER INTERMEDIARIES WHEN THEY REALIZE THE POWER AND COMPETITIVE PRICING OF DIRECT GLOBAL MARKET ACCESS THROUGH INTERNET TRADING.

title: ONLINE TRAVEL SITES ATTRACT MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
body: ONLINE TRAVEL SITES HAVE ATTRACTED MILLIONS OF AMERICANS SINCE THE BEGINNING OF THIS YEAR'S HOLIDAY SEASON. ACCORDING TO A STUDY RELEASED FRIDAY BY PC DATA, A SERVICE TRACKING WEB USAGE INFORMATION AND BUYING PATTERNS, PRICELINE. COM EMERGED AS THE TOP SITE FOR unitedstates INTERNET USERS SHOPPING FOR INFORMATION ON THANKSGIVING HOLIDAY AIR TRAVEL, WITH 3.2 MILLION UNIQUE HOME VISITORS IN NOVEMBER. THIS TRANSLATED INTO A 71 PERCENT INCREASE OVER THE PREVIOUS MONTH'S FIGURES OF THE ONLINE SERVICE WHICH ALLOWS TRAVELERS TO BID ON AIRLINE AND HOTEL FARES. FOLLOWING PRICELINE WERE ONLINE TRAVEL SITES OF TRAVELOCITY AND EXPEDIA, WITH 2.8 MILLION AND 2.1 MILLION VISITORS RESPECTIVELY. OF THE AIRLINE-SPONSORED SITES, SOUTHWEST AIRLINES CAME FIRST WITH 1.5 MILLION USERS, FOLLOWED BY AMERICAN AIRLINES AND DELTA AIRLINES. THE STUDY ALSO REVEALED THAT MOST unitedstates HOME INTERNET USERS RESERVED THEIR HOLIDAY FLIGHTS THROUGH DIRECT CHANNELS AS OPPOSED TO TRAVEL AGENTS. THIRTY-TWO PERCENT BOOKED FLIGHTS ONLINE, WHILE 31 PERCENT BOOKED FLIGHTS BY TELEPHONE DIRECTLY THROUGH AN AIRLINE.  TWENTY PERCENT BOOKED THROUGH A TRAVEL AGENT. AIR TRAVELERS GO ONLINE, PC DATA SAID, BECAUSE THEY WANT INFORMATION, ESPECIALLY WANT TO KNOW THE SHORTEST, EASIEST AND LEAST EXPENSIVE PATH TO BOOK THEIR FLIGHTS. THE SUCCESS OF THE SOUTHWEST SITE HAS TO DO WITH A DESIGN THAT TRANSFERS THE COMPANY'S REPUTATION TO THE INTERNET, ACCORDING TO PC DATA. THE TRADITIONALLY LOW-COST AIRLINE FARED WELL IN THE STUDY BECAUSE ITS DIRECT CHANNEL PHILOSOPHY TRANSFERS EASILY TO THE INTERNET, ENABLING IT TO EXPAND ITS CONSUMER BASE AND CONTINUE TO KEEP ITS COSTS DOWN. PC DATA SURVEYED 4,100 HOME-BASED INTERNET USERS IN NOVEMBER.  SIXTY-EIGHT PERCENT OF THE USERS BETWEEN THE AGES OF 18 AND 34 BOOKED THEIR FLIGHTS ONLINE OR BY TELEPHONE DIRECTLY TO AN AIRLINE COMPARED WITH 56 PERCENT BETWEEN THE AGES OF 35 AND 65.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: NINE IN 10 AMERICAN HOMES WILL BE ONLINE IN FIVE YEARS, WHILE PERSONAL COMPUTERS WILL REMAIN THE DOMINANT INTERNET ACCESS TERMINAL, ACCORDING TO A STUDY RELEASED WEDNESDAY. MOST HOMES WILL USE A NUMBER OF NON-PC ONLINE APPLIANCES, BUT PC WON'T BE REPLACED, SAID THE STUDY OF STRATEGY ANALYTICS, A unitedstates  MARKET CONSULTING BUSINESS IN HIGH- TECHNOLOGY. BY 2005, ACCORDING TO THE STUDY, 91 PERCENT OF AMERICAN HOMES WILL BE ONLINE, 90 PERCENT OF THEM WILL BE USING AN INTERNET PC, 73 PERCENT WILL ALSO HAVE INTERACTIVE TV OR OTHER INTERNET APPLIANCES. ONLINE TV-BASED SET-TOP BOXES WILL BECOME COMMONPLACE IN AMERICAN HOMES. LIMITED DEMAND ALSO EXISTS FOR A RANGE OF NEW INTERNET TERMINALS THAT ARE INDEPENDENT OF THE PC OR TV, SUCH AS SCREEPHONES AND WEB TERMINALS. SALES OF SUCH DEVICES WILL REACH 600 MILLION unitedstates DOLLARS IN 2005. SALES OF INTERACTIVE TV APPLIANCES, SUCH AS ONLINE DIGITAL TV SET-TOP BOXES AND ADVANCED GAMES CONSOLES, WILL REACH 2.4 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2002. SALES WILL PEAK AT 4.8 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2003, BEFORE DECLINING TO 4.2 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2005 UNDER THE IMPACT OF FALLING PRICES. SHIPMENTS, HOWEVER, ARE EXPECTED TO REACH 7.4 MILLION UNITS IN 2000 AND 26.4 MILLION UNITS BY 2005. ON AVERAGE, A unitedstates ONLINE HOME WILL HAVE 2.7 ONLINE DEVICES BY 2005, ACCORDING TO THE STUDY. THIS REPRESENTS AN EMERGING OPPORTUNITY FOR INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS AND NETWORK OPERATORS. ACCORDING TO THE RESEARCH COMPANY YANKEE GROUP, APPROXIMATELY 650,000 unitedstates HOMES HAVE SOME FORM OF NETWORKING INSTALLED NOW, AND THE NUMBER IS EXPECTED TO GROW AT A COMPOUND ANNUAL GROWTH RATE OF 95 PERCENT OVER THE NEXT FOUR YEARS, WHEN IT WILL REACH 10 MILLION BY 2003.

title: WAL-MART REACHES DEAL WITH AOL TO BUILD INTERNET SHOPPING SITE
body: WAL-MART, THE unitedstates LARGEST RETAILER, REACHED A DEAL THURSDAY WITH AMERICA ON LINE, THE BIGGEST INTERNET PROVIDER TO CREATE A NEW INTERNET SHOPPING SITE IN AN EFFORT TO BOOST SALES. UNDER THE DEAL, THE TWO COMPANIES WILL CREATE A NEW ISP THAT WILL BE CO-BRANDED BY  WAL-MART AND AOL. WALL-MART WILL DISTRIBUTE AOL SOFTWARE IN ITS MORE THAN 2,900 unitedstates STORES WHILE AOL WILL PROMOTE WAL-MART'S REDESIGNED WEB SITE, WALMART.COM, IN THE SHOPPING AREA OF ITS SITE. IT IS THE LATEST DEAL BETWEEN A RETAIL CHAIN AND A BIT INTERNET COMPANY TO FORM A PARTNERSHIP IN A BID TO BOOST SALES AND BRAND AWARENESS AMONG SHOPPERS. THE KMART CORPORATION SAID WEDNESDAY THAT IT WAS TEAMING UP WITH THE INTERNET COMPANY YAHOO TO FORM A NEW COMPANY THAT WILL PROVIDE FREE ACCESS TO THE INTERNET AND A CO- BRANDED SHOPPING SITE CALLED BLUELIGHT.COM THROUGH SUCH DEAL, ANALYSTS SAID, ONLINE COMPANIES WILL GAIN A NEW AVENUE TO ADVERTISE THEIR WEB SITES AND EXPAND THEIR CUSTOM BASE WHILE RETAILERS WILL BUILD THEIR OWN INTERNET BUSINESSES WITH THE HELP OF INTERNET COMPANIES. IN THE LAST MONTH, MICROSOFT SIGNED A DEAL WITH THE TANDY CORPORATION TO PROMOTE ITS INTERNET SERVICE THROUGH TANDY'S RADIOSHARK STORES. AOL ALSO LINKED UP WITH THE ELECTRONIC RETAILER CIRCUIT CITY TO PROMOTE ITS WEB ACCESS SERVICE.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: A REPORT RELEASED TUESDAY PROJECTS THAT THE unitedstates WHOLESALE NETWORK SERVICES MARKET WILL GROW AT AN AVERAGE ANNUAL RATE OF 24 PERCENT IN THE NEXT FEW YEARS. THE MARKET, DRIVEN PRIMARILY BY INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) RELATED WHOLESALE VOLUME, IS EXPECTED TO REACH 116 BILLION unitedstates DOLLARS IN REVENUE BY 2003, UP FROM 39 BILLION DOLLARS IN 1998, ACCORDING TO THE REPORT FROM RESEARCH AND CONSULTING FIRM PHILLIPS GROUP. THE REPORT SAID THREE KEY SECTORS ACCOUNT FOR INCREASES IN IP RELATED WHOLESALE VOLUMES. THE RAPID GROWTH OF WIRELESS WHOLESALE SERVICES, DRIVEN BY INTERNET ACCESS, WILL JUMP FROM 500 MILLION DOLLARS IN 1998 TO 5.5 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2003, EXPANDING 11 TIMES. THE SECOND BIGGEST IP WHOLESALE GROWTH RATE WILL BE AMONG NEW ENTRANTS TO THE INDUSTRY, KNOWN AS COMPETITIVE LOCAL EXCHANGE CARRIERS. THESE FIRMS POSTED TOTAL WHOLESALE REVENUES OF 250 MILLION DOLLARS IN 1998 AND IN FIVE YEARS, THEIR REVENUES ARE EXPECTED TO MULTIPLY 10-FOLD, TO 2.62 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2003. LASTLY, REVENUES OF PACKET/CELL-BASED NETWORK SERVICE PROVIDERS, WHICH INCLUDE THE DELIVERY OF IP TELEPHONY, WILL JUMP FROM 2 BILLION DOLLARS IN 1998 TO 20.4 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2003. THERE ARE THREE KEY DRIVERS IN THE unitedstates WHOLESALE NETWORK SERVICE MARKET, ACCORDING TO THE REPORT. THE INITIAL DRIVER IS THE IMPACT OF ONGOING DEREGULATION OF THE TELECOM ENVIRONMENT AND THE GROWTH IN COMPETITION THAT IT HAS GENERATED. THE SECOND DRIVER HAS BEEN THE RAPID ACCELERATION OF TELECOM TECHNOLOGIES, PARTICULARLY FIBER OPTIC TRANSMISSION AND SWITCHING CAPABILITIES THAT ARE RESULTING IN THE DOUBLING OF BANDWIDTH CAPABILITIES EVERY NINE MONTHS. THE THIRD DRIVER HAS BEEN THE IMPACT OF THE INTERNET ON THE DEMAND FOR BANDWIDTH AND THE TRANSFORMATION OF BANDWIDTH USAGE FROM CIRCUIT-SWITCHED VOICE TO IP PACKET NETWORKS.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: unitedstates STANFORD UNIVERSITY IS OPENING A NEW E-COMMERCE CENTER TO PROVIDE RESEARCH AND COURSES ON THE BOOMING INDUSTRY, ACCORDING TO A REPORT FROM THE UNIVERSITY MONDAY. STANFORD OFFICIALS SAID INTERNET GIANTS EBAY, SCHWAB AND GENERAL ATLANTIC ARE AMONG SEVERAL COMPANIES THAT HAVE PITCHED IN TO HELP STANFORD UNIVERSITY RAISE MORE THAN 20 MILLION DOLLARS TO FINANCE STUDIES OF THE INTERNET AND E-COMMERCE. STANFORD PLANS TO USE THE FUNDS TO BUILD THE CENTER FOR ELECTRONIC BUSINESS WITHIN THE UNIVERSITY'S GRADUATE SCHOOL OF BUSINESS, FUELED BY THE HIGH DEMAND FOR SKILLED HIGH-TECH LABOR IN THE unitedstates. ACCORDING TO A STATEMENT ISSUED BY STANFORD MONDAY, THE PROGRAM WILL OFFER COURSE STUDIES AND FOCUS ITS RESEARCH ON HOW INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION AFFECT FIRMS, MARKETS AND INDUSTRIES. ROBERT JOSS, DEAN OF THE BUSINESS SCHOOL, SAID THE NEW CENTER WILL DEVELOP RESEARCH AND EDUCATION INITIATIVES NEEDED TO UNDERSTAND THE IMPACT OF INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGIES ON FIRMS, INDUSTRIES AND MARKETS. JOSS SAID THE BUSINESS SCHOOL'S GOAL IS TO BE THE WORLDWIDE LEADER IN RESEARCH, CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT AND THE DISSEMINATION OF IDEAS ABOUT CONDUCTING BUSINESS ELECTRONICALLY AND ABOUT ELECTRONIC COMMERCE. STANFORD'S PROGRAM COMES AT A TIME WHEN THE HIGH-TECH SECTOR IS IN GREAT NEED OF TALENT. THE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ASSOCIATION OF AMERICA (ITAA) ESTIMATES THAT THERE ARE CURRENTLY 346,000 UNFILLED HIGH-TECH JOBS IN THE unitedstates. IN ADDITION, THE INDUSTRY WILL NEED UP TO 1.3 MILLION NEW HIGHLY SKILLED EMPLOYEES BY 2006, ACCORDING TO THE unitedstates COMMERCE DEPARTMENT. TO MEET THIS DEMAND, CONGRESS ANNOUNCED IN OCTOBER THAT IT WAS CONSIDERING LEGISLATION TO ALLOW COMPANIES TO DRAW FOREIGN-BORN POSTGRADUATE STUDENTS TO FILL THE GAPS. A BREEDING GROUND FOR HIGH-TECH SUCCESS STORIES, PALO ALTO, CALIFORNIA-BASED STANFORD IS TRYING TO ENCOURAGE NET COMPANIES IN ITS BACKYARD TO BECOME MORE INVOLVED IN RESEARCH AND EDUCATION. STANFORD, SPAWNING GROUND FOR MANY SUCCESSFUL SILICON VALLEY BUSINESSES, BELIEVES THAT THROUGH INVESTING IN EDUCATION, THE WHOLE INDUSTRY WINS. "THE SCHOOL WILL DISSEMINATE RESEARCH TO THE BUSINESS COMMUNITY THROUGH SEMINARS AND EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS FOR EXECUTIVES," ACCORDING TO THE STATEMENT. AS PART OF THE NEW PROGRAM, STANFORD WILL OFFER A NEW E- COMMERCE COURSE AND EXECUTIVE TRAINING PROGRAM NEXT YEAR. THE CENTER WILL ALSO ACT AS A CLEARINGHOUSE AND LIBRARY FOR FACULTY RESEARCH AND STUDIES.

title: HKE121414 -- FEATURE: INTERNET WAR FLARES UP IN SINGAPORE(PART 1)
body: A TOUGH PRICING WAR HAS BROKEN OUT AMONG SINGNET, PACIFIC INTERNET (PACNET) AND STARHUB, SINGAPORE'S TOP THREE INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS (ISP). SINGNET, CURRENTLY THE NUMBER-ONE ISP WITH THE LARGEST MARKET SHARE, ANNOUNCED SUNDAY A PACKAGE PLAN OFFERING FREE INTERNET ACCESS AND FREE EMAIL ACCOUNT TO ITS 1.8 MILLION SUBSCRIBERS IN SINGAPORE. THIS DEALT A DEADLY BLOW TO STARHUB, WHICH TRIGGERED THE CONFLICT TEN DAYS AGO WITH ITS OFFER OF FREE NET SURFING BUT WITH NO EMAIL, AND MANAGED TO RECRUIT NEARLY 40,000 NEW USERS IN LESS THAN TWO DAYS. THEN CAME THE NO. TWO PACNET, WHICH INTRODUCED ON MONDAY ASIA'S FIRST CUSTOMER REWARDS PROGRAM WHICH WILL PAY USERS TO LOG ONTO ITS E-COMMERCE PORTAL AND WEB SITE PACFUSION. COM STARHUB DROPPED THE BOMB FIRST ON DECEMBER 3. STARHUB INTERNET, A WHOLLY-OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF INTERNATIONAL CONSORTIUM STARHUB PTE.  LTD., ROCKED THE SCENE BY OFFERING THE EXISTING HALF A MILLION INTERNET ACCOUNT HOLDERS IN SINGAPORE THE OPPORTUNITY TO SWITCH TO ITS OFFER OF UNLIMITED, FREE INTERNET SURFING. "STARHUB BELIEVES THAT ACCESS TO INFORMATION VIA THE INTERNET SHOULD BE MADE SIMPLE AND EASILY AVAILABLE FOR EVERYONE. WE THINK IT IS TIMELY TO BREAK THE ACCESS BARRIERS TO BASIC INTERNET SURFING, WITH THE FREEDOM TO SURF AT NO ACCESS CHARGE," SAID TERRY CLONTZ, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OF STARHUB. THE SURF-FOR-FREE PLAN INCLUDED A FREE INTERNET CONNECTION BUT WITH NO EMAIL, NO INTERNATIONAL ROAMING AND NO DISK SPACE. AN APPLICANT WILL BemailED A FREE STARTER-KIT AFTER REGISTERING ONLINE, AND THEN SURFING IS FREE EXCEPT FOR NORMAL TELEPHONE FEE. NO EMAIL AND NO DISK SPACE WERE CONSIDERED AS A BIG DEFECT AS THERE ARE COUNTLESS WEB-BASED COMPANIES LIKE YHAOO, AND MAILCITY AND GEOCITY WHICH WOULD BE MORE THAN WILLING TO OFFER SURFERS FREE EMAIL ACCOUNTS AND FREE WEB HOSTING. AT LEAST FOR THE MOMENT, THE PLAN POSED AS A DAUNTING CHALLENGE FOR SINGNET AND PACNET BECAUSE EVEN THE CHEAPEST PLAN OFFERED BY THE TWO ASKS A CUSTOMER FOR A MINIMUM OF 55 SINGAPORE DOLLARS ( ABOUT 33 unitedstates DOLLARS) AND ADDITIONAL TELEPHONE FEES FOR ONE MONTH 'S UNLIMITED SURFING. NATURALLY, THE NUMBER OF APPLICANTS FOR THE STARHUB'S SERVICE SOARED, WITH 38,000 PEOPLE, OR 76 PERCENT OF STARHUB'S EXISTING POOL OF 50,000 USERS, SIGNING UP IN ONLY ONE AND A HALF DAYS. "IT TOOK US THREE YEARS TO HIT 50,000, YET THE FREE INTERNET PLAN TOOK ONLY LESS THAN TWO DAYS TO HIT 40,000," SAID AN ELATED MANAGER WITH THE COMPANY.

title: HKE121415 -- INTERNET WAR FLARES UP IN SINGAPORE (PART 2)
body: ...WITH THE COMPANY. THE STARHUB'S JOYOUS MOOD, HOWEVER, DID NOT LAST LONG. THE SINGNET VERSION OF FREE NET-SURFING PLAN CAME WITH A FREE 8MB DISK SPACE EMAIL ACCOUNT POWERED BY LYCOS ASIA, A JOINT VENTURE BETWEEN SINGNET'S PARENT SINGAPORE TELECOM (SINGTEL) AND LYCOS. MOREOVER, THE SINGNET PLAN OFFERS USERS MORE COMPLETE SERVICES, INCLUDING GLOBAL ROAMING, EMAIL ALERT AND FAX-MAIL, THAN ITS COMPETITOR STARHUB. "THE FUTURE GROWTH IN TELECOMMUNICATIONS WILL BE DRIVEN BY THE INTERNET AND E-COMMERCE," SAID SINGTEL CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER LIM TOON, ADDING THAT THE GROUP AIMS TO MAKE SINGAPORE THE INTERNET HUB IN THE ASIA PACIFIC, PERHAPS EVEN IN THE WORLD. "WHAT BETTER WAY THAN TO PROVIDE FREE INTERNET ACCESS AND EMAIL TO EVERY HOME AND OFFICE?" LIM ASKED. SINGNET CURRENTLY ENJOYS A LION'S SHARE OF 250,000 SUBSCRIBERS, OR MORE THAN 50 PERCENT OF THE INTERNET DIAL-UP MARKET IN THE CITY- STATE WITH A POPULATION OF ABOUT 3.8 MILLION. IT SAID THAT ITS PARENT SINGTEL'S 1.82 MILLION FIXED-LINE CUSTOMERS IN SINGAPORE WILL BE "PRE-REGISTERED" FOR THE FREE SERVICE, AND DETAILS ON USER-ID AND PASSWORD WILL BE SENT TO THE CUSTOMERS OVER A PERIOD OF THREE MONTHS STARTING FROM JANUARY NEXT YEAR. AFTER THE SINGNET OFFER, ALL EYES ARE NOW SET ON PACNET, SECOND ONLY TO SINGNET IN TERMS OF THE NUMBER OF SUBSCRIBERS. PACNET FINALLY BROKE THE SILENCE BY DECLARING ON MONDAY AN " ATOMIC" MOVE WHICH IT SAID WILL "REVOLUTIONIZE INTERNET MARKETING.  " "WHY SURF THE NET FOR FREE? YOU SHOULD GET PAID FOR IT," CLAIMED PACNET IN AN ADVERTISEMENT CARRIED IN RECENT LOCAL NEWSPAPERS. UNDER THE PROGRAM, INTERNET USERS WHO VISIT ITS PACFUSION. COM AND OTHER WEB SITES HOSTED ON THE PORTAL WILL EARN SOMETHING CALLED "ATOMS" THAT CAN BE USED TO PURCHASE PRODUCTS AND SERVICES IN THE E-COMMERCE OUTLETS. "WE ARE DELIGHTED THAT SURFERS CAN NOW VISIT OUR PACFUSION. COM PORTAL FOR FREE, THANKS TO SINGNET AND STARHUB," SAID NICHOLAS LEE, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER OF PACNET. WITH THE REWARDS PROGRAM, PACNET IS TRYING TO LEVERAGE ON THE FREE SERVICE OF ITS TWO RIVALS TO HIJACK "EYEBALLS" FOR ITS OWN E- BUSINESS PORTAL. THE PACNET OFFER MAY APPEAR TO PALE BEFORE THE FREE SERVICES BY ITS RIVALS STARHUB AND SINGNET, BUT IT REVEALED THAT PACNET, UNWILLING TO FOLLOW ITS COMPETITORS, HAS EMBARKED ON A NEW STRATEGY OF FOCUSING ON PORTAL REVENUE RATHER THAN ACCESS REVENUE. WITH SOME 70 PERCENT OF ITS REVENUE COMING FROM PROVIDING INTERNET ACCESS IN SINGAPORE, PACNET SAID IT PLANS TO DIVERSIFY ITS REVENUE THROUGH ITS E-BUSINESS EXPANSION INTO OTHER AREAS IN THE REGION, LIKE CHINA, hongkong, THE PHILIPPINES, AUSTRALIA AND INDIA.

title: CANADIAN GOVERNMENT TO GO ON WEB AT C5B BY 2004
body: THE CANADIAN FEDERAL GOVERNMENT PLANS TO SPEND UP TO 5 BILLION CANADIAN DOLLARS (ABOUT 3.4 BILLION unitedstates DOLLARS) GETTING ITS SERVICES ONLINE BY 2004, THE OTTAWA CITIZEN REPORTED SUNDAY. THE CYBERSPACE PROJECT AIMS AT BUILDING NEW INFRASTRUCTURE AND PUTTING THE MOUNDS OF GOVERNMENT INFORMATION AND PROGRAMS ON THE WEB, THE REPORT QUOTED FEDERAL OFFICIALS AS SAYING. THE GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENTS WOULD BE ABLE TO USE THE INTERNET TO REENGINEER HOW THEY DO BUSINESS. UNLIKE THE PAPER-BASED TRANSACTIONS BEING CONDUCTED IN THOSE DEPARTMENTS, THE HIGH-COST TECHNOLOGY WOULD MEAN PAPERLESS ONE- STOP SHOPPING FOR ALL FEDERAL, PROVINCIAL AND MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT SERVICES. CANADIANS, FOR EXAMPLE, WOULD BE ABLE TO FILE INCOME TAX AND GET THE REFUND DIRECTLY DEPOSITED INTO THEIR ACCOUNT, WITHOUT EVER KNOWING THE TRANSACTION PROCESSED THROUGH REVENUE CANADA, ACCORDING TO THE REPORT. THE GOVERNMENT AND TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY HAVE, IN THEIR FIRST STEP, WORKED CLOSELY OVER THE PAST YEAR TO DEVELOP A SECURE, HIGH- SPEED NETWORK TO DELIVER FEDERAL SERVICES OVER THE INTERNET. A TOTAL OF 26 MILLION CANADIAN DOLLARS (ABOUT 18 MILLION unitedstates  DOLLARS) HAS BEEN SET ASIDE TO DEVELOP A PROTOTYPE OF THE NETWORK.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: hongkong'S MOBILE PHONE SERVICE PROVIDERS ARE NOW STAGING AN INTENSIVE CAMPAIGN TO DEVELOP THE THIRD-GENERATION WIRELESS INTERNET SERVICES, WHICH ARE EXPECTED TO BE ESSENTIAL TO THEIR REVENUE INCREASE NEXT YEAR. FOUR MAJOR CELLULAR OPERATORS, CABLE AND WIRELESS HKT, HUTCHISON TELECOM, SMARTONE AND NEW WORLD MOBILITY (NWM), HAVE ALL LAUNCHED THE MOBILE INTERNET SERVICES THIS WEEK, WITH THE ARRIVAL OF THE FIRST WIRELESS APPLICATION PROTOCOL (WAP) HANDSET IN hongkong. WAP IS AN OPEN GLOBAL STANDARD FOR COMMUNICATION BETWEEN A MOBILE HANDSET AND THE INTERNET OR OTHER COMPUTER APPLICATION.   THE NOKIA 7110 WAP HANDSET, WHICH BECAME AVAILABLE IN hongkong RECENTLY, ENABLES USERS TO GET ADVANCED, INTERACTIVE AND REAL-TIME MOBILE SERVICES, SUCH AS MOBILE BANKING OR INTERNET-BASED NEWS SERVICES. THE "WORLD WIDE MOBILITY" (WWM) INTERNET SERVICE, LAUNCHED BY NWM, PROVIDES BILINGUAL INFORMATION SUCH AS NEWS, WEATHER, TRAFFIC AND FINANCIAL INFORMATION VIA THE WAP HANDSET. "WWM IS JUST OUR FIRST STEP TO MOVE INTO THE MOBILE INTERNET AND E-COMMERCE ARENA. WE WILL CONTINUE TO PROVIDE MORE NEW VALUE- ADDED SERVICES BY USING THE LATEST TECHNOLOGY, BRINGING hongkong' S MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS INTO A NEW HEIGHT OF ACHIEVEMENT," SAID ALBERT WONG, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OF NEW WORLD TELEPHONE GROUP. NWM, WHOSE MOBILE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED BY NEW WORLD TELEPHONE GROUP, HAS JUST MARKED A MILESTONE OF 500,000 MOBILE PHONE USERS. IT HAS ALSO SIGNED A STRATEGIC COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH YAHOO hongkong TO PROVIDE THE LATEST AND MOST DYNAMIC GLOBAL INFORMATION TO MOBILE PHONE USERS. YAHOO'S INFORMATION SERVICES ARE TARGETED TO BE AVAILABLE IN FIRST QUARTER OF 2000 WHILE A WIDE ARRAY OF WAP SERVICES SUCH AS TRANSPORTATION HOTLINE, MOVIE AND RESTAURANT GUIDES, WAP email, MOBILE BANKING AS WELL AS SHOPPING AND TICKETING WILL BE LAUNCHED. MOBILE OPERATORS HAVE TAKEN UP PREFERENCES OF FREE MONTHLY FEE AND FREE AIRTIME TO PROMOTE THE NOKIA WAP HANDSET WHICH IS SOLD HERE AT 3,680 HK DOLLARS (472 unitedstates DOLLARS). CABLE  WIRELESS HKT, LEADING TELECOMMUNICATION OPERATOR IN hongkong, ON ITS PART, LAUNCHED THE I.MENU MOBILE INTERNET SERVICE BY USING WAP TECHNOLOGY AND BELIEVES THE SERVICE WILL BE WELCOME IN THE MARKET. THE COMPANY PLEDGED TO INVEST ONE BILLION HK DOLLARS TO UPGRADE THE COMMUNICATION NETWORK AND OFFER MORE NEW SERVICES TO MEET THE DEMANDS OF BUSINESS AND DAILY LIFE OF CUSTOMERS.

title: HUTCHISON TELECOM, THE LARGEST CELLULAR OPERATOR IN HONG KONG, .
body: AS THE WORLD'S BIGGEST MOBILE PHONE COMPANY, NTT DOCOMO WAS THE FIRST NETWORK OPERATOR TO INTRODUCE BROADBAND WIRELESS INTERNET ACCESS INTO COMMERCIAL USE. THE I-MODE SERVICE, DEVELOPED BY NTT DOCOMO, ALLOWS USERS TO ACCESS DATA AND IMAGES VIA A MOBILE PHONE AT FAST SPEEDS. THE SERVICE ENABLES THE MOBILE USE OF SUCH APPLICATIONS AS TELEPHONE BANKING, AIRLINE RESERVATIONS, STOCK TRANSACTIONS, email AND INTERNET ACCESS. HUTCHISON'S MANAGING DIRECTOR CANNING FOK KIN-NING SAID THAT THE DEAL MADE SENSE IN LIGHT OF THE EXPECTED TRANSITION FROM VOICE- DOMINATED TO DATA-DOMINATED MOBILE TELEPHONE TRAFFIC IN THE NEAR FUTURE. "hongkong CELLULAR PENETRATION IS ALREADY OVER 50 PERCENT, SO WHERE CAN IT GO EXCEPT TOWARD WIRELESS DATA AND MULTIMEDIA SERVICES," SAID FOK. NTT DOCOMO'S MANAGING DIRECTOR OF GLOBAL BUSINESS KIYOYUKI TSUJIMURA SAID IT WOULD TAKE ABOUT ONE YEAR FOR NTT DOCOMO TO BRING ITS JAVA-BASED I-MODE SYSTEM TO hongkong. HUTCHISON TELECOM, WHICH OPERATES TWO MOBILE NETWORKS IN hongkong, HAS ABOUT 1.3 MILLION SUBSCRIBERS, 33 PERCENT OF THE hongkong SAR CELLULAR MARKET. HUTCHISON PREDICTS THAT 50 PERCENT OF ITS SUBSCRIBERS WOULD USE THE I-MODE SERVICE, WHICH WOULD FUEL THE INCREASE OF CONSUMPTION OF SUBSCRIBERS. JOINING HANDS TO UNVEIL A NEW CHAPTER IN hongkong'S MOBILE COMMUNICATION INDUSTRY, NWM HAS ALSO COMPLETED THE INSTALLATION OF THE NOKIA GENERAL PACKET RADIO SERVICE (GPRS) SOLUTION. AS A MAJOR STEPPING STONE TOWARDS THE THIRD-GENERATION MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY, GPRS BOOSTS DATA SPEED TO OVER 100KBITS PER SECOND AND ENABLES MOBILE PHONE USERS TO BE PERMANENTLY CONNECTED TO THE NETWORK. MIKE MULVEY, MANAGING DIRECTOR OF NOKIA NETWORKS, NOKIA (HK) LTD, SAID: "GPRS IS A KEY BUILDING BLOCK IN THE SMOOTH EVOLUTION TO OUR VISION OF MOBILE INFORMATION SOCIETY WHERE USERS HAVE ACCESS TO INFORMATION ANYTIME, ANYWHERE." SWEDISH TELECOMS GROUP ERICSSON ANNOUNCED THAT IT WILL ESTABLISH ASIA'S FIRST MOBILE DATA APPLICATIONS TEST CENTERS IN hongkong AND SINGAPORE. THE CENTERS WOULD ENABLE THE TRIAL OF GENERAL PACKET RADIO SERVICE (GPRS) APPLICATIONS, AND FUEL THE MOVE TOWARDS THIRD- GENERATION (3G) WIRELESS MULTIMEDIA SERVICES. WITH THE AVAILABILITY OF GPRS APPLICATION AND THE WAP HANDSET, ANALYSTS PREDICT THAT THE INTERNET SERVICE VIA HANDSET WILL TAKE A LEAP IN THE COMING YEARS AND THE NUMBER OF THOSE WHO ENJOY MOBILE INTERNET SERVICES MAY EVEN EXCEED THOSE INTERNET USERS WITH COMPUTER APPLICATION.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: MORE THAN 80 PERCENT OF THE unitedstates CONSUMERS RATE THEIR ONLINE BANKING EXPERIENCE HIGHER THAN THEIR TRADITIONAL BRICK-AND-MORTAR BANKING EXPERIENCE, ACCORDING TO AN INTERNET SURVEY RELEASED THURSDAY. THE SURVEY OF 444 CONSUMERS, CONDUCTED BY THE RESEARCH FIRM FREDERICK SCHNEIDERS RESEARCH, ALSO FOUND THAT 13 PERCENT OF RESPONDENTS DO ALL THEIR BANKING ONLINE. WHILE THE MAJORITY OF USERS ARE SATISFIED WITH THEIR ONLINE BANKING EXPERIENCE, THE SURVEY ALSO FOUND THAT SOME CONSIDER THE PROCESS OF OPENING AND FUNDING NEW ACCOUNTS ONLINE INCONVENIENT AND TIME-CONSUMING. TWENTY PERCENT OF ALL RESPONDENTS SAID THEY HAVE STARTED THE PROCESS OF OPENING AN ONLINE CHECKING ACCOUNT AND THEN QUIT IT.  MORE THAN HALF STOPPED BECAUSE TOO MANY FORMS HAD TO BE COMPLETED AND MAILED OR FAXED, AND THE METHOD OF DEPOSITING FUNDS WAS TOO INCONVENIENT. "THIS SURVEY SHOWS THAT (unitedstates) INTERNET USERS ARE EMBRACING ONLINE BANKING," THE RESEARCH FIRM SAID. "BUT THE RESULTS ALSO SHOW THEY WANT ONLINE FINANCIAL SERVICES COMPANIES TO PROVIDE MORE SERVICES, AND --GIVEN THE HIGH ABANDONMENT RATE OF NEW ACCOUNTS-- MAKE THE ACCOUNT OPENING AND INITIAL FUNDING PROCESS EASIER TO ACCOMPLISH." MORE THAN 80 PERCENT OF RESPONDENTS SAID THEY PREFER TO USE A SERVICE THAT WOULD ALLOW THEM TO TRANSFER FUNDS ELECTRONICALLY TO AN ONLINE ACCOUNT FROM ACCOUNTS AT OTHER FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS, AND NEARLY 80 PERCENT RATED SUCH A SERVICE AS CONVENIENT. ABOUT ONE QUARTER OF CURRENT ONLINE CHECKING ACCOUNT HOLDERS INITIALLY FUNDED THEIR ACCOUNTS BY MAILING A CHECK FROM ANOTHER INSTITUTION, THE STUDY FOUND. OTHERS FUNDED IT WITH A DIRECT DEPOSIT OF A PAYCHECK, OR BY TRANSFERRING FUNDS FROM A SEPARATE TRADITIONAL ACCOUNT WITHIN THE SAME INSTITUTE. THE SURVEY ALSO FOUND THAT THE MAJORITY OF CONSUMERS ARE CONCERNED WITH THE SECURITY OF THE INTERNET. NEARLY 85 PERCENT OF RESPONDENTS ARE CONCERNED WITH THE SECURITY OF ONLINE TRANSACTIONS, SUCH AS CREDIT CARD PURCHASES ON THE WEB. MORE THAN 90 PERCENT ARE CONCERNED WITH THE SECURITY OF THEIR PERSONAL INFORMATION ON THE INTERNET.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: SPENDING ON WEB ADVERTISING IN THE unitedstates IS EXPECTED TO SLOW DOWN ALTHOUGH TOTAL DOLLAR FIGURES WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE THROUGH 2003, ACCORDING TO A REPORT RELEASED THURSDAY. ONLINE ADVERTISING SPENDING WILL GROW FROM 3.1 BILLION unitedstates  DOLLARS IN 1999 TO 4.82 BILLION IN 2000 AND 13.3 BILLION BY 2003, SAID THE REPORT FROM EMARKETER, A unitedstates FIRM SPECIALIZING IN ONLINE BUSINESS. "THE YEAR-TO-YEAR INCREASES THAT OCCURRED IN 1997 AND 1998 ARE NOT SUSTAINABLE," SAID THE REPORT. "AS THE BASE GETS BIGGER, THE RATE OF GROWTH IN ONLINE ADVERTISING WILL SLOW DURING THE NEXT FIVE YEARS." ONLINE ADVERTISING SPENDING IN 2003 WILL REPRESENT 4.7 PERCENT OF TOTAL ADVERTISING EXPENDITURES IN THE unitedstates, WHICH ARE EXPECTED TO TOP 285 BILLION DOLLARS. NEW MEDIA CONTENT PROPERTIES AND COMPUTER-RELATED PRODUCTS AND SERVICES ARE BUYING THE LARGEST PORTION OF WEB ADS IN THE unitedstates, ACCOUNTING FOR 48 PERCENT OF THE TOTAL ONLINE AD SPENDING, THE REPORT SAID. COMPUTER HARDWARE AND SOFTWARE ADVERTISERS ARE ALSO SPENDING HEAVILY ON THE INTERNET AS THEY ARE A NATURAL FIT FOR THE WEB AUDIENCE. CONSUMER PACKAGE GOODS MARKETERS ARE NOW BEGINNING TO DIVERT MORE OF THEIR MASSIVE AD BUDGETS TOWARD ONLINE ADVERTISING. THE REPORT ALSO STRESSED THAT WHILE THE INTERNET IS EXPERIENCING RAPID GROWTH, IT WILL NEVER TOTALLY SUPPLANT ADVERTISING IN TRADITIONAL FORMS OF MEDIA. "ONLINE MARKETERS WILL STILL RELY ON OTHER, OFF-LINE MEDIA TO CREATE AWARENESS, BUILD AND PROMOTE THEIR BRANDS, AND DRIVE TRAFFIC TO THEIR WEB SITES," THE REPORT SAID. "THE NET IS MERELY ONE TOOL, WITH SPECIFIC STRENGTHS AND WEAKNESSES, IN THE OVERALL ADVERTISING MIX."

title: EU EXECUTIVE HAILS AGREEMENT ON E-COMMERCE LAW
body: THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION SAID WEDNESDAY THAT IT WELCOMES THE POLITICAL AGREEMENT REACHED TUESDAY BY THE EUROPEAN UNION (EU) FOREIGN MINISTERS ON A COMMON POSITION FOR THE PROPOSED ELECTRONIC COMMERCE DIRECTIVE. THE EU EXECUTIVE SAID IN A STATEMENT THAT THE DIRECTIVE WOULD ENSURE THAT INFORMATION SOCIETY SERVICES BENEFITED FROM THE EU INTERNAL MARKET PRINCIPLES OF FREE MOVEMENT OF SERVICES AND FREEDOM OF ESTABLISHMENT AND COULD BE PROVIDED THROUGHOUT THE EU IF MEMBER STATES COMPLIED WITH THE LAW AT HOME. THE PROPOSED DIRECTIVE WOULD ESTABLISH SPECIFIC HARMONIZED RULES ONLY IN THOSE AREAS STRICTLY NECESSARY TO ENSURE THAT BUSINESSES AND CITIZENS COULD SUPPLY AND RECEIVE INFORMATION SOCIETY SERVICES THROUGHOUT THE EU, IRRESPECTIVE OF FRONTIERS, SAID THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION, THE EU EXECUTIVE BRANCH MAINLY FOR PROPOSING AND ENFORCING REGULATIONS EU-WIDE. THOSE AREAS INCLUDE DEFINITION OF WHERE OPERATORS ARE ESTABLISHED, TRANSPARENCY OPERATIONS FOR OPERATORS, TRANSPARENCY REQUIREMENTS FOR COMMERCIAL COMMUNICATIONS, CONCLUSION AND VALIDITY OF ELECTRONIC CONTRACTS, LIABILITY OF INTERNET INTERMEDIARIES, ON-LINE DISPUTE SETTLEMENT AND THE ROLE OF NATIONAL AUTHORITIES. IN OTHER AREAS, THE DIRECTIVE WOULD BUILD ON EXISTING EU INSTRUMENTS WHICH PROVIDE FOR HARMONIZATION OR MUTUAL RECOGNITION OF NATIONAL LAW.

body: THREE KEY DEVELOPERS OF INTERNET PROTOCOL-BASED TELEPHONY HELD A FORUM TODAY IN hongkong TO DEMONSTRATE THE DEPTH OF AND SUPPORT FOR IP-BASED COMMUNICATIONS IN ASIA. CLARENT, A PREMIER PROVIDER OF IP TELEPHONY PRODUCTS IN THE WORLD, ANNOUNCED THE OPENING OF ITS OFFICES IN hongkong AND SINGAPORE. INTERNET TELEPHONY HAS DEFINITELY HIT PRIME TIME AND MORE THAN ONE BILLION MINUTES OF IP TELEPHONY TRAFFIC IS ESTIMATED TO TRANSMIT THROUGH CLARENT IP GATEWAYS WORLDWIDE THIS YEAR, SAID HEIDI BERSIN, CLARENT CORPORATION'S SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT FOR CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS AND MARKETING. "CURRENTLY, WE ARE HANDLING OVER 20 MILLION MINUTES EACH MONTH AND TRAFFIC IS GROWING BY DOUBLE DIGITS MONTH OVER MONTH," SAID LEA KING, PRODUCT DIRECTOR OF ATT GLOBAL CLEARINGHOUSE. "THE NEXT WAVE WILL BE IN IP-BASED VALUE-ADDED APPLICATIONS AND ATT GLOBAL CLEARINGHOUSE WILL BE LEADING THE DEVELOPMENT EFFORT TO BRING VALUE TO OUR MEMBERS AND THIS INDUSTRY," KING SAID. WITH THE COMMERCIAL LAUNCH OF ITS MANAGED IP BACKBONE NETWORK, OCEN COMMUNICATIONS, A LEADING INTERNET SERVICES PROVIDER FOCUSED ON NORTH AMERICAN AND ASIAN MARKETS, IS WELL-POSITIONED TO RESPOND TO ASIA'S STRONG DEMAND FOR IP-BASED COMMUNICATIONS, SAID STEVEN ENG, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER OF OCEN. "OUR NEW NETWORK IS CAPABLE OF SUPPORTING UP TO 50 MILLION MINUTES PER MONTH OF CARRIER-GRADE VOICE AND FAX TRANSMISSIONS AND OTHER REAL-TIME AND ENHANCED IP COMMUNICATIONS SERVICES," HE SAID. OF THIS MORE THAN 20 PERCENT WILL INVOLVE THE ASIA PACIFIC REGION.

title: HKE120645 -- MALAYSIA'S E-BANKING BANKING INDUSTRY TO GROW
body: MALAYSIA'S BANKING INDUSTRY IS PREDICTED TO ACHIEVE ABOUT 500 MILLION unitedstates DOLLARS IN REVENUE FROM THE ELECTRONIC BANKING (E-BANKING) BUSINESS BY 2003. MOST OF THE MALAYSIAN BANKS ARE NOW EXPLORING THE E-BANKING CONCEPT, A unitedstates FINANCER SAID HERE MONDAY. "THIS WILL GIVE LOCAL BANKS AN IDEA OF THE EXPENDITURE THEY HAVE TO DEAL WITH FOR SETTING UP E-BANKING AND TO DEVELOP THE STRATEGY TO MARKET THE NEW SYSTEM TO THE COMMUNITY," RICK RICHARDSON, THE LEADER FOR THE unitedstates FINANCIAL SERVICES PRACTICE AND GLOBAL BANKING FOR PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS USA, SAID DURING THE MEDIA BRIEFING ON"TRENDS IN ASIA'S BANKING SECTOR" HERE. HE SAID THE CONSOLIDATION EXERCISE CURRENTLY BEING UNDERTAKEN BY THE MALAYSIAN BANKING INDUSTRY WOULD GIVE AN ADDED ADVANTAGE TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF E-BANKING IN THE COUNTRY. "WITH THE MERGER EXERCISE, A BIGGER ENTITY WILL BE CREATED WHICH WILL BENEFIT THEM (BANKS) ALL AS THEY BECOME READY TO OFFER E-BANKING. WHAT WE NEED NOW IS THE APPROVAL FROM BANK NEGARA ( STATE BANK) MALAYSIA TO SET UP THE E-BANKING SYSTEM," HE SAID. THE CURRENT CONVENTIONAL BANKING IS BEGINNING TO GIVE WAY FOR E- BANKING, HE SAID, ADDING "ONCE THE RESTRICTION ON VIRTUAL BANKING IS LIFTED BY THE CENTRAL BANK, WE FORESEE THAT MALAYSIA WOULD DEFINITELY BE AMONG THE FIRST ASIAN COUNTRIES TO IMPLEMENT THE NEW TREND AND BECOME A MAJOR PLAYER." THERE IS A POSSIBILITY FOR MALAYSIAN BANKS TO GO FOR CROSS- BORDER MERGER OR PARTNERSHIP WITH THE IMPLEMENTATION (OF E-BANKING) , THOUGH NOT SOON, HE PREDICTED, SAYING MALAYSIAN BANKS MIGHT WANT TO DEVELOP ITS OWN E-BANKING SYSTEM BEFORE MOVING FURTHER OR OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY OR REGION.

title: HKE120661 -- EXPERTS MEET TO DISCUSS RESEARCH ON MEASURING E-COMMERCE
body: SOME 200 STATISTICAL EXPERTS FROM 27 COUNTRIES (AREAS) ARE GATHERING HERE TO EXPLORE WAYS TO DEVELOP ACCEPTABLE AND WORLD-WIDE STANDARDS AND PROTOCOLS ON E- COMMERCE WITH A VIEW TO ACHIEVE UNIFORMITY, CONSISTENCY AND COMPARABILITY IN E-COMMERCE STATISTICS EVERYWHERE. SPEAKING AT THE OPENING OF THE THREE-DAY CONFERENCE ON THE MEASUREMENT OF ELECTRONIC COMMERCE, SINGAPORE ACTING MINISTER FOR COMMUNICATIONS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY AND MINISTER OF STATE FOR NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT JOHN CHEN ATTACHED IMPORTANCE TO THE RESEARCH ON MEASURING E-COMMERCE, SAYING IT IS CRUCIAL THAT MEASUREMENT ISSUES ARE HIGHLIGHTED AND A SET OF TOOLS AND STANDARDS BE DEVELOPED FOR MEASURING E-COMMERCE IN A BID TO GAUGE THE IMPACT OF E-COMMERCE ON THE ECONOMY. NOTING THAT THE LACK OF AN INTERNATIONAL STANDARD DEFINITION ON E-COMMERCE HAS LED TO WIDELY DISPARATE STATISTICS ON E-COMMERCE AND GENERATED MUCH DIFFICULTY IN DRAWING COMPARISON BETWEEN DIFFERENT SOURCES OF INFORMATION, CHEN EMPHASIZED THE NEED TO DEVELOP A COMMON FRAMEWORK FOR CONDUCTING E-COMMERCE SURVEYS, STANDARDIZE CONCEPTS DEFINITIONS AND DEVELOP A UNIFORM QUESTIONNAIRE FOR COLLECTING INFORMATION RELATING TO E-COMMERCE. ACCORDING TO CHEN, E-COMMERCE IS GROWING RAPIDLY WITH THE GLOBAL NUMBER OF INTERNET USERS EXPECTED TO REACH 300 MILLION AND THE TOTAL E-COMMERCE TRANSACTIONS PROJECTED TO EXCEED ONE TRILLION unitedstates DOLLARS BY 2002. IN THE CASE OF SINGAPORE, CHEN SAID 96 PERCENT OF LARGE ENTERPRISES AND 86 PERCENT OF SMALL ENTERPRISES ARE EQUIPPED WITH INTERNET ACCESS AND 61 PERCENT OF LARGE FIRMS AND 32 SMALL ENTERPRISES HAVE THEIR OWN WEBSITES. CHEN ALSO SAID SINGAPORE WILL FURTHER STRENGTHEN ITS SUPPORT FOR COMMERCE DEVELOPMENTS BY "ENCOURAGING ACADEMIA, CONSULTANTS AND BUSINESS TO TAKE UP THOUGHT LEADERSHIP PROJECTS ON SINGAPORE AND THE REGION", "ENCOURAGING LEADING E-COMMERCE RESEARCH COMPANIES TO BE BASED IN SINGAPORE" WITH A VIEW TO BUILD THE COUNTRY'S RESEARCH CAPABILITY, "FACILITATING AND GENERATING FORUMS FOR DISCUSSION ON THE LATEST THINKING" AND CONTINUING TO EXCEL AND TAKING GREAT LEADERSHIP AT INTERNATIONAL POLICY FORA.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: THE NUMBER OF unitedstates ADULTS USING CREDIT CARDS TO PURCHASE GOODS AND SERVICES ONLINE MORE THAN DOUBLED BETWEEN 1998 AND 1999, ACCORDING TO A REPORT RELEASED THURSDAY. BY THE THIRD QUARTER OF 1999, 19.2 MILLION ADULTS USED THEIR CREDIT CARDS TO MAKE ONLINE TRANSACTIONS, COMPARED TO 9.3 MILLION IN 1998 AND ONLY 4.9 MILLION IN 1997, SAID THE REPORT FROM CYBER DIALOG, A unitedstates MARKET RESEARCH AND DATA MARKETING FIRM. CYBER DIALOG'S FINDINGS COME AS PART OF ITS SURVEY ON AMERICAN INTERNET USAGE, WHICH CONSISTS OF RANDOM INTERVIEWS WITH 1,000 INTERNET USERS AND 1,000 NON-USERS. THE SURVEY ALSO FOUND OUT THAT VISA IS USED BY NEARLY 70 PERCENT OF ADULTS, WHO COMPLETE PURCHASE TRANSACTIONS ONLINE. THE FINDINGS SUGGEST THAT CREDIT CARDS HAVE ESTABLISHED THEMSELVES AS THE NEW ONLINE CURRENCY WHEN IT COMES TO BUYING GOODS AND SERVICES OF ANY VALUE, THE REPORT SAID. OTHER STUDIES, HOWEVER, INDICATE THAT CREDIT CARD SECURITY HAS BEEN ONE OF THE MAJOR CONCERNS OF ONLINE PURCHASERS. A SURVEY CONDUCTED BY THE RESEARCH FIRM INTERMARKET GROUP IN OCTOBER FOUND THAT ONLY ONE-THIRD OF unitedstates INTERNET USERS HAVE ACTUALLY MADE ONLINE PURCHASES. THE MOST FREQUENTLY CITED BARRIERS OF ONLINE SHOPPING INCLUDE PRODUCT PRICING, POTENTIAL RETURN HASSLES, CONCERNS ABOUT CREDIT CARD SECURITY AND PERSONAL PRIVACY ISSUES SUCH AS WORRIES ABOUT JUNK email. SIXTY-FIVE PERCENT OF THE INTERNET USERS SURVEYED CITED CREDIT CARD SECURITY AS THEIR CONCERN.

body: BRINGING INTERNET CONNECTIVITY THROUGHOUT THE HOUSEHOLD WILL ALLOW THE EMERGING MARKET FOR RESIDENTIAL GATEWAY HARDWARE TO REACH 4.7 BILLION unitedstates  DOLLARS WORLDWIDE BY 2005, ACCORDING TO A REPORT RELEASED THURSDAY. THE ROLLOUT OF BROADBAND AND HOME NETWORKING SOLUTIONS WILL CONVERGE TO PRODUCE THIS SIGNIFICANT NEW CATEGORY OF PRODUCTS, SAID THE REPORT FROM THE unitedstates TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH THINK-TANK ALLIED BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE, INC. (ABI). THE RESIDENTIAL GATEWAY IS AN INTELLIGENT HARDWARE DEVICE CONNECTING HOME DEVICES AND APPLIANCES TO THE INTERNET. IT MAY ALSO INCORPORATE THE NETWORK ACCESS INTERFACE. IN MANY CASES SUCH DEVICES WILL BE PRIMARILY MARKETED AS ACCESS DEVICES WITH INTEGRATED HOME NETWORKING FUNCTIONALITY. THESE ALL-IN-ONE BOXES WILL ALLOW SERVICE PROVIDERS TO DELIVER MULTIPLE SERVICES BY DEPLOYING A SINGLE BOX ON THE CUSTOMER PREMISES. THE ROLLOUT OF BROADBAND ACCESS DEVICES WILL ALSO ALLOW SERVICE PROVIDERS TO DELIVER INTEGRATED SERVICES SUCH AS DATA, VIDEO AND VOICE TO THE HOME, SAID THE REPORT. BY 2005, OVER 23 MILLION NORTH AMERICAN HOUSEHOLDS WILL SUBSCRIBE TO BROADBAND SERVICE, ACCORDING TO ABI'S PREDICTION. NORTH AMERICA IS EXPECTED TO BE THE LEADING MARKET FOR RESIDENTIAL GATEWAY DEPLOYMENT, ABI SAID, BECAUSE OF HIGHER MULTIPLE PC PENETRATION INTO THE HOME AND GREATER PENETRATION OF NON-PC INTERNET APPLIANCES. THIS MARKET WILL ACCOUNT FOR A 59 PERCENT ANNUAL INCREASE IN UNITS SHIPPED FROM 2002 TO 2005. IN OTHER REGIONS, THE REPORT SAID, UTILITY-CENTRIC SERVICE GATEWAYS WILL BE DEPLOYED AGGRESSIVELY. EUROPE, FOR EXAMPLE, WILL REALIZE A 64 PERCENT INCREASE ANNUALLY IN THESE SHIPMENTS BETWEEN 2002 AND 2005. IN THESE MARKETS, RESIDENTIAL GATEWAYS WILL BE DRIVEN BY DEREGULATED UTILITIES SEEKING TO PROVIDE AUTOMATED METER READING, SECURITY MONITORING AND REMOTE APPLIANCE MANAGEMENT.

title: AUTHORITIES: GERMAN NEO-NAZI WEB SITES RISING IN INTERNET
body: THE NUMBER OF GERMAN FAR RIGHT EXTREMISTS IS RISING CONTINUOUSLY IN RECENT YEARS, NOT ONLY IN THE REAL WORLD BUT ALSO IN THE INTERNET, AUTHORITIES SAID ON THURSDAY. THE NUMBER OF NEO-NAZI WEB SITES WRITTEN IN GERMAN HAS GROWN TO ABOUT 320 UP FROM 30 IN YEAR 1996 ECKART WERTHEBACH, A SENATOR IN BERLIN FOR INTERIOR AFFAIRS, WAS QUOTED AS TELLING THE DEUTSCHE PRESSE AGENTUR (DPA) NEWS AGENCY. THERE ARE FURTHER SOME 1,400 WEB SITES IN 30 OTHER COUNTRIES, SAID PETER FRISCH, PRESIDENT OF FEDERAL OFFICE OF CONSTITUTE PROTECTION. THE OFFICE BASED IN COLOGNE IS GERMANY'S DOMESTIC SECURITY AGENCY. IN RECENT YEARS, MORE CONTENTS IN THESE WEB SITES ARE FOCUSED ON MAKING EXPLOSIVE AD BOMBS, DEPLOYING VIOLENCE AGAINST POLITICAL OPPOSITES, AND EVEN MURDER THE OPPOSITES, SAID FRISCH. THESE WEB SITES ARE WORLD WIDE ACCESSIBLE, MAKING IT MORE DIFFICULT FOR THE OFFICE TO OBSERVE AND CONTROL, WERTHEBACH ADDED. IN YEAR 1998, THERE WERE 53,600 FAR RIGHT EXTREMISTS REGISTERED IN GERMANY, UP FROM 48,400 IN 1997, SAID FRISCH. AMONG THEM, SOME 8,200 WERE RECORDED AS "DANGEROUS VIOLENT, " UP FROM 7,600 IN 1997. MOST OF THE VIOLENT NEO-NAZIS ARE BASED IN EASTERN STATES, AND TWO-THIRDS OF THEM ARE YOUTH OR YOUNG ADULTS, HE SAID. GERMAN AUTHORITIES ARE MORE CONCERNED ABOUT THOSE "NEO-NAZI POTENTIALS," ESPECIALLY IN THE CAPITAL BERLIN. THE GEOGRAPHIC SITE OF BERLIN MAKES NEO-NAZI POTENTIALS EASIER TO BE MOBILIZED SAID WERTHEBACH, QUOTING THAT THE NUMBER NEO-NAZI POTENTIALS IN BERLIN HAD DOUBLED FROM YEAR 1990 TO 1998. BUT THERE ARE STILL NO SIGNS THAT BERLIN, AS THE CENTER OF HITLER'S THIRD REICH, HAS BECOME A SYMBOL CHARACTER FOR NEO-NAZIS, HE SAID.

body: AN EXPLOSIVE GROWTH IN THE unitedstates BUSINESS INTERNET ACCESS MARKET WILL BE FUELED BY THE DEMAND FOR HIGHER BANDWIDTH TECHNOLOGIES, ACCORDING TO A REPORT RELEASED WEDNESDAY. THE MARKET IS EXPECTED TO GROW BY NEARLY 70 PERCENT TO AN ANNUAL RATE OF ALMOST 17 BILLION unitedstates DOLLARS IN 2003, SAID THE REPORT FROM THE STRATEGIES GROUP, A unitedstates TELECOMMUNICATIONS MARKET RESEARCH AND CONSULTING FIRM. "SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED BUSINESSES ARE THE GROWTH ENGINE OF THE unitedstates ECONOMY," THE REPORT SAID. "FOR MOST OF THESE COMPANIES, NEW TECHNOLOGIES THAT OFFER COST-EFFICIENT BANDWIDTH WILL BE THE ONLY WAY TO LEVERAGE THE INTERNET POTENTIAL.  TECHNOLOGIES LIKE DIGITAL SUBSCRIBER LINE HAVE NOT YET REACHED WIDESPREAD ADOPTION, BUT WILL GROW TREMENDOUSLY OVER THE NEXT TWO YEARS." INTERNET ACCESS HAS BECOME ESSENTIAL FOR THE MAJORITY OF unitedstates  BUSINESSES.  THE REPORT FINDS INTERNET PENETRATION INCREASING IN LINE WITH BUSINESS SIZE: 60 PERCENT OF SMALL BUSINESSES NOW HAVE INTERNET ACCESS, WITH MEDIUM-SIZED BUSINESSES AT 80 PERCENT, AND LARGE ONES AT 90 PERCENT TO 97 PERCENT. ACCORDING TO THE STRATEGIES GROUP'S FORECAST, unitedstates SMALL BUSINESS (WITH ONE TO 19 EMPLOYEES) WEB HOSTING REVENUES WILL REACH 1.67 BILLION DOLLARS IN 1999, 3 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2001 AND 3.9 BILLION DOLLARS IN 2003.

title: EU ADOPTS ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE DIRECTIVE
body: THE EUROPEAN UNION (EU)'S TELECOMMUNICATIONS MINISTERS ADOPTED TUESDAY A NEW LEGAL FRAMEWORK GUARANTEEING EU-WIDE RECOGNITION OF ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES. THE ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE DIRECTIVE WAS CLEARED DURING AN ONE- DAY MEETING OF EU COUNCIL OF MINISTERS. THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION, THE EU'S EXECUTIVE BRANCH, SAID THIS IS THE FIRST EXAMPLE OF ITS " FLEXIBLE AND INTEGRATED" EFFORTS TOWARDS DEVELOPING A EUROPEAN FRAMEWORK FOR THE PROGRESS OF ELECTRONIC COMMERCE. EU'S 15 MEMBER STATES NOW HAVE 18 MONTHS TO IMPLEMENT THE LAW WHICH IS EXPECTED TO ENHANCE INTERNET SECURITY AND HELP EUROPE MAKE GOOD THE E-COMMERCE GAP BETWEEN THE REGIONAL BLOC AND THE unitedstates. IN THE PAST, ONLY HAND-WRITTEN SIGNATURES HAVE BEEN LEGALLY VALID BUT THIS LEGISLATION EXTENDS THAT RECOGNITION TO ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES AND APPLIES THE INTERNET MARKET PRINCIPLES OF FREE MOVEMENT OF SERVICES AND HOME COUNTRY CONTROL TO E-COMMERCE, THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION SAID IN A STATEMENT. "THIS FRAMEWORK PROVIDES THE SECURITY THAT THE MARKET FOR ONLINE TRANSACTIONS DEMANDS AND STRENGTHENS THE EU'S POSITION IN THE FACE OF INTERNATIONAL COMPETITION IN THIS NEW GLOBAL MARKET," IT ADDED. ELECTRONIC SIGNATURES ALLOW SOMEONE RECEIVING DATA OVER ELECTRONIC NETWORKS, VIA THE INTERNET FOR EXAMPLE, TO DETERMINE THE ORIGIN OF THE DATA AND TO CHECK THAT THE DATA HAD NOT BEEN ALTERED. THE DIRECTIVE IS NOT DESIGNED TO REGULATE EVERYTHING IN DETAIL BUT DEFINES THE REQUIREMENTS FOR ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE CERTIFICATES AND CERTIFICATION SERVICES SO AS TO ENSURE MINIMUM LEVELS OF SECURITY AND ALLOW THEIR FREE MOVEMENT THROUGHOUT THE INTERNET MARKET, THE EU EXECUTIVE SAID.

title: MEE113004HKE -- FEATURE: NET SERVICE PRICE WAR HEATED IN LEBANON
body: LEBANON'S INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS (ISP) HAVE HAD A ROUGH RIDE OVER THE LAST FEW MONTHS, AFTER A CUT-THROAT PRICE WAR BEGAN IN SEPTEMBER. THE PRICE WAR BEGAN WHEN BANQUE AUDI, THE COUNTRY'S LEADING BANK, ACQUIRED PART OF INCONET, A KEY ISP IN LEBANON, AND STARTED OFFERING "FREE" INTERNET ACCESS TO ANYONE WHO OPENED A NET ACCOUNT. AUDI'S NET ACCOUNT IS NOT EXACTLY FREE. CLIENTS PAY AN  ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE FEE OF 10,000 LEBANESE POUNDS (ABOUT 6.66 unitedstates  DOLLARS) A MONTH. CYBERIA, THE LARGEST PLAYER WITH ALMOST 40,000 SUBSCRIBERS, RESPONDED BY SLASHING THE PRICE ON UNLIMITED ACCESS FROM 29 DOLLARS A MONTH TO 12.99 DOLLARS. THE ISP PACK SOON FOLLOWED SUIT, DROPPING RATES ON UNLIMITED ACCESS TO LEVELS AS LOW AS 9.99 DOLLARS A MONTH. TWO MONTHS LATER THE DUST HAS BEGUN TO SETTLE, BUT NOT WITHOUT LEAVING SOME CASUALTIES. A FEW SMALLER ISPS, INCLUDING INTER, BRIDGE AND MAGNARAMA, HAVE REPORTEDLY BEEN FORCED OUT OF BUSINESS, WHILE MOST OF THE REMAINING ISPS HAVE TO TIGHTEN THEIR BELTS AND WAIT TO SEE WHO WILL SINK AND WHO WILL SAIL ON. "YOU JUST PUT IN YOUR MONEY AND HOLD YOUR BREATH," SAID SAM LUTFALLAH, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF INCONET. HIS COMPANY'S PARTNERSHIP WITH BANQUE AUDI ANGERED MANY IN THE BUSINESS WHO FEEL BANKS SHOULD STICK TO BANKING AND ISPS TO THE INTERNET. "IF BANQUE AUDI WAS OFFERING A FREE SERVICE, THEN I THINK THERE IS A LEGAL ISSUE THAT NEEDS TO BE ADDRESSED," SAID ABUDE OMARI OF CYBERIA. NONETHELESS, THE DEAL STARTED A TREND AS OTHER ISPS ARE TEAMING UP WITH BANKS. BYBLOS BANK, THE COUNTRY'S ANOTHER POWERFUL FINANCIAL INSTITUTION, HAS ALIGNED ITSELF WITH DATA MANAGEMENT, WHILE CREDIT LIBANAIS STRUCK A PARTNERSHIP DEAL WITH TERRANET AND DATA MANAGEMENT. IN A DESPERATE BATTLE TO WIN NEW CUSTOMERS AND GREATER MARKET BASE, ISPS HAVE ALSO BEGUN DIVERSIFYING THEIR PRODUCTS AND SERVICES SO AS NOT TO RELY EXCLUSIVELY ON THE VOLATILE DIAL-UP MARKET. SOME OFFER EXTRA SERVICES SUCH AS INTERNET ROAMING, INTERNET FAXING AND WEB DESIGN SERVICES, EXCEPT INTERNET CALLS, WHICH ARE CURRENTLY BANNED BY THE COMMUNICATION MINISTRY. THE CASH-STRAPPED LEBANESE GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN WORRYING THAT THE REVENUES GENERATED FROM ITS MONOPOLIZED INTERNATIONAL PHONE CALLS WILL BE GRABBED BY THE CHEAPER ONLINE PHONE SERVICE. DATA MANAGEMENT RECENTLY ANNOUNCED THAT IT WAS GOING INTO THE NET COMMERCE BUSINESS WITH CREDIT LIBANAIS. TERRANET AND INCONET SAID THEY HAVE PLANS TO DO THE SAME WITHIN THE NEXT YEAR. DESPITE THE TOUGH TIMES, MOST ISPS SAY THAT THEY INTEND TO REMAIN IN THE GAME. "IN THE LONG TERM, WE SEE TREMENDOUS POTENTIAL. THAT'S WHAT KEEPS US IN THE BUSINESS," SAID SUHEIL ZURUB, GENERAL MANAGER OF TERRANET. IN LEBANON, THERE ARE SOME 20 ISPS AND 60,000 TO 100,000 INTERNET USERS, THE HIGHEST PER CAPITA IN THE MIDDLE EAST.

body: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK (CCB), ONE OF THE COUNTRY'S FOUR LARGEST STATE-OWNED COMMERCIAL BANKS, WILL GIVE A GOVERNMENT MEDIA CENTER FINANCIAL SUPPORT, ONLINE BANKING, BUYER'S CREDIT AND HELP WITH ITS NATIONWIDE SETTLEMENT SYSTEMS, CHINA DAILY REPORTED TODAY. AS PART OF A DEAL SIGNED IN BEIJING, THE BANK WILL LOAN THE INFORMATION NETWORK CENTER 300 MILLION YUAN (36 MILLION US DOLLARS) IN WORKING CAPITAL, AND MORE MONEY IS EXPECTED, SAID THE ENGLISH NEWSPAPER. "IT IS A WIN-WIN PARTNERSHIP AND WILL BE BENEFICIAL TO BOTH OF US," ZHANG ENZHAO, VICE PRESIDENT OF THE CCB, WAS QUOTED AS SAYING. AS HOPES HEIGHTEN FOR CHINA'S ENTRY TO THE WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION, THE COUNTRY'S BANKING SECTOR AND INFORMATION INDUSTRY ARE EXPECTING DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES AND ALSO PREPARING FOR CHALLENGES. "SO WE SHOULD COOPERATE MORE CLOSELY AND STRENGTHEN EACH OTHER, " HE TOLD CHINA DAILY. THE STATE ADMINISTRATION OF RADIO, FILM AND TELEVISION, WHICH OVERSEES THE INFORMATION NETWORK CENTER, PLANS TO ESTABLISH A COMPANY TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE CONSTRUCTION AND OPERATION OF CHINA' S RADIO AND CABLE TV TRANSMISSION NETWORKS. THE INFORMATION   NETWORK CENTER IS EXPECTED TO HANDLE THE FOUNDING WORK, CHINA DAILY REPORTED. AS THE CENTER EXPANDS ITS RESPONSIBILITIES, THE CCB WILL SERVE AS A FINANCIAL CONSULTANT FOR THE NEW COMPANY, HELP THE LATTER WITH COMPUTERIZED SETTLEMENT SERVICES, COLLECT FEES FROM CLIENTS AND HELP ESTABLISH A CABLE TV USER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, ZHANG TOLD CHINA DAILY. HE ADDED THAT HIS BANK ALSO NEEDS HELP FROM THE RADIO, FILM AND TV ADMINISTRATION TO ASSIST IT IN THE COMPUTER INFORMATION ERA. CURRENTLY SERVING MORE THAN 200 MILLION PEOPLE IN THE COUNTRY, CHINA'S CABLE TV NETWORK IS RECEIVING 5 MILLION NEW USERS EACH YEAR AND HAS BECOME ONE OF THE WORLD'S LARGEST CABLE TV NETWORKS.
