"their needs today are focused on improving communications, with commerce coming much later." small businesses are those with two to 99 employees while medium businesses employ 100 to 499 people. among the two categories surveyed, only an average of 30 percent stated that the internet was important to achieving business goals. in fact, although 61 percent of small businesses and 82 percent of medium businesses report that they have some form of internet access, only 50 percent of all pcs within small businesses and 31 percent of all pcs within medium businesses have internet access.  according to the research firm, small and medium businesses account for 98 percent of all unitedstates businesses, represent about 50 percent of the nation's gnp, and spend approximately 445 billion unitedstates dollars annually on information technology products and services.  "there is no question that service providers, as well as equipment manufacturers, have a huge opportunity to turn these companies into 'internet believers' through substantial education efforts and long-term relationship building," the yankee group said.

title: web maestro wins lifetime achievement award
body: pc magazine, the largest business magazine in the unitedstates, announced tuesday that its lifetime achievement award of 1998 was given to the web maestro tim berners-lee.  ten years ago, berners-lee proposed a global hypertext project, to be known as the world wide web, that would allow people to work together by combining their knowledge in a web of hypertext documents. he also wrote the first web server and the first client browser. through 1991 and 1993, he continued working on the design of the web, coordinating feedback from users across the internet.  bernerslee graduated from the queen's college at oxford university, england, in 1976. while working in the european particle physics laboratory in geneva, he wrote for his own private use his first program for storing information, which formed the conceptual basis for the future development of the world wide web. in 1994, he accepted a position at mit's laboratory for computer science, where he remains today as director of the influential world wide web consortium, the organization that coordinates web developments all around the world.  earlier this year, in response to a question whether he was happy with what the world wide web has turned out so far, bermers-lee approved the richness of material on the web and the diversity of ways in which it is being used. but he said "there are many parts of the original dream which are not yet implemented." for example, he said, very few people have an easy, intuitive tool for putting their thoughts into hypertext.  pc magazine also presented the person of the year award to jerry yang and david filo, founders of yahoo. while both studying at stanford as graduate students in 1994, they created the directory company.  the magazine has also given awards to breakthrough products and technologies since 1984, including pc hardware, software, internet and networking technologies.

title: yahoo delivers one-stop internet shopping service
body: yahoo, the silicon valley-based internet media company, launched a holiday season online shopping service tuesday, featuring more than two million products.  "yahoo shopping" enables consumers to locate, compare and buy these products from 2,700 online stores, make purchase in one checkout and ship orders to multiple locations.  "let your figures do the shopping," said the company, boasting the convenience its service offers to the customers. shoppers simply click on "view cart" in the menu bar to get a full view of the items they have selected prior to checkout. regardless of the number of different stores shoppers buy from, they will only need to provide their billing address once during a trip to the web site. customers can also designate the recipient of each item to send and ship holiday gifts from their computer.  two million products across 14 popular categories include apparel, books, electronics, music, movies, cd players, digital cameras and toys.  the company said that the merchants participating in the service have been selected based on their commitment to online security and customer service. visa is the preferred payment card of the new service.

title: australian shares falter further as leaders tumble
body: the australian share market drifted further friday after a sharp dip in key stocks, particularly news corp., outweighed a recovery in the gold and oil sectors.  the all ordinaries index closed 27.0 lower at 2,681.3 points with industrial stocks among the biggest losers while losses in the resource sector were less marked.  brokers said the five percent fall in the news corp. shares accounted for much of the 58.8 point fall in the all industrials index to 4,685.4.  news corp.'s ordinary shares shed 55 cents and its non-voting stock dropped 65 cents, which fell after it revealed disappointing first quarter earnings.  "the quarterly profit was significantly less than what the market had thought and that's what's dragged news corp. back," macquarie nevitts client adviser rick terpstra said.  one of the most dramatic falls of the day was baker goodman fielder which topped the day's trading volume as it retreated close to 15 percent after revealing an unexpectedly flat profit outlook.  goodman fielder ended 31 cents lower on a turnover of 28 million shares. total turnover was 375.1 million shares traded worth 1.035 billion australian dollars (657.22 million unitedstates dollars), with 522 rising stocks, 532 falling and 352 steady.  national australia bank suffered the most in the banking sector, down 35.5 cents, while the other majors also fell.  anz lost nine cents, westpac gave up eight and commonwealth shed seven.  the all resources index closed 1.0 point higher at 1,069.5 points, despite a 48.9 cents fall in the second largest miner on the exchange, rio tinto, to 19.969 australian dollars.  fellow diversifieds bhp, down 0.3 cents, and wmc, up 15.4, were better performed. oil and gas major woodside moved two cents higher.  the gold sub-index rose just under two percent to 1,188.7 points.  bullion rose 3.60 to 297.10 unitedstates dollars in sydney's trade after a rise overnight was fueled by the growing tensions in the persian gulf.

title: scholars call for international information law
body: a number of scholars recently proposed the establishment of a framework global "information law" covering the acquisition of information, intellectual property, criminal acts and web security.  the made the proposal at an international seminar on intellectual property rights held here recently.  "a series of laws should have certain cross reference points and relationships which should be taken into consideration when researching challenges met by the legal system governing intellectual property from electronic information technology," according to chen xiaozhu, an official with the ministry of information industry.  electronic information technology, including microelectronics, computers and telecommunications, is witnessing rapid development which has had a great influence on the intellectual property system.  "we must adopt a long-term view regarding trends in the intellectual property system and the information era in the next century. we must also continue to research problems related to the intellectual property system," said chen.  it is essential to protect the exclusive rights of information and simultaneously encourage the development of new techniques.  experts noted that computer software and integrated circuit semi-conductors are subject to the duality of industrial property and copyrights.  "the result of ongoing developments will accelerate two existing trends involving intellectual property," according to michael pantuliano, a senior adviser with the rogers and wells law office.  "the first is the emergence of a separate body of copyright laws for electronic works and computer software, and the second is judicial concepts for using patent laws to resolve electronic copyright disputes.  "prior to legal resolutions concerning emerging issues, permissible uses for intellectual property must be accomplished by establishing rights and solutions for the internet by contract," according to pantuliano.  "internet piracy is a growing problem shared by all industries subject to copyrights," said davis wang, an employee of the microsoft office in beijing.  "governments will play a paramount roll in creating and implementing an effective intellectual property system which will protect the interests of software developers and the creators of information transmitted over the internet," said wang.

title: australian stocks close firmer as big caps bounce
body: strong buying interest in large capitalization stocks inspired by the success of news corp's 1.76-billion-unitedstates-dollar share offer in fox entertainment in the unitedstates helped the australian share market close firmer wednesday.  the all ordinaries index climbed just under 1.5 percent, or 38.3 points to close at its peak for the day of 2,720.7.  the rise was strongest in non-resource stocks with the all industrials index up 77.0 points to 4,764.2 while the all resources index added 5.1 points to 1,075.2.  volume was strong with national turnover a healthy 348.5 million shares traded worth 1.129 billion australian dollars (711.23 million unitedstates dollars) with 624 shares rising, 475 falling and 397 steady.  news corp's ordinary shares jumped 4.7 percent, or 51 cents, to 11.30 australian dollars, while its preferred shares climbed 42 to 10.08 australian dollars.  henderson charlton jones dealer michael blake said news corp was firmer largely due to positive news about the fox entertainment group inc float in the unitedstates.  he said rises among other key industrials such as lend lease and brambles were also keeping the market firm.  the local bourse drew little direction from the dow jones industrial average in new york which closed down 33.98 points at 8,863.98 overnight.  westpac rose 31 cents after it delivered a 1.5-percent drop in net profit after an abnormal loss in line with expectations.  the other banking majors' strength also contributed to a 1.93-percent jump in the banking sub index to 5,976.0 points.  national australia rose 49 cents, commonwealth rose 46.9 and anz gained 14 cents on turnover of 7.1 million shares.  the only major industrial to buck the positive trend was telstra, which drifted four cents on strong volume of 11.82 million shares.  elsewhere in the industrial sector, lend lease stacked on 58.5 cents and brambles industries soared 69.  resource majors were generally much softer performers.  bhp gained a modest two cents, while rio tinto added 24 after a weak start while fellow diversified miner wmc lost three cents.  the gold index firmed 14.8 points to 1,180.8 as bullion gained 1.20 unitedstates dollars to 293.10 per ounce in sydney trading.

title: yahoo gets foothold in china
body: global internet content provider yahoo has signed a landmark agreement with china to sell its services here, yahoo international vice president heather killen announced here today.  she said in a speech delivered at the third cic-china.com conference here that beijing-based infoshare technology co. ltd. will be the exclusive sales agency for yahoo in china.  infoshare is a state-owned company under the china international electronic commerce center (ciecc) of the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation (moftec).  ma yun, general manager of infoshare, said that this cooperation will begin in december. infoshare will promote yahoo services in china and help chinese enterprises create on-line advertisements on yahoo's worldwide network.  "this is just the first step in cooperation, and we have a complete plan," he said.  but he did not elaborate, saying that the plan will be unveiled at a joint press conference in the unitedstates in the next 48 hours.  killen said that it is a good idea to cooperate with moftec, which has direct links with import-and export-oriented companies in china.  she said that yahoo will offer a global platform for chinese companies entering the international market.  it is necessary to have a local sales agency in the country because the number of chinese companies contacting yahoo for on-line advertisement is increasing, she said.  according to ma the newly established ministry of information industry (mii) is drafting new regulations on the rapidly growing internet market and there is no requirement that the mii approve this cooperative project.  "we will go through all necessary procedures if any are introduced in the future," he said.  china now has six million internet users and the figure is doubling every year.

title: content provider holds annual conference in beijing
body: china's most promising internet content provider china internet corporation (cic) held the third cic-china.com conference here today.  several hundred representatives from the chinese government and international information technology and financial circles attended the meeting.  under the joint sponsorship of cic, the news and information center of xinhua news agency and the data communications bureau of china telecom, the conference invited representatives from successful internet content providers in the world to give lectures, including jack davis, president of america online.  the conference focused on four topics under the theme of "creating network society, embracing network civilization," including growth of international network technologies, internet market in china, network applications and on-line advertisement.  cic was jointly developed by xinhua news agency and the former ministry of posts and telecommunications. the china.com company (ccc), or china wide web (cww), is a solely owned company of cic. the first and second china.com conferences were held in october, 1996 and december, 1997 respectively.  since early this year, china.com has achieved success in creating a number of specialized web sites during such major events as the world cup football games, unitedstates president bill clinton's visit to china and serious floodings in china. as a result, it has become a pace setter in terms of on-line information and advertisement in the country's fledging internet industry.  at present, china.com provides information about china and its hongkong and taiwan regions in both chinese and english. it has four major web sites and access to users in over 200 cities and regions in china, as well as to those around the world.  it has formed cooperative relations with america online and nescape and strategic partnership with 24/7 media. its sources of informations include afp, dow jones business video, xinhua, thomson financial service and financial times.

title: worldwide internet services market to grow
body: worldwide spending on internet services will grow to 43.6 billion unitedstates dollars in 2002, according to the new forecast by an american market analysis firm released wednesday.  international data corporation (idc) said that the internet services market will be one of the fastest growing information technology (it) service market segments over the next five years.  in 1997, it was a market of just 4.5 billion dollars.  explaining the rapid growth of the market, idc said that companies moving from using internet technologies as a publishing medium to using them for e-commerce are finding themselves strapped for the necessary resources. "increased technical demands, higher profile projects, and a desire to focus on core competencies are driving companies to turn to external service providers for deployment of some or all parts of their e-commerce project," said the analysis firm.  the unitedstates represents the largest part of the worldwide internet services market opportunity throughout the forecast period. with 2.9 billion dollars in spending in 1997, idc expects it to grow to 22 billion dollars by 2002.  idc's report on worldwide internet and e-commerce services market and trends forecast between 1998 and 2002 analyzes unitedstates market opportunities, as well as europe, japan, asia-pacific, canada and latin america.  "the move to deploy e-commerce sites is putting increased demands on companies to raise their sophistication in internet technologies and to rethink how the internet ties in with business' strategies and processes," the idc report said. "growth potentials exist for service providers seeking to capitalize on these market opportunities."

title: hke110234--australian adults more likely to surf internet at work
body: australian adults are more likely to surf the internet at work than at home, an official survey released here monday found.  the australian bureau of statistics (abs) said monday that 1.43 million people use the internet at work, compared with 1.29 million who surf the world-wide web in their own time.  another 1.7 million access the internet at a mixture of places such as universities, libraries, or a friend's or neighbor's house.  the survey, taken in february and may this year, also found that 3.34 million adults had been on-line in the 12 months before they were questioned.  australia's population totals 18 million.  the survey also found that more households (43 percent) own a mobile phone than a computer (37 percent) or an answering machine (33 percent).  more than 1.7 million, or 50.5 percent, of all children aged between five and 17 use a home computer more than once a week.  about 85 percent of the children who frequently use a home computer spend their time playing games, compared with only 15 percent who are busy with internet-based activities.  this compared to about one-quarter of adults who use a home computer frequently, or 3.46 million.  the survey said that 15.4 percent, or 913,000 households, access the internet.

title: new opportunities, challenges open to hk's it industry: official
body: the greatest business opportunities for the information technology (it) industry lie in the development of sophisticated chinese internet applications and innovative content, as well as services related to electronic commerce, secretary for information technology and broadcasting k.c. kwong, said here on saturday.  addressing the annual conference of the hongkong institution of science, kwong said hongkong possessed a competitive edge and some distinctive comparative advantages not available to many of its competitors.  as a bilingual city, hongkong can communicate with and obtain information from most regions of the digital world where english is the lingua franca, he said. hongkong can also use chinese to promote and develop the application of chinese content in the digital world, to co-operate with other chinese communities, and to act as the digital intermediary between china's mainland and other parts of the world, he added.  "such capability is particularly important in view of the increasing number of internet users in chinese-speaking communities, and the ever-growing demand for chinese internet applications and content all over the world," he said.  hongkong is a cosmopolitan city which accepts different cultures in the world and its people are quick to assimilate the latest knowledge and technology. with a free and market-based economy where a free flow of information is available, the local community can freely co-operate and make association with any other place in the world, kwong said.  to assist local industry and business to exploit these opportunities, the special administrative region (sar) government should take the lead in using it to demonstrate the potentials, create the necessary environment to facilitate the development of content and applications, and raise public awareness and confidence in electronic business.  this is precisely the aim of the electronic service delivery (esd) scheme, a plan to deliver online government services, he noted.  through esd, the public can transact business with government online and, by means of internet, interactive telephone, tv or other electronic means of access, kwong said.  the sar government is working on such supporting issues as the establishment of certification authorities to ensure security of electronic transactions, and the introduction of a legal framework to provide necessary backing for electronic commerce.

title: africa has 800,000 internet users
body: africa has the lowest internet usage in the world, accounting for only 800,000 or 0.54 percent of the global internet user population of about 150 million, a nigerian communications official has said.  ogbonnaya iromantu, executive vice-chairman of the nigerian communications commission (ncc), said out of the figure, about 700,000 internet users are in south africa, 10,000 in zimbabwe and 7,000 in ghana and nigeria, the guardian newspaper reported friday.  by contrast, he said, the unitedstates has about 79 million internet users and europe 34 million while asia and pacific have 24 million.  the ncc boss said the inadequate general level of telecommunications facilities was clearly the most critical inhibiting element to electronic information sharing in africa.  he said at the on-going second international conference on broadcasting in africa held in nigerian capital abuja that africa spends about three billion unitedstates dollars to import telecommunications equipment and some 600 million dollars to connect one african country to the other through european countries every year.  this amount of money, he noted, is enough for some countries to maintain sustainable development of their telecommunications infrastructure and to develop local manufacturing competence in the continent.  the nigerian official said the way to redress the situation included support for technical training and skills as well as development of access points and demand in secondary cities and rural areas.  the journey to full internet connectivity in nigeria has been tortuous due to the different perceptions of the technology, he said.

title: china plans internet home page on ipr protection
body: china plans to set up a web site on the internet for its intellectual property rights protection to provide information on various court decisions, according to jiang zhipei, the deputy chief judge of the ip tribunal of the supreme people's court judge.  jiang said he believes that this will benefit ip rights holders, society and foreign investors, adding that china will make a legislative, judicial, administrative and social effort to protection intellectual property rights.  according to him, the nation's courts have handled 22,860 ipr disputes, with a decision reached on 21,830, in the past six years.  chinese law, in agreement with international conventions, protects patent, trademarks, copyrights and other intellectual property rights, and chinese courts have increased the judicial protection of intellectual property rights against plagiarizism, illegally copying, and contract breaches, jiang said.  the revised criminal law took effect in october 1997 and allows for a three to seven year prison sentence for offenders.  the high people's court in beijing also trains scholars from law schools, institutes or government offices in trying major difficult ipr cases, zhang said.  a sound system for adjudicating intellectual property rights disputes is an important prerequisite of ipr protection, said lu guoqiang, chief judge of the ip tribunal of the high people's court of shanghai.

title: murdoch attacks media for man united delay
body: media mogul rupert murdoch attacked british media on friday for the hold-up in his bskyb's controversial bid for manchester united.  murdoch, whose news corp owns a controlling 40 percent stake in bskyb, said the government's referral of the bid for an anti-monopoly review on thursday appeared politically motivated.  but he added he doesn't have any hard feelings towards trade secretary peter mandelson, the man who made the decision to delay the 623.4 million pound (about 1.05 billion unitedstates dollars) bid.  "i'm not blaming mr. mandelson in the least," murdoch told reporters after bskyb's annual shareholders' meeting. "as far as i'm concerned that goes with the territory." "obviously there is an excess of caution, yes. i mean, to be influenced by a few paranoid hacks (journalists) in fleet street is ridiculous," he said, adding that he didn't believe the bid raised any serious competition issues.  murdoch made the remarks during a brief question-and-answer session that touched on topics ranging from bskyb's plans in europe to the planned flotation of news corp's unitedstates fox unit.  bskyb's bid for manchester united, launched in september, has triggered widely publicized protests by some fans and politicians who fear the takeover of britain's biggest club will give murdoch too much control over british soccer.  murdoch already ranks as a favorite target for rivals who have criticized his grip on britain's tv and newspaper industries.  news corp's british holdings, aside from bskyb, include top-selling newspapers the sun and the times.  as a result of the referral to the monopolies and mergers commission, bskyb will have to wait until next year to find out whether it can buy man united. the mmc's report is due by march 12.  asked whether a rival bidder might emerge in the meantime, murdoch said, "i doubt it. i would be very surprised."

title: china to hold internet export fair
body: china is planning to introduce internet into china export commodity fair, which is one of the most influential foreign trade event in the country.  face-to-face talks and internet trading will become a new trend for the fair to be held biannually in guangzhou, officials attending the current 84th event told reporters.  preparations for such a fair are being made by china international electronic commerce center under the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation, the officials disclosed. the internet will play the role of introducing participating enterprises and products, statistics and background information of previous fairs.  according to zhang daming, deputy director of the center, the projected internet event is expected to expand the scale and influence of the fair, and facilitate the exchange between exporters and importers.  the novelty will also become an extension of the biannual event, providing chances for further contacts after the on-the-spot event is closed, zhang said.  internet was used for the first time two years ago during the 80th fair when a web-site of the fair was opened. statistics show about 4,000 people visit the site everyday.  the 83rd fair employed internet to send invitations to over 2,000 chain stores and department stores.  during the current fair, legend group, a leading chinese computer maker, struck a deal worth 18 million us dollars with a hongkong company.  "all these have paved the way for the coming of the internet fair in the future," zhang said.

title: electronic business popular in china
body: electronic business is growing in popularity in china, where 78.1 percent of the more than one million internet users want to shop on-line. to meet this demand, cities like beijing, shanghai, shenzhen, and xiamen have opened on-line homepages since the spring of 1996, when the xinhua bookstore in hangzhou, the capital of zhejiang province, started a website and china's first electronic business. the address "www.hot100.com.cn:" of an on-line shopping outlet started by the first general merchandise co. ltd. of xiamen, in fujian province, has proven the most successful. some 210,000 people have visited the website since the xiamen company opened it in september 1997, from japan, australia, singapore, hongkong and many other countries. che wancheng, the company's general manager, said that e-commerce has helped them increase sales, better understand market trends, and has been a good publicity tool. more than 30 factories in xiamen have opened homepages using the website address of che's company. che predicted that by the end of this year, there will be some 100,000 people looking at his company's website address each month. according to the international data corporation, 7.6 billion unitedstates dollars worth of goods were sold over the internet globally last year.

title: australian stocks end slightly lower
body: a rebound by media group news corp. prevented the australian sharemarket from following falls in asian bourses friday.  while the all ordinaries index finished just 1.3 points lower at 2,543.9 in mixed trade, a bounce in news corp. shares after thursday's slump largely offset japan and hongkong's weakness friday.  the all industrials index rose 1.9 points to 4,421.2, with news corp. up 45 cents to 10.16 australian dollars and its preferred scrip up 35 cents higher to 8.95 australian dollars.  banking stocks were mixed, with commonwealth bank of australia down 13 cents to 19.00 australian dollars and the other majors marginally higher: national australia bank up five cents to 20.25 australian dollars, anz bank up 2.9 cents to 8.979 australian dollars and westpac bank one cent higher at 9.46 australian dollars.  the all resources index was down 4.8 points to 1,039.0.  resources giant bhp edged six tenths of a cent higher to 13.00 australian dollars while global miner rio tinto shed one cent to 20.41 australian dollars.  the gold index rose four points to 1,142.8 as the bullion price fell 1.80 unitedstates dollars per ounce to 292.30 unitedstates dollars.  preliminary turnover figures showed 305 million shares traded at a value of 549.87 million unitedstates dollars with 512 falls, 423 rises and 376 steady.

title: more u.s. public schools connected with internet
body: a nationwide survey conducted during the 1997-98 school year found that the number of public schools in the unitedstates providing key technologies continues to rise.  eighty-five percent of all public schools in the country have internet access, up 21 percent over the prior year, according to market data retrieval (mdr), a technology research firm specializing in analysis about the education market. mdr's statistics were based on a survey of 33,000 public schools.  the survey also shows that connectivity within and among schools has also significantly improved. over 75 percent of schools reported using a local area network (lan) and 44 percent reported access on wide area networks (wans).  the number of computers for instructional use during the past five years more than doubled, from 3.6 million units in 1992-93 to today's total of 7.4 million. an addition of 560,000 computers were used by administrators.  mdr said that the great growth in terms of location of internet access occurred in classrooms and administrative offices. schools have begun to provide internet access throughout their buildings. as a result, more than half of the schools now provide internet access in classrooms and administrative offices. earlier reports estimated that 27 percent of classrooms had internet access in 1997.  classroom access to the internet, however, has been a controversial issue in the unitedstates. a california-based nonprofit organization, learning in the real world, said this week educators and parents are now finding disturbing data casting doubt on the assumption that computers play a valuable role in early primary grades.  and there is the problem of how to use classroom computers. a survey published by education week magazine in september concluded that what matters most are not computers, but what teachers and students do with them. while classroom computers can boost student test score if used properly, they can also have opposite effect if they are in the hands of untrained teachers.  according to the mdr survey, there are an estimated 3.1 million teachers in the unitedstates today, most of whom learned about computers on the job. about 23 percent of the schools reported that almost all their teachers used computers on a daily basis for instructional planning or teaching. but an equal number reported that none of their teachers used computers daily.

title: australian stocks close marginally higher
body: media tycoon rupert murdoch's news corp. reined in the australian share market thursday ensuring it only ended marginally higher despite a strong run by four major stocks.  the all ordinaries index closed the day 2.2 points, or 0.9 percent, higher at 2,545.2.  "there's mixed moves in the market if you look at the strength in (australia's leading mining company) bhp, national bank (of australia), the commonwealth bank (of australia), telstra, but it has all been offset by the downward move in news corp.," shaw stockbroking dealer jamie spiteri said.  news corp. ended the day down 62.9 cents, or 6.08 percent, at 9.71 australian dollars, its preferred shares lost 56.4 cents, or 6.15 percent, at 8.60 australian dollars.  dealers said the stock succumbed to profit-taking after it jumped sharply on news that its fox entertainment group inc. could raise about 1.8 billion unitedstates dollars in its initial public offer.  on the whole, the market remained fairly cautious and "is probably going to trade on a conservative manner in comparison to overseas markets as has been the case," spiteri said.  the banking sector received strong investor support thursday, boosting the index 59.1 points, or 1.10 percent, to 5,428 points.  national australia bank added 48.3 cents to 20.20 australian dollars, commonwealth bank of australia gained 17 cents to 19.13 australian dollars, anz bank jumped 1.5 cents to 8.95 australian dollars while westpac bank slipped five cents to 9.45 australian dollars.  in the resource sector, bhp stacked on 18.4 cents to 12.99 australian dollars after rumors that duke energy chief executive paul anderson may take up the helm at the diversified miner.  global miner rio tinto added 11 cents to 20.42 australian dollars.  the gold index slipped 1.2 points to 1,138.8, while the price of gold bullion in sydney closed down at 294.25 unitedstates dollars an ounce compared to wednesday's close of 297.10 unitedstates dollars an ounce.  national turnover ended the day with 295.36 million stocks traded for 459.79 million australian dollars (287 million unitedstates dollars), with falling stocks outnumbering rising stocks 491 to 479, while 365 stocks remained steady.

title: australian stocks end higher on asian stocks gains
body: the australian share market closed higher wednesday as strong asian markets underpinned gains in local stocks.  the benchmark all ordinaries index closed 26.1 points higher at 2,543.0, receiving an early kick along from a stronger wall street overnight and powerful regional markets supported that move later in the local session.  lucinda chan from macquarie equities said the market closed at its highest point for the day with some short covering in afternoon trade.  "it's been pretty lackluster," said chan, adding that there had been little to drive the market wednesday.  rather, it had been underpinned by solid fundamentals such as the stable domestic currency, she said.  on australian equities markets, the all resources index firmed 8.6 points to 1,038.2, while the all industrials index jumped 47.4 points to 4,420.2.  chan said news corp. was one of the notable strong stocks wednesday, rising after the media group's fox entertainment group inc. in the unitedstates projected a price range of 21 to 24 unitedstates dollars for shares in its planned initial public offering.  news corp.'s shares gained 73.9 cents, while its preferred scrip added 74.3 cents.  the banking sector was also strong, gaining 33.8 points to close at 5,368.9. national australia bank added 1.7 cents, westpac rose 25 cents, anz gained eight cents while the commonwealth bank bucked the trend to drop 22 cents.  in the resource sector, bhp added 24 cents, rio tinto added three, wmc gained 4.4 cents and mim dropped one cent.  the gold index improved 3.7 points to 1,140.0, the price of gold bullion in sydney closed at 297.10 unitedstates dollars an ounce, compared to tuesday's close of 296.25.  national turnover was 361.98 million stocks traded for 1.006 billion australian dollars (626.73 million unitedstates dollars), with rising stocks outnumbering falling stocks 500 to 466, while 375 stocks remained steady.

title: discounts attract american online shoppers
body: discounted pricing is the most important way to make the american online shoppers become online buyers, according to a study released on tuesday.  the study found that those who have access to the internet but yet to make purchases online are still hesitant to initiate transaction, citing price, not payment security, as a primary concern.  they were less likely to make an initial purchase soon. one of the main reasons for the reluctance is the barrier of price. most of them said that greater discounts online will spark buying behavior, said the study, which was based on an extensive set of consumer surveys.  the study was jointly conducted by jupiter communications, a new media research firm, and nfo worldwide, a provider of customer and syndicated marketing information services.  a significant 35 percent of the 60 million unitedstates online population did purchase a product or service in the last year and were satisfied with their shopping experience, the study said.  however, it went to say that although lowering prices may help many transact online, it should not be the only outcome that online marketers depend on. consumers are increasingly relying on online information sources to drive their off-line purchases.

title: s. african firm aims at no.1 internet provider
body: south africa's leading cellular network operator vodacom tuesday launched its 53-million-unitedstates dollar internet service, which allowc internet access through prepaid vouchers.  vodacom, one of south africa's two dominating cellular network providers, said it planned to be the country's largest internet service provider in just two months, business day rfported wednesday.  but becoming a significant player by christmas is a tall order, considering the 150 registered internet service providers and an estimated 750,000 internet users in the country, the report said.  the aggressive deadline gives vodacom 10 weeks to outsell south africa's largest access providers, uunet internet africa, with 80,000 dial-up users, and mweb, with 58,000 dial-up clients.  vodacom said it was not worried by the cenge, as it did not see a very competitive market in the internet field.  vodacom chief executive officer alan knott-craig said there were still about 4.3 million users to be signed up for internet access across the coubtry, and vodacom's newly-launched yebonet wanted the lion's share.  vodacom will offer prepaid internet access using its cellular phone vouchers, which were already available from retail outlets across the country.  voda?om said yebonet would target consumers aged between 16 and 25 and the main source of news on the website was from south africa's leading newspaper group, the independent group.  however, some of south africa's major internet service providers said vodacom was being extremely optimistic. they doubted a new player like vodacom would dominate the market in a few months, as the subscriber base was pretty well entrenched.

title: market for information appliances to increase
body: the global market for information appliances is "on the verge of explosive growth," said a unitedstates market analysis firm.  the market is expected to climb from three million units in 1997 and nearly six million this year to an overwhelming 55.7 million in 2002 worldwide, registering a 76 percent annual growth rate between 1998 and 2002, according to a report by the international data corporation (idc).  information appliances are household or office devices that can be plugged into common public or private networks.  in late 1998, the industry has begun to coalesce around key platforms and specific solution partnership initiatives. on the down side are network computers and screenphones. but the lion's share of the information appliance momentum has moved toward internet tv, gaming devices and smart handhelds, according to the report.  internet smart handheld devices show the greatest promise for deployment on an absolute unit shipment basis. however, idc said, these products primarily lie in the corporate domain, with many purchased directly by corporate funds. as a result, these handhelds will drop out of the top ranking and get closer to the bottom of unit shipments for consumer-used items.  internet gaming devices also have great potential, with the growth accelerating from 848,000 units in 1998 to almost 15 million in 2002.  internet tvs represent a hot bed of innovation, the report said. they will quickly become the next largest category of information appliances, generating 1.4 million units in 1998, 4.3 million in 1999 and over 11 million units at the turn of the millennium. at present, internet tv services use a set-top box that connects the tv to a modem and telephone.

title: internet changing chinese people's life
body: chen lei, a middle school student in a remote part of beijing's suburbs, sent a bit of information over the internet a month ago, and some 4,000 tourists have visited her small village since then.  the information super-highway has made the world a smaller place, and an increasing number of chinese have become aware of the importance of the internet.  china's first email called "crossing the great wall to the world", was sent over a local network, the china computer technology net, to a german university net and finally to the international science net in september 1987.  seven years later, china got connected to the internet, and as computer and network technology develop, the number of chinese internet users increases. at the beginning of this year, china had 670,000 users, and by the end of this june the number had grown to 1.17 million, according to the china internet information center.  "the internet has become part of my life, and i can't imagine living without it," says he ping, a 31-year-old senior staff member at a foreign-funded company in beijing.  young people enjoy the internet most. a recent survey shows that 84 percent of the chinese internet users are below the age of 35. about 69 percent of them spend one to ten hours on the internet every week, and 20 percent spend more than 10 hours. china has 542,000 computers connected with the internet.  there are 45 media organizations in china that are connected with the internet, like people's daily, the xinhua news agency, china daily, and china central television station.  beijing, guangdong and shanghai lead the country in the number of internet users, according to official figures.  local governments of 17 provinces, municipalities and ethnic autonomous regions have also been providing local information to the outside world via the net.

title: u.s. nonprofit group awards researchers on education technology
body: a california-based nonprofit group announced monday its 1998-99 research grants which are being awarded to four universities to help answer the growing questions around education technology.  learning in the real world (lrw) said that last spring it invited research proposals investigating the correlation between children's use of computers and effects of this use on their academic achievement and their social-emotional development.  the research grants will go to researchers at central michigan university, stanford university, university of california at santa barbara and university of pittsburgh.  "education technology will cost taxpayers up to 100 billion dollars in up-front costs and 33 billion dollars per year after that," lrw said. "right now only one tenth of one percent of the education technology budget is going to research to see if it really works." lrw hopes that its research grants, 56,000 dollars this year, would serve to encourage bigger foundations for objective research before billions of dollars are wasted.  as computers have become more important in professions and the workplace, many americans have assumed they should become equally important in the classroom. but lrw said that educators and parents are now finding disturbing data which cast doubt on the assumption that computers play a valuable role in early primary grades.  in 1994, 35 percent of schools in the unitedstates and three percent of classrooms had internet access. but 1997, the proportions grew to 78 percent and 27 percent, respectively, according to an education week report earlier this year.  sharing the concerns expressed by lrw, an author, thomas sherman, wrote in education week that every technology bringing benefits also carries a monetary and social price. "it is unfortunate that we have yet to examine seriously the price associated with internet access," he said.  "at this point, it appears that there may be some risk to the intellectual and emotional development of young children if they spend considerable time surfing the web," sherman wrote. "at a minimum, it will be wise to study the impact of the web much more carefully before we completely immerse our children in this pervasive medium."

title: polling on-line bussiness being developed in china
body: internet technology china (itc) and beijing horizon research today announced a joint effort to develop the on-line polling business in china.  this would mean a new era in polling in china and the rapid development of the internet has huge market potential.  charles zhang, 33, ceo and president of itc, has been recently named one of time's "top fifty digerati." he says that on-line polling is characterized by high speed, reduced research intervention, better accuracy and low cost.  sohoo, china's most popular internet destination, which was developed by itc, has opened 14 web-based user surveys that profile the habits, opinions, and trends of the internet users in china, according to sally shi, marketing manager of itc.  "the internet provides a perfect platform for highly-targeted market analysis and sohoo, with a total of approximately two million user sessions a month, provides the perfect subject pool for such research," she said.  she said that, since june 29, 1998, sohoo has had a series of online user surveys covering everything from divorce policies to internet trends and reactions.  china has now 1.5 million registered internet users, with the number estimated to reach 5 million by the year 2000.

title: uk creates world's first virtual autopsy on internet
body: students and staff at leicester university, central england, have created the world's first virtual reality autopsy website. the pioneering development allows medical students to conduct a virtual post-mortem with the mouse in place of the pathologist's knife, according to a press release from the university. the final design is based around seven autopsy files with basic details extracted from departmental records. the images were obtained from a wide variety of sources and do not come from the original autopsies. the website, http://www.le.ac.uk/pathology/teach/va, is being hailed as a breakthrough in computer-assisted learning for medical students. "as the hospital autopsy rate has dwindled, the exposure of medical undergraduates to the post mortems as a valuable teaching aid has diminished." said dr kevin west, a senior lecturer in pathology from the university. "however, it is possible to use autopsy files to facilitate learning without the traditional post-mortem demonstration and modern information technology allows access to such material," he said. dr west added that because the site has open access, whole body images are not included and thus the voyeur is discouraged. students are presented with a clinical history and may then view the autopsy findings by clicking on the appropriate system on a body outline. there are opportunities to review aspects of the underlying basic medical science and at any stage the student may propose the cause of death. if the answer is wrong, further advice is offered.

title: australian stocks close lower on japanese stocks
body: the australian share market tuesday took little heed of buoyant unitedstates and european markets overnight, closing half a percent lower after taking its lead from japan, brokers said.  the benchmark all ordinaries index closed 13.1 points weaker at 2,488.5 after reaching a high of 2,517.9 earlier in the day.  henderson charlton jones client adviser brett o'donovan said the australian bourse had a very disappointing day considering the strong showing on overseas markets overnight monday.  in new york, the dow jones industrial average closed up 101.95 points at 8,001.47, after being up more than 170 points at one stage.  "we were led lower by the japanese market. it had a big impact on us," o'donovan said.  the nikkei 225 in japan closed down 312.22 points at 13,242.79, down 2.3 percent and off a low of 13,241.20 points on the back of investor caution over a government plan to inject additional funds into banks' capital, brokers said.  on australian equities markets, the all industrials index shed 20.1 points to 4,324.9 and the all resources index offloaded 8.1 to 1,016.5.  the national australia bank was the only major bank to buck the negative trend, firming 3.6 cents, the anz slumped 29 cents, with analysts saying it was likely someone was using the current low share price to build up a strategic stake in the bank.  the commonwealth bank shed 16, westpac eased three.  news corp. fell from a high of 9.38 australian dollars to 9.17 following its annual general meeting in adelaide.  news corp. chairman and chief executive rupert murdoch said tuesday that no significant acquisitions were planned as the company braced itself for a significant downturn in world markets.  telstra topped the turnover table with 22.15 million installment receipts traded as the stock slid 9.6 cents to 4.43 australian dollars.  in the resource sector, bhp fell 12 cents, wmc eased three and rio tinto firmed four.  the gold index retreated 37.5 points to 1,175.1, with the gold price in sydney tuesday afternoon closing at 296.75 unitedstates dollars an ounce, compared to a close of 296.65 monday.  national turnover was 287.21 million shares traded for 867.44 million australian dollars (546.48 million unitedstates dollars) with falling stocks outnumbering rising stocks 629 to 447, while 377 stocks remained steady.

title: media baron warns of global economic crisis
body: media baron rupert murdoch tuesday warned that the world was facing global economic crisis and there was little governments could do about it.  murdoch, chairman and chief executive of the global media group news corp. ltd., repeatedly said at the company's annual general meeting in australia tuesday that the world could be slipping into a period of deflation or recession.  "everybody is worried about the possibility of it," murdoch said when asked about the possibility of the world slipping into recession in adelaide, a coastal city in south australia.  he was quoted by the australian broadcasting corporation radio as saying the big question globally was how much governments would be able to do in such an economic climate.  "i think it's interesting around the world, the big question is just how much governments will be able to do as against how much central bankers will be able to do or how much markets will just go past all those forces," murdoch said.  "we are in a new paradigm today altogether and governments can maybe soften the effects of violent movement in the markets, but not much else," he said.  murdoch has substantial stakes in printed and electronic media in the unitedstates, britain, australia and hongkong.  the success of the film the titanic helped boost the news corp.  profits to 1.68 billion australian dollars (one billion unitedstates dollars) for the past financial year ending june 30, 1998, with the film reaping 1.8 billion unitedstates dollars at the box office.

title: u.s. venture capital investments in internet hit record
body: silicon valley remains the no. 1 attraction for unitedstates venture capital, receiving over half of internet investments during the second quarter of 1998.  unitedstates venture capital investments in internet-related companies hit a record 887 million dollars in 164 companies in the quarter, up 42 percent over the period a year ago, according to a new survey announced tuesday by pricewaterhousecoopers (pwc), one of the world's largest professional services organizations. the survey covered 500 venture capital firms in the unitedstates.  silicon valley companies received 55 percent of the money, with 487 million dollars invested in 97 deals. new england was next with 218 million dollars.  the survey found that size of the deals continued to grow.  during the first half of this year, the top ten internet-related venture capital investments each surpassed 20 million dollars, as an increasing number of investments shifted from early stage companies to expansion and later stage companies.  a total of 1.35 billion dollars were invested in the first half of the year.  the majority of internet investments were made in early and expansion stage companies during the second quarter. but the investments in early stage companies declined from 48 percent in 1997 to 37 percent in the first half of 1998.  in addition, internet companies specializing in services accounted for the largest share of the investments in the first six months of this year, with 455 million dollars or 34 percent of the total. next came software, 31 percent, and access/infrastructure, 29 percent. pwc said that investments in internet service companies should continue to increase as more businesses begin to take advantage of the explosion in e-commerce.

title: acquisition creates largest online business association in u.s.
body: a leading unitedstates direct marketer has acquired an online business organization, creating the world's largest trade association for business on the internet.  the 81-year-old direct marketing association (dma) announced monday the acquisition of the association for interactive media (aim), founded in 1993, during the ongoing dma 81st annual conference in san francisco.  "this acquisition is a sign of the times --a snapshot of what's going on in the business world today," dma president and ceo h. robert wientzen said in a statement. "many mainstream, stable and traditional businesses are merging with younger, entrepreneurial start-ups on the verge of success. each side needs the other to move e-commerce into a successful future." dma's members include more than 4,100 businesses in interactive and database marketing from the unitedstates and 53 other nations, while aim's 250 members only do business online.  according to aim president andy sernovitgz, the acquisition is about sharing intellectual capital. direct marketers have the marketing know-how and the new media architects have the technological know-how. businesses using the internet must marry the new interactive nature of the net with traditional marketing tools to fulfil the promises made to consumers, he said in a statement.  dma was founded in 1917. its members include catalogers, internet retailers and service providers, financial services providers, book and magazine publishers, book and music clubs, retail stores and industrial manufacturers. in 1997, 705 billion unitedstates dollars in direct marketing purchases were made by consumers and 554 billion dollars were made by businesses in the unitedstates, according to dma.  business-to-business direct marketing has recorded phenomenal growth over the the past five years in the unitedstates, dma said. companies are increasingly utilizing direct mail, print, tv and interactive advertising, in addition to the standard industry practice of outbound telemarketing, to attract buyers for the corporate market.  after the acquisition, aim, headquartered in washington, d.c., will operate as a subsidiary of the new york-based dma. the organization has experience in promoting consumer confidence in e-commerce and providing business-to-business networking.

title: news corp rise pushes australian stocks higher
body: australian shares shrugged off firmer japanese and hongkong markets monday to close only marginally higher, boosted by a 6-percent jump in news corp shares.  the all ordinaries index finished 10.3 points firmer at 2,501.6, with news corp's rise the standout.  the global media group's shares had gone into a tailspin over the past two weeks, with a decision to pull back on the extent of its fox float seen as one of the leading factors behind the selling.  the fortnight's fall saw the ordinary shares go from 11.20 australian dollars to 8.64 before bouncing back 54.7 cents to 9.19 -in line with its trade in new york on friday -as buyers took advantage of the nine-month low. news corp preferred shares added 46 cents at 8.11 australian dollars.  the rise in news corp shares was linked to the better performance of the unitedstates stock market on friday. the dow jones industrial average on friday rose 167.61 to 7,899.52, a gain of 114.83 points for the week.  elsewhere in the market, non-institutional interest remained tepid as global economic uncertainty lingered and the historical fear of october financial markets contributed to the ill-will.  in japan, the nikkei index jumped 5 percent on the back of new proposals to prop up the nation's banking system.  in hongkong, the key hang seng index closed up 483.48 points at 8,990.27, with late profit-taking eroding earlier even more substantial gains.  locally, the all industrials index was up 22.2 points to 4,345.0.  national australia bank, seen as a potential acquirer of competitors, fell 38.3 cents. the other major banks were higher, anz up five cents, westpac was 11 cents better while commonwealth finished 16 cents firmer.  telecommunications major telstra dropped 12.4 cents as uncertainty remained over how much of the company would be privatized, while final payment of installment receipts was due in a little over a month.  the all resources index was unchanged at 1,024.6 points.  bhp was up 14 cents. it is expected that the company could be close to announcing a new chief executive.  the gold index fell 38.4 points to 1,212.6 as the bullion price lost 1.80 unitedstates dollars per ounce to 297.30.  turnover was 275.24 million shares at a value of 946.80 million australian dollars (587.02 million unitedstates dollars), with 544 falls, 494 rises and 388 steady.

title: net tvs to edge out pcs in american homes
body: it has been the dream of bill gates to have the pc on every desk in the unitedstates, but that's not going to happen, according to a new study released this week.  inteco, a unitedstates market researcher focusing on consumers' prosperity to adopt new technologies, said that the future of home computing does not lie in expensive multimedia computers, but more likely in some type of internet tv.  inteco's study shows that by 2003, set-top boxes will be able to provide limited internet access for a fraction of the cost of a pc, leaving american consumers with less of a reason to invest in a pricey desktop or notebook system.  although the number of american households with pcs will grow from 45.1 million in 1998 to 54.7 million in 2003, most of that growth is derived from households with more than one computer, not new users, according to inteco.  the actual number of american households with pcs will only grow from 44.8 million in 1998 to 52.7 million in 2003. this presents a problem for the pc industry, inteco said, because dwindling prices and profit margins need to be offset by high volumes.  about 30 percent of american households do not own a pc and have no interest in purchasing a computer, the study found, because they still see no crucial use for a home computer.  part of the problem is that the pc industry has not yet provided a compelling application for high-end pcs, said inteco, adding that "the pc industry can try and bring back the high-end pc, but there isn't any new application that is driving the specs higher." instead, limited local news, sports and weather information via cable television or set-top box will likely captivate both pc and non-pc households alike, inteco said.  as many american households own more than one pc, home computing could be stimulative for new chip making. recent surveys have shown that sharing internet communications and printers are two critical needs for home computer users in the unitedstates.  to meet the needs, the silicon valley-based lucent technologies has released a new chip family that will allowing home users to share printers, files and internet access.

title: 10,000 people surf internet in hainan province
body: some 10,000 people are now surfing the internet in hainan province, accounting for 0.14 percent of the province's population, a proportion higher than the country's average.  considering that 80 percent of the province's people are rural residents, and that some 5 or 6 years ago, local people had to stand in line to make long-distance phone calls, their access to the internet now is incredible, said a local government official.  haikou, the provincial capital of hainan province, opened its first chinanet port in 1996, and now has 19 cities and counties with internet access. users all over the province are now able to get online through local direct-dialing networks.  internet fans in the province have established clubs which is drawing the attention of people from all walks of life, including the vice-president of the province wang houhong, who is said to be an internet fan.  local sources said that public information, tourism and agricultural information websites are all under construction.  since last year, local economic departments have been displaying their investment projects on the internet, while the government has also been publishing official statistics and information regularly on the 'net.

title: australian stocks fall by nearly one percent
body: falls in major stocks, particularly global media giant news corp, pushed the australian sharemarket almost one percent lower tuesday.  the all ordinaries index finished 24.5 points lower to 2491.2, its lowest close since september 11.  "concerns on overseas markets are still lingering and to the extent that further falls are there, we will fall into line with them," jack moss from shaw stockbroking said.  "some of the blue-chips got into all sorts of trouble today but this market could turn around very very quickly," he said.  the all industrials index closed 51.8 points down at 4338.9.  the news corp fell 63.2 cents to 9.40 australian dollars on a turnover of 4.26 million shares while the preferred shares were 44 cents lower at 8.14 australian dollars.  the company's exposure to the british economy and a decision to float just 13 percent of its fox assets rather than the previously mooted amount of up to 20 percent were seen as explanations for the fall.  among australia's major banks, westpac's 21 cent fall to 8.80 australian dollars and national australia bank's 37 cent drop to 19.07 australian dollars were the major moves.  anz bank was seven cents lower at 8.58 australian dollars on a turnover of 5.6 million shares while commonwealth added 2.5 cents to 18.52 australian dollars.  the all resources index was down just 0.8 points to 1008.1 as a strong rise in resources giant bhp offset the gold sector's reversal of fortune.  bhp jumped 28 cents to 11.98 australian dollars on a view it had been oversold of late, and the rise again prompted thought the company had found a new chief after a search of more than six months.  the gold index dropped 37.6 points to 1207.0, losing more than three quarters of monday's rise, as the spot bullion price fell 3.30 unitedstates dollars per ounce to 296.40 unitedstates dollars.  turnover was 272.77 million shares traded at a value of 557.54 million unitedstates dollars, with 637 falls, 457 rises and 324 steady.

title: mexican internet users to double by
body: mexico will have two million internet users by the end of 1999, coupled with a growth in electronic commerce and a great potential need for internet-related professionals.  given the fact that one million people are connected to the internet in mexico now, the number will grow five-fold by the year 2003, said eduardo adame goddard, chief executive officer (ceo) of the tecnofin company, citing market studies.  in an interview with the state news agency notimex, adame said that there is "an enormous potential" for internet expansion and there will be a great need for highly qualified professionals.  he predicted that trade through the internet will result in a change in labor structure. for instance, he noted, stores connected with the internet need less sellers and more stage coach services.  he said that currently there are some 300 companies in mexico that have links or promotion programs with the internet, and new web sites offering products and services appear everyday.  he said, however, that the number of jobs created by the internet is still unknown.  with the dynamic expansion of the internet, adame said that there will be readjustments in labor market soon just as in other sectors around the world.  mexican entrepreneurs will face major challenges because foreign products are advertised through the internet, he said.

title: sub-saharan africa marginalized from telecom revolution: report
body: the world development report 1998/99" issued by the world bank monday indicated that sub-saharan africa (ssa) has generally been marginalized from the telecommunication revolution.  in 1996, ssa had about 1.46 million working phone lines serving a population of about 575 million, excluding south africa (with four million lines), said the report.  however, the annual report noted that there has been a gradual wave of reform in telecommunication in the ssa over the past five years.  approximately 75 percent telephone lines in ssa are "private'' today, though the bulk of these are in south africa.  the report said ten countries, including ghana, senegal, uganda, guinea, cote d'ivoire and south africa have privatized national operators and 15 more countries, including madagascar, cameroon, tanzania and malawi, intend to do so.  since 1996, the proceeds of privatization amount to approximately 1.7 billion unitedstates dollars with roll-out obligations by companies of 3.8 million lines (4-6 billion unitedstates dollars).  investment costs have decreased from 5,000 to 1,000 dollars per line.  there has also been increasing choice with regard to equipment, interconnection and international transmission capacity.  the cellular market, almost completely private, comprises about 20 percent of the market.  though the internet is growing quickly, access remains limited, the report added, saying the opportunities for the private sector during this liberalization phase are substantial, especially with regard to cellular telephones, paging, voicemail and the internet.  according to the report, new communications technologies (especially wireless and satellite) could accelerate ssa's economic growth and poverty alleviation.  timely access to local and international agricultural commodity price information, for instance, could spur increased production and marketing by rural farmers.  in telecommunications alone, investment totaling at least six to eight billion dollars would be required in ssa (excluding south africa) over the next four years to add an additional 4.5 million lines so as to achieve a minimum teledensity of one percent (one line per 100 inhabitants) by 2001.  the world bank has been assisting in telecommunication development in about 25 countries in ssa and is attempting to establish clear links between its assistance to the sector and poverty reduction.  these initiatives include the african virtual university (avu), economic toolkit and workshops for internet connectivity in africa, the rural telecommunications field trial and commercialization pilot in kenya, and the global connectivity in africa conference, according to the report.

title: israeli internet market to reach 1 billion u.s. dollars by year
body: the internet market in israel is expected to reach 1 billion unitedstates dollars by the year 2002, local daily haaretz said on thursday.  the report quoted a new market survey carried out by international documentation center's israel branch as saying that the number of internet users in israel will also increase 30 percent a year on average.  the survey said that during 1998 some 360,000 people in israel have used the internet and the volume of the internet market in israel will reach 300 million dollars this year.  meanwhile, the survey showed that the largest market segment in the israeli internet market is the access to the net --linkage services provided by internet suppliers.  it assessed that the total value of access services in 1998 will be at 115 million dollars.  it also predicted that revenues from access services would grow at faster rates in israel than revenues from any other internet-related segment.  at a growth rate of 45 percent a year, the access services segment will reach 350 million dollars a year by the year 2002.  the survey found that other fast-growing segments include site storage services, telephony and video products for the internet, and intranet-extranet establishment services.

title: tianjin's farmers earn money from internet
body: he jijin, a farmer in the beichen district of north china's tianjin municipality, is very grateful to the internet for helping him improve his chicken farm and bring in much larger orders.  he and his family are now running the largest chicken-breeding farm in north china. in the past, he sold about 2 million chicks annually, but this year he has already received orders for 3 million chicks, simply because he is now on-line with the internet.  using the internet, he is able to follow and analyze the market and publicize his chicken farm. he has learned from the internet that there were great opportunities in the romanian egg market, so he is now preparing to set up chicken farms abroad.  he jijin's case is not unusual in the beichen district, as the people there have established a science and technology information center affiliated with 12 other towns, which has helped heighten the local farmers' awareness of the importance of information.  many farmers are now eager to get on-line in beichen. some farmers, though not well educated themselves, ask their children to learn about computers so they can link on to the internet.  liu xushu, a farmer in beichen's xiditou village, said, " on the internet, i have brighter eyes and sharper ears."

title: new survey reveals working women's desire for technology
body: most working women worldwide are concerned about not getting access to the right technology to assist in the future growth of their companies, according to a new study released today.  out of a group of women business owners surveyed at two international conferences, 83 percent said they already use computers at work, but 79 percent expressed concern that they were not getting adequate access to information about new technologies that could help expand their businesses.  the research was sponsored by ibm and conducted by the national foundation for women business owners (nfwbo) of the unitedstates.  responses from women from countries as diverse as argentina, canada, ethiopia, finland, ireland, italy, mexico, senegal, uganda and the unitedstates were included in the study, which was conducted over the past two years.  most of the women said computers constitute an important aspect of their business today, and they consider new developments in technology as key to their companies' future growth, the study said. small business owners, in particular, feel technology can help them expand internationally.  in canada, 100 percent of those women polled said that they used computers, as compared with 95 percent in argentina, 93 percent in the unitedstates, and 60 percent in finland, according to individual studies done in these countries.  in each country surveyed, more than two-thirds of the women entrepreneurs said that learning about new technology was "very important" or "extremely important," according to the study. in argentina, 80 percent of the women surveyed made such an assessment, compared with 69 percent in canada and 62 percent in ireland, for example.  however, since most women have had little formal training in the use of computers, it comes as no surprise that they feel distanced from new developments in technology, said ibm in a statement. only three percent of those enrolled in technology career-training programs around the world are women, the company said. ibm plans to work with women business owners globally to understand their needs in order to market products specifically to their needs.  according to the nfwbo, women-owned businesses generate revenues of 2.3 trillion unitedstates dollars annualy in the unitedstates alone, and account for one-quarter of overall business in the economy worldwide.  the internet is a popular technology tool for many of today's business women, but usage rates varied widely, according to the study. eighty-five percent of women business owners in canada use the internet for work, while only 50 percent do so in ireland and 37 percent in argentina. overall, 51 percent of the women surveyed at the two international conferences use the internet on a regular basis.  also based on the two conference surveys, 26 percent of women entrepreneurs have business home pages on the internet. forty-one of women entrepreneurs in canada and 23 percent of their american counterpart have home pages.

title: china's innovative internet technology
body: china has developed new technology that it says will greatly improve quality and reliability and cut cost of internet services that use telecommunications networks.  chinese told the study group 7 meeting of the international telecommunications union's standardization department in beijing about using an optical cable network.  herb bertine, chairman of the study group 7, said that he is surprised to see that china has been developing this technology and equipment and that the technology is unique.  it combines the advantages of ppp and atm technology that is now widely used to connect the internet with telecommunications networks, with a performance to cost ratio many times higher than that of existing technology. the wuhan academy of post and telecommunications is developing the technology and equipment. the academy's yu shaohu says that since china has the largest optical cable network in the world, the technology will greatly expand internet use here.  china now has 120 million telephone lines. the figure is expected to be 180 million by 2000. and, there are more than a million internet users in china.  yu said that if the technology gets itu approval, it will create a new telecommunications technology and equipment market.

title: hke092444 --4 malaysians charged for spreading rumors on internet
body: four malaysians, including a woman, were charged thursday in four magistrate's courts here and in petaling jaya near here for circulating rumors on the internet about alleged riots in the city in early august, malaysia's national news agency bernama reported.  this is the first case of its kind in malaysia. the charged are au yong way, 27, a bank officer; lee chun meng, 40, a construction site supervisor; wong yoon sing, 37, a finance manager; and tan lai yee, 25, a computer firm logistics trainee.  they pleaded not guilty under section 505 (b) of the penal code which carries a maximum two years' jail or fine, or both, on conviction.  au, who is alleged to have committed the offense on august 3 this year, was allowed bail of 2,000 ringgit (526 unitedstates dollars) in one surety pending trial on november 11.  lee, charged with committing the offense on july 30, was allowed the same amount of bail pending trial on may 20 next year.  wong who was said to commit the offense on august 8 was allowed bail of 6,000 ringgit (1,578 unitedstates dollars) in one surety pending trial on october 22.  and tan charged with committing the offense at her workplace on august 3 was allowed bail of 5,000 ringgit (1,315 unitedstates dollars) in one surety pending trial on december 15.

title: map information on hk available to tourists on internet
body: tourists wishing to visit hongkong can now plan their trip beforehand by accessing the latest information on hotels, restaurants, shopping and sightseeing on the internet via the computerized map inquiry system for tourists (cmest).  developed by the survey and mapping office of the lands department of the hongkong special administrative region (sar) and funded by the hongkong jockey club charities trust, the system was handed over to the hongkong tourist association thursday.  speaking at a handover ceremony thursday morning, robert pope, director of lands of the sar, said the system employed advanced internet map technology to publish updated information on tourist attractions.  apart from the internet, the system can also be accessed from display kiosks at the tourist information center of the hongkong tourist association and the kowloon map publication center of the lands department.  "more display kiosks connected to the system will be installed in the coming months at the new airport and other convenient locations. the system will therefore be available to local residents as well," said pope.  "as the system links up with the 'city of life' web site of the hongkong tourist association and the access to the system is free, prospective tourists can plan their sightseeing route as well as check the room rate and reservation information via the internet before arriving in hongkong," he added.

title: red cross internet appeal for donations for china
body: the red cross society of china (rcsc) and the bank of china have opened a site on the internet to solicit donations for flood victims. donations will go into a special account in the bank of china that will be used to help prevent epidemic diseases and build new houses for people in flooded areas, according to wang lizhong, rcsc's vice-president. he says that the chinese red cross society will try to use the donations in accordance with donors' requests on the internet and will tell people how the disaster relief is used in the same way. david aaron, a senior american commerce department official who was at the opening ceremony for the website in beijing today, said that it will allow people from around the world to make donations via the internet to help chinese in flood-hit areas. vast areas along the yangtze, nenjiang, and songhua rivers were hit by floods this summer, with losses estimated at more than 160 billion yuan (19.2 billion unitedstates dollars). provincial branches of the rcsc have raised 180 million yuan worth of cash and material donations for the disaster relief. the internet addresses are http:// www.dragonpulse.com; http://www.chineseredcross.org.cn; http://www.bank-of-china.com; http://www.cyberash.com; and http//://www.sparkice.com.cn. the activity, which is being sponsored by the american cybercash company and the unicom-sparkice info system engineering ltd, will close at the end of december.
