title: more americans do stock trading at home
body: a growing number of americans are doing their stock trading at home, all they use is a computer and a modem, according to a report of the new york post today.  a study by investment banking firm piper jaffrey found that online trading accounted for 17 percent of all volume from retail investors in 1997. in the first half of 1998, it grew to 20 percent. the piper jaffrey study estimates that online could account for 30 percent of retail volume by the end of the year, and 50 percent by the new millennium.  the low cost of online trading is what first attracted investors.  "when people move from traditional brokerage or phone execution of trades to online execution of trades, they do increase their trading," said alex goor, president of datek online, which allows customers to trade up to 5,000 shares of stock for just 9.99 unitedstates dollars.  "the costs are just so much lower that the investors feel they can move in and out of stocks quickly," goor said.  according to brokerage firms and the stock exchanges, the average individual investor conducts two transactions each month -typically one sell order and one buy order.  the average online brokerage customers conducts 4.5 transactions each month, the paper said.  some customers would do more trades a day.  more than 75 firms currently offering online trading, up from fewer than 20 just one year ago.  many of these firms are taking advantage of newly released technology to process trades of 1,000 stocks or more for less than 10 unitedstates dollars.  and many more providers of online trading are popping up every day.  people also uses the internet to search for information on which they base their trading decisions. there are hundreds of websites providing investment information.  they can also customize the site to track their favorite stocks.  meanwhile, it said, the securities and exchange commission is stepping up its oversight of the internet, in hopes of stopping stock promoters from pushing bad offerings on innocent investors.

title: newpaper groups battle for market
body: rupert murdoch's news corp is likely to be the model for emerging chinese newspaper groups, which are becoming increasingly market-oriented as competition in the mass media hots up, today's china daily reported.  china's first newspaper group, the guangzhou daily group, was founded in 1996. a further four groups --the nanfang daily, the yangcheng evening news, the economic daily and the guangming daily --were formed in may and june this year.  "formation of newspaper groups will enable the mass media to adapt better to the market-driven economy. our goal is to expand the influence of 'party' newspaper, and enhance their financial strength," said xu guangchun, deputy chief of the publicity deparment of the central committee of the communist party of china, at the opening ceremony for the economic daily and the guangming daily groups.  the five newspaper groups have all been registered as companies by the state industry and commerce administration, meaning they have independent rights to invest in or manage enterprises.  china now has 2,160 newspapers and 7,900 periodicals. the total annual circulation of newspapers in china is estimated at 26 billion copies a year.  information from the state press and publications administration said china will have eight to 10 newspaper groups by 2000.

title: lebanon's internet market grows rapidly
body: lebanon's internet market is growing rapidly, with the number of users jumping from 5,000 in 1996 jumping to 40,000 this year, a senior ministry official said friday.  al-minaim yousuf, general-director of the investment department of the posts and telecommunication ministry, said in a radio interview that lebanese internet subscribers represent half ox the total in all arab countries.  the revenues from the internet service have reached 1 million unitedstates dollars each month, the official added.  he attributed the rapid growth of the internet service to the ministry's effective policy to fully open the market to the private sector.  so far, there are a total of five commercial companies in lebanon providing internet service.  the official said that the ministry has hammered out a huge project to promote this modern technology across the country.  the state-run lebanese university has hooked up to the internet and other governmental institutions and departments are moving in this direction, yousuf said.  the internet node was first introduced to lebanon in 1993 by the privately-owned american university of beirut and on a commercial basis in september 1995 by data mangement company.  the early subscribers consisted mainly of students and professors, most of whom were lebanese from abroad already familiar with the on-line services.  but most of the subscribers currently belong to the corporate field, especially in economy, finance and industry.

title: thailand goes on-line to promote goods
body: the department of export promotion in thailand is staging trade exhibitions on the internet as a new way to publicize thai products to the world market, the bangkok post said thursday. according to the newspaper, gems and jewelry will be the first sector featured, with extensive previews of the bangkok gems and jewelry fair, scheduled for september 9-12. the department has invested 600,000 baht (15,000 unitedstates dollars) to develop the new web site: www.thaitradefair.com. director-general sanit vorapanya of the department said that more than 50 million people use the internet worldwide and that many have high purchasing power. meanwhile, the cost of organizing an on-line trade show, which would be available 24 hours a day, is much lower than for a live exhibition. sanit said thai exporters should improve their knowledge of information technology since the internet is becoming many consumers' primary source of information. the next sector to be featured on the site would be leather goods, he said. meanwhile, komson opassathavorn, president of the thai gem and jewellry traders association, applauded the project, saying all 400 members of the association have participated in the project. exporters might also develop their own site soon, he said. he expressed optimism about the effectiveness of the promotion, particularly in the unitedstates, thailand's largest market for gems and jewellry exports, since 70 percent of the world's internet users live in that country.

title: australian stocks rise marginally
body: early gains inspired by rises on unitedstates and japanese markets were tempered by late selling of shares of news corp. and bhp to leave australian shares only marginally higher friday.  the all ordinaries index rose 3.3 points to 2,704.6 off an early high of 2,735.2 points, with volumes unusually strong.  general sentiment was also seen improving as the japanese reform process began and overnight unitedstates wages numbers provided further indications of a strong growth, low inflation economy.  "there was a very positive reaction to the economic numbers that came out of the unitedstates market thursday night that allayed fears we may see an interest rate rise any time soon," hartley poynton broker ned shamay said.  the all industrials index rose 12.7 points to 4,777.8 with most leading stocks solid and some good gain among the mid-range companies.  insurance giant amp, which roared ahead this week prior to monday's inclusion in market indices, posted a more mild rise friday, closing 15.1 cents higher, on a volume of 13 million shares.  of the major banks, anz was the improver after missing out thursday, adding 17 cents, commonwealth bank rose 12.2 cents, national australia bank edged five cents lower and westpac dropped ten cents.  the all resources index finished 5.3 points lower at 1,027.2 despite a strong gold sector.  diversified giant bhp dropped 26.4 cents amid reports of offshore institutional selling.  of the other diversifieds north gained three cents, rio tinto was 13 cents lower and wmc finished steady at 4.94 australian dollars.  the gold index finished three points higher at 1,052.9 as the bullion price edged up from 289.60 unitedstates dollars per ounce to finish at 289.65.  turnover was 383.96 million shares traded at a value of 1.874 billion australian dollars (1.148 billion unitedstates dollars), with rises topping falls 599 to 441.

title: uk universities to pay for transatlantic internet traffic
body: students and academics in the uk will pay for the transatlantic internet traffic from midnight on friday.  the uk education and research networking association (ukerna), which runs janet, the uk's academic and research network, has announced that it will start collecting new charges for incoming traffic on transatlantic links from august 1.  according to an announcement from the ukerna, all universities, most colleges of higher education and most research council establishments who link to janet will pay two pence (0.033 unitedstates dollars) for every two megabytes received over transatlantic links.  traffic received between 01:00 and 06:00 each morning will be free from charging. other than that, all incoming transatlantic traffic, including that at weekends, will no longer be free.  because of the nature of the internet routing and janet's set up, not only incoming unitedstates data, traffic from some organizations within europe or even the uk is subject to charging if it is routed via the unitedstates.  the annual bill for institutions should average 15,000 pounds (24,489 unitedstates dollars), and the ukerna estimates that it can raise about two million pounds (3.3 million unitedstates dollars) in the current financial year.  janet's costs have risen in 10 years from 2.5 million pounds (4.1 million unitedstates dollars) to 20 million pounds (32.7 million unitedstates dollars) with traffic increasing at between 200 to 300 percent annually.  "the funding council consider it no longer appropriate to provide central funds to provide 100 percent funding for what appears to be an unlimited demand for networking service," the ukerna said in the announcement.

title: chinese media on internet
body: the chinese media are increasing their presence on the internet in order to meet the challenges of the cyberspace age.  people's daily, the voice of the communist party of china, has two million hits on its web page every day.  "the internet has the advantages of speed, content and accessibility over newspapers, radio and tv. therefore we are not to be left outside the arena, " liao hong of the internet edition of the newspaper said.  according to statistics from the china internet information center (ciic), china has 127 newspapers that now have internet websites. chinese radio and tv stations have also put their programs on the 'net.  "the internet will be a major sources of revenue for our newspaper in the next century," a reporter from the guangzhou-based south china daily said.  the south china daily press group in guangdong province has put the content of all five of its daily newspapers and one magazine on the internet. in june, more than 400,000 people visited the website of the daily, which has a circulation of 800,000.  "as a local newspaper, we must use the internet to expand our readership," the reporter said.  china now has more than 3,000 newspapers competing for readers.  according to ciic statistics, the number of internet users in china exceeded one million at the end of june, 75 percent more than at the beginning of the year.  a journalist from the shanghai-based wenhui bao newspaper said that now chinese readers can choose among hundreds of newspapers published both in and out of china. he said that the chinese readers' demand for information on the internet has increased so fast that chinese newspapers have to improve their content and readability constantly.  though most chinese newspapers do not charge for access to their websites, some papers have begun to make money from the internet. china infoworld, one of the first chinese newspapers to enter cyberspace, is expected to even accounts through on-line advertisements.  zhang juanjuan, head of the electronic publication section of the newspaper, said they also provide economic information and book-selling services on the internet.  despite strict government regulations on the distribution of news on the internet, chinese media have received wide support for going on-line.  china telecom regards newspapers and other media as major sources of content, so that it offers free special lines for major newspapers and leases internet servers to news organizations.  some media experts say that as the number of internet users increases in china, demands for news and other information on the 'net will multiply. but they note that the internet will not replace other conventional media in the near future because cost of surfing the 'net is many times higher than the cost of a newspaper.

title: d t 1732 nc-hong kong-internet hka073012 --internet commerce show staged in hk
body: the only mega-show in hongkong dedicated to internet commerce, corporate intranet and networking was opened here thursday.  more than 60 exhibitors, twice as many as last year, from around the world were showcasing their wares at the show called netasia " internet commerce expo (ice) hongkong '98, which was organized by idg world expo (asia) and regent pacific.  addressing the opening ceremony of the event, gary fung, vice president of idg world expo (asia), said the internet is becoming not only a business tool but a strategic business tool to gain competitive advantages, be it in process automation, cost saving, market coverage or customer support.  the show is aimed to help hongkong businesses to explore, adopt and spread the use of the electronic commerce across industries, he noted.  eyeing the great number of small and medium-sized enterprises (smes) which are eager to use e-commerce in their operations, a pavilion called sme village was set up for cater for their needs.  other special themes included internet develop zone for internet developers, hongkong commercial web to showcase commercial web sites in hongkong, connecting point to allow visitors first-hand usage of electronic message and web surfing.  in tandem with the exhibition, a high-powered conference program was fixed with over 70 top executives and experts from the industry as speakers.  the three-day show expected an attendance of some 20,000, against 11,000 visiting last year's debut.

title: u.s. media, tech firms working to enhance tv programs
body: a group of unitedstates media and technology companies are working on a standard way to enhance tv programming with internet content.  in an announcement made tuesday, the companies, including microsoft, intel, disney and cnn, have formed an organization, called advanced television enhancement forum (atvef), for that purpose.  they will promote the use of standardized technology, allowing content providers to design interactive content for delivery through cable, satellite or digital tv platforms, the announcement said.  "enhanced television offers new entertainment and commerce opportunities, such as sports events with complementary information on players and teams, news with additional details and related stories, and advertisements that allow consumers to order merchandise with the click of a button," it added.  but there must be a standard way of linking tv content with web sites. without it, broadcasters essentially have to place a bet on the success of one type of receiver.  with a standard in place, content providers and distributors would be able to target delivery methods using a wider variety of business models such as various combinations of sponsorships, advertisement revenues and subscription-based services.  the atvef said it will work with other industry groups. the final version of the specification, which is currently open for public comment, is expected to be published in the fourth quarter this year.  tv receivers compliant with the atvef standards are expected to become available in the first half of 1999, it added.

title: australian shares tumble as tokyo's nikkei slides
body: a slide on the tokyo stock market monday pulled the australian bourse one percent lower, with major companies news corp, national australia bank and bhp losing ground.  the benchmark all ordinaries index ended 30.2 points softer at 2715.3 while the tokyo's nikkei index tumbled 417.53 points as investors remained nervous.  "we were watching tokyo and the yen today and that led us lower. news out of japan seems to be that the new prime minister is just more of the same," reynolds co's grant williams said.  the all industrials shed 51.8 points to 4774.8 and the all resources index lost 12.9 to 1052.2.  media stocks were particularly hard hit.  telstra, which topped the turnover table with 8.29 million shares traded, ended steady at 4.59 australian dollars.  financial services giant amp rallied 17 cents to 19.92 australian dollars. colonial shares rose four cents.  among resource stocks, bhp shed 12 cents to close, and rio tinto slipped eight after reporting that production of most commodities increased over its second quarter. woodside lost 12 cents, and caltex tumbled 20 cents.  the gold index gave up 19.9 points or 1.8 percent to finish at 1080.6 as the spot price for the precious metal was selling 290.60 unitedstates dollars an ounce.  the banking index held up a little better, shedding 57.5 percent or 0.95 percent to 6010.6. anz ended 21 cents softer, cba closed 23 lower, nab decreased 16 and westpac came back 7.1 to 10.45 australian dollars.  national turnover was a modest 233.10 million valued at 790.75 million australian dollars (490.4 million unitedstates dollars).

title: meeting in u.s. city on geographic information system
body: projected to be indispensable in the 21st century, a type of information technology is drawing over 8,000 specialists around the world to southern california.  at the focus of the annual conference starting monday in san diego is geographic information system, or gis, with pervasiveness predicted by the organizers to be just as the internet is today.  gis is a computer-based tool integrating common database operations, such as query and statistical analysis, with the visualization and geographic analysis offered by maps.  it is used to map and analyze things and events on earth.  what makes san diego, the second largest city in california, standing out to host the five-day gis event is its status as one of the pioneers in the unitedstates in applying the technology.  the city and county of san diego since 1984 have developed a system using a computerized base map to locate 832,300 assessor's parcels, 35,700 street lights, 501 schools, 64 eagle nests, etc.  currently with 50 gigabytes of information, equivalent to the storage of 90 cd-roms, such a gis system produces maps for area planners, utility crews, budget analysts and private industries.  over years, san diego has spent 12 million unitedstates dollars to collect and standardize the geographic data, plus millions more on annual basis to update local governments' information files.  the uses of gis varies. san diego city water crews, for instance, can pinpoint a pipeline break on a digitized map on their laptop computers, make repairs and download the record of the repair into the city mainframe computer for future reference.  now at some world wide web sites on the internet, the vast computer network accessible worldwide, mapping services are available to point out the best driving route between two places.  as for the future, gis researchers imagine that it will soon be possible, via the internet, to call up a map, locate a specific property, download a photo and even watch a video showing people and vehicles outside a certain building.  combined with signals transmitted from global positioning system (gps) satellites, it might eventually be possible to geocode any person or article and local it within seconds.

title: american investors choose internet portals
body: of the 58 million american internet users, 35 million are conducting some form of financial services over the web, according to a study by market research firm cyber dialogue.  the study, released thursday, shows that instead of banks or brokerage houses, internet portals such as american online, yahoo and quicken have become the key to financial services. american consumers are primarily using these portals to access financial services on the internet, placing portal brand recognition above traditional financial brand names online.  out of the 18.1 million american users who manage their investments online, more than 2 million "digital investors" reported that the most frequently used site for managing their finances is american online's personal finance area, which is accessed five times more often than the nearest established brokerage branded web site.  in fact, according to the study, financial services providers cannot go online and rest on the laurels, depending on their offline brand to bring in the hits. they must have a range of online and offline service options available to obtain and retain customers. more than 50 percent of american "digital investors" use multiple sources to retrieve stock quotes, and nearly 20 percent use multiple brokerage sources when they trade.  "these findings tend to support the long-term valuations of leading internet portals," said cyber dialogue.  the survey also found that while only 3 million internet users perform a majority for their stock trades via the internet, 18.1 million users are regularly engaged in some form of investment activity via the net, a 132 percent increase from 7.8 million measured in the second quarter of 1997.  the study is based on interviews with 1,000 internet users and 500 non-users. respondents were asked about their use of online and offline financial services usage. the survey was fielded in the second quarter of 1998.

title: tsinghua university signs agreement with teleglobe at internet summit
body: china's tsinghua university and teleglobe of the unitedstates signed an agreement here thursday for teleglobe to provide high-speed global internet connectivity via its internet backbone service, globeinternet (sm).  the signing ceremony took place at inet'98, the internet society's annual conference, for which teleglobe is providing conference attendees with four mbps of global internet capacity via its frankfurt globeinternet point of presence (pop).  teleglobe is one of the world's leading global carriers and internet backbone providers. tsinghua university in beijing is the operator of the china education research network (cernet) the agreement reflects the growing trend of the global educational and research community to rely on teleglobe's internet backbone, currently linking internet service providers (isps) in more than 70 countries and regions.  "teleglobe is proud to have been selected by cernet to provide global internet access to academic institutions throughout china, an increasingly important market to teleglobe," said bob collet, vice president and general manager, data services for teleglobe.  "we're committed to providing solutions and services to accommodate cernet's growing needs." the link will consist of earth station and backhaul circuit connectivity services by china telecom to tsinghua university; space segment via china telecom and teleglobe jointly leased intelsat space segment capacity; and corresponding earth station and backhaul capacity to a globeinternet access node in north america.  teleglobe also will provide a quality of service (qos) operating system, enabling higher priority traffic to flow ahead of other network traffic during periods of congestion.  "the universities and the institutions connected to cernet throughout china are looking forward to the improved global internet access that will be provided by teleglobe, in conjunction with china telecom and intelsat," said dr. wu jianping of tsinghua university. "this link will further facilitate the sharing of knowledge and expertise by the multitude of academic institutions connected within china by cernet."

title: jon postel awarded itu silver medal for key role in internet
body: the international telecommunications union (itu) wednesday awarded dr jon postel the itu silver medal for his central role in the success story of the internet.  the medal was awarded on behalf of itu secretary-general dr pekka tarjanne in recognition of postel's outstanding contribution to the development of the global information infrastructure, through his management of the internet assigned numbers authority (iana).  in the world of internet governance, itu said, few organizations play as critical a role as the iana. unique numbers and unique names of the internet domain name system (dns) must be assigned and managed in an orderly fashion to enable the functioning of the internet.  that has been the iana's task from the very beginning of the internet. the iana has been managing the root of the dns to promote stability and robustness and has ensured that every internet computer had a unique ip number. to this end, the iana has been allocating blocks of numerical addresses to regional ip registries throughout the world which in turn issue them to internet service providers and users.  the iana also assigns and maintains a registry of the values used for several technical parameters including protocol numbers, port numbers, and others which must also be unique for the internet to work.  the fact that the on-going number assignments have continued to work effectively despite the phenomenal growth of the internet which now boasts of 24.7 million hosts, is a credit to the architects of the system and to the iana which administers it.  postel, currently a researcher at the university of southern california's (usc) information sciences institute (isi), is a legendary figure in the world of the internet.

title: internet society conference opens in geneva
body: the eighth annual meeting of the internet society (isoc) conference, known as the internet summit in the industry, began here tuesday.  one of the major issues at the conference will be the future of the internet's domain naming system, said the unitedstates-based isoc, the organizer of the event on july 21-24.  representatives from more than 120 countries and regions are expected to discuss the next major steps to assist the internet assigned names authority (iana) in defining and developing a non-profit corporation.  isoc expects that about 4,000 stake-holders, policy makers and internet leaders around the world will be attending the conference.  the network training workshops of isoc, held annually since 1993, have helped some developing countries in asia, the former soviet union and more than 20 african countries to set up internet connections and to have individuals trained in the technical and operational aspects of establishing and managing network system.  another training system of isoc, named "hands-on", will be given to professionals who will play a vital role in establishing the internet's presence in their countries or facilitating the efforts of schools, government organizations, firms, and residents to learn about and exploit internet services.  as the conference is not a purely technical one, 11 tutorials will be set up to help visitors understand the internet.  the internet society is a unitedstates-based non-profit international organization. since 1992, it has served as the international organization for global coordination and cooperation on the internet, promoting and maintaining a broad spectrum of activities focused on the internet's development, availability and associated technologies.  the first internet society conference was held in 1991, when an estimated four million people had access to the internet. by 1997, the number has risen to 57 million.

title: u.s. small businesses embrace internet
body: small businesses in the unitedstates accessing the internet increased dramatically from 19.7 percent in 1996 to 41.2 percent in 1998, according to a new study of the international data corp (idc).  idc's survey of 1,011 unitedstates firms with fewer than 100 employees confirmed the dramatic growth of small business online cuts across all company size categories.  the percentage of companies with under five employees that access the internet more than doubled from 1996 to 1997, climbing from 17.2 percent to 36.4 percent. however, smaller companies do lag behind larger ones in overall online penetration.  the internet is widely viewed as a vital business resource for specific industry and competitive information. small businesses are overwhelmingly accepting the internet as critical to the operation and management of their business.  idc's study shows internet usage among unitedstates small businesses is gaining momentum, with penetration forecast to approach 4.3 million small firms by 2001.  the study also found that the professional service sector, such as law firms, insurance agencies, real estate agencies and accounting firms, leads in internet usage, with 63 percent of pc owners online.  among the laggards are retail and health care industries.  internet users in manufacturing companies log onto the internet most frequently and for the broadest range of applications.  pc-owning small business with home pages will increase from 9 percent in 1997 to 20.1 percent by 2001, according to idc.  thirty-six percent of small businesses that plan to go online expect to use the internet to sell products.

title: australian shares fall as profit-takers move in
body: the australian share market slipped almost one percent monday as profit takers moved on to the bourse.  caution held turnover to modest levels as participants await unitedstates federal reserve chairman alan greenspan's biannual humphrey hawkins testimony to congress tuesday and local inflation figures due out wednesday.  the benchmark all ordinaries index edged down 26.8 points, or 0.95 percent, to 2,787.9.  on friday, the dow jones industrial average index edged another 9.78 points higher to a record close of 9,337.97.  "there was quite a bit of profit-taking which came in first thing this morning," reynolds co's peter struk said.  "you've got greenspan talking on tuesday night and cpi figures on wednesday so there's a few unknowns there," he said.  "tokyo was closed today so there was no guidance there and hongkong was weaker. the australian dollar was also lower and that helped news corp. along," struk said.  the all industrials index fell 42.3 points to 4,887.0 and the resources sector shed 15 points to 1,095.2.  rupert murdoch's news corp. added eight cents to 13.13 australian dollars while its preferred scrip rose four cents.  in contrast, publishing and broadcasting ltd. closed 16 cents softer amid reports that its chairman kerry packer was ill and might require a kidney transplant in the next 18 months.  telstra eased three cents on solid turnover of 8.79 million shares placing the telecommunications giant at the top of the turnover table.  the gold index came back 8.1 points to 1,105.0 as the price of the precious metal was trading at 293.90 unitedstates dollars an ounce in sydney, marginally up from friday's close of 293.65.  the banking sector shed 72.2 points or 1.17 percent to 6,118.2 as australia's big four all gave up ground.  nab, which unveils its third quarter profit thursday, ended 18.3 cents easier, anz dropped 20.6 cents, cba fell 27 cents, and westpac moved back 12 cents.  national volume topped just 188.72 million valued at 607.92 million australian dollars (382.98 million unitedstates dollars), with falls outpacing rises 595 to 370 and 367 steady.

title: beijing's palace museum reaches agreement with intel
body: the beijing-based palace museum has reached an agreement with the unitedstates's intel to solve a dispute over a web site on the internet, it was reported today.  intel created the site earlier this year to provide information about the museum in the forbidden city, without chinese authorization.  museum officials expressed their displeasure with the move, saying that it contained some mistakes and that photos and articles were being used without copyright.  the dispute was solved recently, however, according to a museum spokesman, who says that the chinese will go along with the site and provide copyrights for the americans and see to the correctness of the contents.  intel says that it will place a notice on the main page, saying that the palace museum supports the site and will provide the museum with some advanced computer equipment for "further promoting chinese culture".  the cooperation will mean that previous mistakes are corrected and that some low-quality pictures are replaced with new ones provided by the museum, the spokesman says.  some people explain that the dispute was the result of a lack of legal protection for copyrights in the information era and chinese scholars' insufficient understanding of computer technology development.  china has more than one million internet users who spend most of their time looking at information from the west.

title: hk youths given a hand to start business on internet
body: young people who want to start a business on the internet may realize their dreams with the financial and technical assistance from a leading multimedia services provider in hongkong.  about 800 hongkong youths attended a seminar organized by hongkong telecom's netvigator monday afternoon to illustrate a netvigator entrepreneur program, which is open to those below the age of 30.  the program targets particularly fresh university graduates, job seekers or employees who have creative ideas for starting businesses on the internet, dr. william lo, managing director of hongkong telecom interactive multimedia services (ims), told the seminar.  interested parties are required to submit proposals to netvigator via email not later than august 21, once a proposal has been approved, a minimum of 200,000 hk dollars (25,600 unitedstates dollars) will be invested plus technical and operational support from hongkong telecom to turn the idea into a real business venture, according to lo.  on top of giving young people a chance to start their own businesses, the program also aimed at creating new business opportunities and pushing electronic commerce in hongkong.  "as the largest internet service provider in hongkong, we have continuously promote e-commerce, a significant trend in the business world," he noted.

title: india to invest 7 billion dollars on it in 10 years
body: india intends to invest 7 billion unitedstates dollars in information technology (it) over the next decade which is expected to generate an annual export revenue of some 50 billion unitedstates dollars.  one of the convenors of the national task force on information technology and software development, n. seshagiri, said here monday that direct and indirect investment in it from government, public and private sectors would be to the tune of 6 to 7 billion unitedstates dollars till 2008.  the task force, set up by the indian government on may 22, put forward at the end of last month a series of recommendations for the development of information technology and software in the country and set the target of annual software exports of 50 billion unitedstates dollars by the year 2000.  giving details about the national information policy drawn up by the task force, seshagiri said one to three percent of every ministry's outlay would be earmarked for information technology, and every department in the central and state government has a five-year it action plan.  he estimated that on an average of two percent of outlay, an annual expenditure of near 500 million unitedstates dollars would flow into the it sector from government alone for purchase of it products including software and personnel training in addition to spending by state governments.  on the recommendation of the special team, the indian government would make an immediate investment of 7 billion rupees (170 million unitedstates dollars) as a corpus fund to solve the year 2000 problem (y2k) in government, public and private organizations and services.  seshagiri said that actual inflow of working capital into the industry would be to the tune of 3 billion unitedstates dollars by 2000 against the current projection of 1 billion dollars.  indian banks would be permitted to invest in dedicated capital funds meant for it industry as part of a five percent increment in deposits currently allowed for shares, he said.  the task force said in its "it action plan" submitted to prime minister atal behari vajpayee last month that it industry is expected to create more than a million jobs in the next five years when its recommendations are implemented.  the suggested measures include introduction of sweat equity to it employees, blanket approval for indian it firms to acquire foreign companies and zero duty on all it products by the year 2002.  the team also suggested 100 percent depreciation on all it products in two years, tripling of working capital requirements for industry, ending internet access monopoly, internet access through cable, introduction of authorized independent service providers in all districts by 2000 and internet to all schools, polytechnic, colleges and universities by 2003.  software has become one of india's main foreign exchange earners with 68 billion rupees (1.7 billion unitedstates dollars) for software exports in 1997-98, recording a growth rate of 65 percent over the previous year.

title: german politicians call for international crackdown on child pornography
body: leading german politicians including chancellor helmut kohl saturday called for strengthened international cooperation to crack down on child pornography on the internet.  in an interview with the german sunday newspaper welt am sonntag which was released in advance, kohl said that he was "shocked" by a recent founding in the netherlands that an international child pornography ring had exploited toddlers as young as one year old and distributed their images worldwide via the internet.  thousands of print photographs and computer disks with child pornography images were confiscated during a raid on an apartment in the dutch seaside town of zandvoort owned by a german man who was shot dead in italy after tipping off police to the pornography ring, a belgian citizen group investigating the case announced thursday.  kohl said that the new founding highlighted the need for an intensification of international cooperation on protecting the children from sexual abuses.  german finance minister theo waigel meanwhile called on the european union to suggest an international legal convention against child pornography on the internet.  the latest founding of on-line child pornography had actually opened up a new dimension for international legal authorities, something which cannot be dealt with by just one country, waigel said.  german research minister juergen ruettgers on saturday also called on members of the united nations to negotiate an "internet code of conduct" to provide regulations on materials disseminated over the internet.

title: networking protocol co-inventor to join internet summit
body: vinton cerf, co-inventor of the language for internet communications, will give his vision of the future of the internet at the 1998 internet summit (inet'98) to be held on july 21 to 24 here in geneva.  cerf is co-inventor of the computer networking protocol tcp/ip, which is the basic language of the internet. today, he is responsible for the development of mci's internet services.  "the internet society is devoted to the process that has allowed the internet to grow, flourish and evolve successfully," said cerf when announcing his decision to attend the annual conference organized by the internet society.  "inet'98 comes at a critical time in internet evolution and i am looking forward to participating in what is certain to be a very constructive series of dialogues and programs on current and future challenges facing this global resource," said cerf, who also serves on a presidential panel to review the unitedstates' program for the next generation internet.  the conference provides an annual forum for world leaders of the internet community to discuss the future impact of the internet on many key areas of society, including communications, health, law, education and electronic commerce. representatives from more than 120 countries are expected to attend the summit.

title: britannica unveils new web site
body: encyclopedia britannica took its first major step wednesday to compete with some internet sites that have supplanted it online.  britannica, one of the best-known in the publishing industry, launched a new web site aiming to become a major research tool for internet surfers.  the new free service of britannica, named eblast, is a web navigation service featuring a searchable and browsable directory of more than 125,000 sites selected by the company's editors for their quality and usefulness, said the company in an announcement.  eblast also offers a forum for today's leading writers and thinkers.  eblast is not designed to replace the encyclopedias the company has published since 1768. britannica, with its headquarters based in chicago, still puts out book and cdrom versions of its encyclopedias, and sells access to its electronic version on the internet for 85 unitedstates dollars a year.  the new web navigation service, a "thinking person's guide to the web," as called by the company, aims to grab a piece of the market dominated by better-known internet brands such as yahoo, excite and america online.  britannica is hoping to gain 5 percent of the market for research-oriented internet searches by stressing quality over quantity in its search results.  "eblast is an important step in redefining the role of the encyclopedia in the digital age," said britannica publisher paul hoffman.  "encyclopedias serve two functions: to provide fast access to trustworthy information and to help people acquire knowledge. the web makes millions of pages of new information available, but some of it is questionable, and much of the best of it is hard to find. our web-savvy editors separate the kernels of quality information from the chaff and present it in an engaging, contemporary way," he said.  eblast's special features include favorite websites of famous people, a guest column in which columnists examine exceptional sites, an interactive "ask an expert" area, and columns featuring the favorite websites of britannica editors.

title: hk to speed up information technology development
body: the government of the hongkong special administrative region (hksar) will continue to work closely with industry and academia to explore ways to facilitate the commercialization of the results of research on leading edge information technology.  k. c. kwong, secretary for information technology and broadcasting, made these remarks in a written reply to a question raised by a legislative council member here wednesday afternoon.  he said that currently, institutions funded by the university grants committee maintain close contact with the information technology industry over research activities.  some institutions have also established independent private bodies to facilitate technology transfer and commercialization of the results of research on technological developments, including information technology, he said.  kwong said to enhance collaboration between the academic sector and the information technology industry, the government funding support is made available through the industrial support fund and the research grants council under the aegis of the university grants committee.  the government has financed a number of projects involving collaborative efforts between the academic sector and the information technology industry, he said.  one example is the cyberspace center established by the hongkong university of science and technology to promote and facilitate the use of the internet among software developers.  the center has produced publications on internet security and initiated an internet business consortium for the promotion of business application of internet.  another example is the electronic news media and publishing consortium set up by the chinese university of hongkong for the local news media industry to promote greater use of electronic publishing.  through the research grants council, funds are provided for research projects with the potential of social or economic application, he said.  since 1991, kwong said that the research grants council has allocated about 160 million hk dollars (20.5 million unitedstates dollars) to support 344 research projects and five large-scale initiatives in computer science and information technology.  the research grants council also supports the establishment of co-operative research centers to promote technology transfer between tertiary institutions and the industry, he said.

title: hyundai to sell auto parts online
body: hyundai america said it plans to use the web to broaden the distribution of its replacement parts and generate business for its unitedstates auto-franchise dealers.  while auto makers use their informational web sites to steer new-car shoppers to local dealers, hyundai is the first with plans to sell parts over the web to independent repair shops and car owners.  hyundai, which sells 150 million unitedstates dollars worth of replacement parts annually in north america, said that the extranet will generate additional revenue for its dealers, who will handle all parts orders from auto shops and car owners.  the system is set to go live around november and will supplement the cd-rom catalogs and electronic data interchange (edi)-based ordering systems commonly used in the auto-parts sector. it will link hyundai's ordering system with a password-protected web site where buyers can search and order parts from a hyundai catalog.  by selling parts on the web, manufacturers are making an important turn in their e-commerce strategies, which have been focused on integrating relationships with suppliers and providing information for consumers. their e-commerce initiatives have been oriented more backward to the supply chain than forward through the selling chain.

title: u.s. nonprofit groups turning to cyberspace
body: charities and other nonprofit groups in the unitedstates are turning to cyberspace to raise money.  what attracts many nonprofit groups is the prospect of a cheap, easy way to reach an estimated 57 million americans with access to the world wide web.  many nonprofits originally set up web sites to spread their mission and offer online activism. now they are adding encryption technology that makes it safer to send credit-card information over the internet.  also, they use the techniques of electronic commerce to accept online credit-card donations and conduct upscale auctions over the internet.  the philanthropic spinoff of e-commerce is still in its infancy; no one tracks how many nonprofits are fund-raising online, or how many money they are bringing in. yet a growing number of nonprofits regard the internet as a way to reduce their reliance on expensive fund-raising methods like direct mail and phone banking, according to knight ridder newspapers.  guidestar is a nonprofit online service that lists information and financial data for 40,000 american charities and non-profit organizations.  the trend has spawned a cottage industry of consultants and companies that create or host secure web sites for the non-profits --sometimes in exchange for a cut of the contributions.  charityweb, a california-based startup which has signed up contracts with seven agencies, for instance, charges full membership 99 unitedstates dollars for setup, plus 2.5 percent to 5.5 percent per transaction.  the most successful online fund-raisers are philanthropy's biggest brand names, such as the american cancer society and the american red cross.  the american cancer society began raising money in 1995 through an online form that could be downloaded, then faxed or mailed.  this low-tech way trickled 3,000 dollars in each month. online contributions have grown fourfold since the nonprofit added secure transactions to its web site.  the american red cross launched online contributions in july 1996 and has raised about 128,000 dollars since then. during the midwest floods of 1997, contributions shot up to 300 monthly, up from a more typical 25 to 40 per month.

title: australian bank to introduce internet banking
body: australia's leading bank national australia bank ltd. (nab) announced thursday that it would introduce an online banking service with unprecedented levels of security.  the service, known as national internet banking, would be based on java software and feature the use of digital certificates, the first in the australian banking market, the bank said.  the use of digital certificates is equivalent to an electronic signature and is assigned to each customer's personal computer.  it is encrypted and held on the customer's personal computer, preventing unauthorized access from any other location.  the service would feature online registration, so nab clients would not need to visit a branch before using it.  it would offer users account balances, 100 days of statement information with search and sort functions, transfer of funds between nab accounts and other banks, secure email to and from the bank, set up and change periodic payments and bill payments.  glenn barnes, nab executive general manager of business and personal financial services, said national internet banking would be made available progressively to nab staff and selected customers from this week, with a general release later in the year.

title: clinton's advisor to attend internet summit in geneva
body: ira magaziner, senior advisor on unitedstates internet policy to president bill clinton, will attend the 1998 internet summit scheduled on july 21-24 in geneva, announced the internet society (isoc) thursday.  in his role as the leading unitedstates spokesman for internet policy, magaziner will speak at the conference's governance panel. he will discuss the role of government in determining internet policy and provide his perspective on the administration and regulation of the internet.  the annual conference organized by the isoc provides a forum for world leaders of the internet community to discuss the evolution of the internet and its future impact on many key areas of society, including communications, health, law, education and electronic commerce.  the conference plays an important part in the isoc's overall program to encourage global coordination and cooperation on the internet, and magaziner will provide the unitedstates government's perspective on the new era of self-governance upon which the internet community is now embarking.  more than 150 peer-reviewed papers will be presented during inet'98. major sponsors for the event include geneva financial center foundation, compaq computer corporation, sun microsystems, cisco systems, ibm, france telecom, university of geneva and mci communications.

title: half a million people visit china's new commodity market website
body: a website belonging to china's ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation (moftec) on the internet was visited 60,000 times on july 1, the first day it opened. there were 114,000 visits to the "china market" site on tuesday, ministry officials reported today. according to xing wei, director of moftec's china international electronic commerce center (ciecc), in the past week it was visited 562,000 times by people from the unitedstates, canada, japan, and dozens of other countries and some regions. "china market" can be reached at http://www.chinamarket.com.cn and moftec can be reached at its official web site http://www.moftec.gov.cn. xing wei explains that "china market" has 6 major product categories: electronics and machinery; textiles; light industry and crafts; foodstuffs, native produce, and animal by-products; hardware, minerals, and chemicals; and medicine and nutritional products. ciecc's ma yun says that businesses have been active on the website but no deals are known to have been concluded so far. the minister of foreign trade and economic cooperation shi guangsheng says that he believes that the website is a solid step by china to move into the age of e-commerce. the united nations' international telecommunication union estimates that the world could do 50 billion unitedstates dollars worth of e-commerce this year, and 300 billion by the year 2000.

title: internet becomes job-search tool in u.s.
body: hewlett-packard(hp), a computer maker based in california, hired 1,000 people from web applications last year.  the number was a significant portion of hp's total hires, said the internet hiring leader which employs 123,000 people worldwide.  hp is not alone in using internet as a recruiting tool. in fact, the information superhighway is becoming the american way to employment. hiring advertisements, resumes, job listings, training sessions and notices of career fairs and workshops are continuously shooting through cyberspace. on-line observers estimate internet job postings more than doubled this year in the unitedstates.  many companies and organizations offer on-line application forms on their web sites, usually under the entry of "employment." hp's home page offers detailed job description, minimum and desired qualifications for a certain job, so that applicants can measure themselves in terms of their interest, background and capabilities.  under rd, for instance, hardware design engineer, software design engineer and firmware design engineer are listed as job titles, and each has a digital code seemingly for relevant managers to easily pickup their needed applicants.  the internet is the only way to get some jobs, such as soft ware and network engineering positions. a great variety of job seekers uses careermosaic to access the site's 70,000 job listings. apart from high-tech and tech-oriented jobs, the site places short-order cooks, health care workers, financial planners and box packers. the site averages 450,000 hits a day.  a month-long careermosaic ad cost only 160 unitedstates dollars, while other forms of advertising might run as high as 8,000 dollars a day.  nowadays, even people without pcs use the internet to search for jobs. the growth of terminals at libraries, cybercafes and schools encourages public access.

title: internet stock boom creates another billionaire
body: yahoo co-founder jerry yang, a chinese-american, reached billionaire status tuesday as a result of internet stock boom.  yang, 29, became the latest net executive to gain entry into the billionaire boys club as yahoo's opening price climbed to 178.875 unitedstates dollars.  he holds 5.7 million shares, or a 12.2 percent stake in the silicon valley company.  yahoo's other co-founder, david filo, was just one step ahead of yang into the club. the 32-year-old executive, who holds nearly 5.9 million yahoo shares, reached billionaire status last week.  the company's stock has been on a rocket ride since early june, when it traded slightly above 100 dollars a share. in fact, it repeatedly has set new 52-week highs, with tuesday marking the latest peak.  yang ended the day with paper wealth of 1.14 billion dollars, while filo's net worth stood at 1.2 billion dollars, based on yahoo's closing price of 199.25 dollars per share.  before them, the founder of the online bookstore amazon.com, jeff bezos, cracked the one-billion-dollar barrier in early june, when amazon.com stock hit 51.25 dollars per share. bezos, 34, who holds 19.8 million of his company's shares, was worth 2.8 billion dollars on paper tuesday, based on the company's closing price of 139.5 dollars a share.  both amazon and yahoo were founded in 1994. yahoo hit the public markets in april 1996, while amazon went public in may of 1997.

title: measures for indian infotech development recommended
body: a special team set up by the indian government on may 22 has put forward a series of recommendations for the development of information technology and software in the country and set the target of annual software exports at 50 billion unitedstates dollars by 2008.  the national task force on information technology and software development submitted the "it (information technology) action plan" to prime minister atal bihari vajpayee last saturday, the times of india reported tuesday.  the action plan said infotech is expected to create more than a million jobs in the next five years when its recommendations are implemented.  the suggested measures included introduction of sweat equity to it employees, blanket approval for indian it firms to acquire foreign companies and zero duty on all it products by the year 2002.  the team also suggested a 100 percent depreciation on all it products in two years, tripling of working capital requirements for industry, an end to internet access monopoly, internet access through cable, introduction of authorized independent service providers in all districts by 2000 and internet service to all schools, polytechnic, colleges and universities by 2003.  the prime minister has already appointed a four-member ministerial committee comprising the ministers of finance, information and broadcasting, human resources development and defense to examine the report by the task force headed by deputy chairman of the planning commission jaswant singh.  the report said the software and it services industry should be treated as a priority sector by banks for the next five years, besides creation of at least four venture capital funds with a corpus of not less than 500 million rupees (about 12.5 million unitedstates dollars) each to cater exclusively to it entrepreneurs.  permission could be granted to railways, defense, state electricity boards, powergrid corporations as well as organizations to use their fiber optic backbone to provide service to the public by interfacing existing or new public networks, it said.  the task force also proposed a fund of 7 billion rupees (175 million dollars) to tackle the "y2k" or year 2000 bug problems in computers of government organizations, besides recommending that each ministry or department earmark 1-3 three percent of its budget to it.  the task force, which has made 108 recommendations, was required to identify bottlenecks for it development in india and measures to remove them, and to formulate a draft on the national informatics policy with the aim of enabling the country to emerge as an "infotech superpower" in the next decade.  software has become one of india's major foreign exchange earners with 68 billion rupees (about 1.7 billion dollars) worth of software exports in 1997-98, an increase of 65 percent over the previous year.

title: blue chips drive australian stocks higher
body: rising blue chip stocks led the australian share market higher monday, insulating the bourse from weaker sessions in tokyo and hongkong.  the benchmark all ordinaries index climbed 8.7 points to close at 2,751.8.  brokers said global media giant news corp, australian telecommunications giant telstra and national australia bank (nab) ltd powered the australian bourse monday as investors continued to take refuge in defensive stocks.  "it looks like offshore buyers were in there today sticking to core stocks," reynolds co's grant williams said.  telstra marched to another intraday record high of 4.49 australian dollars before closing at 4.46 australian dollars, up 10 cents. trade was solid with 10.29 million shares changing hands worth 27.98 million unitedstates dollars, placing telstra comfortably at the top of the turnover table.  news corp, still riding on the back of optimism surrounding the planned partial float of its unitedstates entertainment arm, added 14.5 cents to 13.06 australian dollars. its preferred scrip gained 11 cents to 11.66 australian dollars.  the all industrials index ended 22.9 points better at 4,833.6 and the resources sector slipped 3.8 to 1,071.5.  resources giant bhp eased one cent to 14.08 australian dollars, global miner rio tinto moved back 6.9 cents to 18.651 australian dollars.  the gold index gave up 6.5 points to finish at 1,106.9.  in sydney, gold bullion was selling 1.50 unitedstates dollars an ounce lower at 295.90 unitedstates dollars by 1655 australian eastern standard time.  the banking index rose 38.4 points to 5,943.4, with nab increasing 18 cents to 21.98 australian dollars, anz bank up 13 cents to 11.57 australian dollars, the commonwealth bank of australia eased two cents to 19.34 australian dollars, and westpac bank gained 5.2 cents to 10.282 australian dollars.  national turnover was 201.21 million shares worth 419.68 million unitedstates dollars with rises outnumbering falls 554 to 408, and 375 remained steady.

title: major news items in leading israeli newspapers
body: the following are major news items in leading israeli newspapers monday. the jerusalem post: --israeli security officials are concerned that the recent series of attacks on arab property in the hebron area may be the work of an organized group. four vegetable stalls belonging to palestinians near the avraham avinu enclave in hebron were torched on sunday morning.  police are still trying to find out whether the arson was carried out by persons involved in friday's vandalism and if the recent incidents are the work of an extremist underground. haaretz: --israel is the 12th in the world in terms of per capita internet users, science minister michael eitan told the cabinet sunday. eitan said that there are some 500,000 internet users in israel, comprising about 10 percent of the population.  he said the government will establish a committee to include the science, communications, and industry ministries to find ways to double israeli use of the internet in the coming years. yediot aharonot: --israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu said at the cabinet meeting sunday that neither he nor defense minister yitzhak mordechai knew in advance the arrangement made early friday morning to end the standoff in gaza.  but national infrastructure minister ariel sharon implied that netanyahu was lying about this issue, and mordechai acknowledged that he himself had agreed to the arrangement.

title: ethiopian telecom to upgrade internet services
body: ethiopian telecommunications corporation (etc) announced sunday that it will expand the capacity of ethio-internet services and enable it to serve 14,000 subscribers.  a press release issued here by the corporation said that a tripartite memorandum of understanding was signed thursday by ethiopian ministry of economic development and cooperation, the united nations development program (undp) and etc to upgrade the capacity of internet services at a cost of over 1.3 million unitedstates dollars.  according to the memorandum, some 600,000 unitedstates dollars of the total fund would be covered by the undp internet initiative for africa and the remaining 703,303 unitedstates dollars by the corporation.  the corporation said in its press release that the project would create a one-megabite capacity which will make possible the provision of dependable internet services to eight regional towns.  etc started internet services in capital addis ababa with thousands of subscribers at the beginning of last year.  meanwhile, the corporation also announced that it has signed a contract with global one to further upgrade the band width of its existing connection server from 256 kilobites to 512 kilobites per second to solve the problem of congestion.  the corporation has also signed a contract with nec, a japanese company, to upgrade the satellite earth station at sullulta which was installed by the same company 20 years ago.  the project also includes the installation of a second international earth station in makelle before the end of 1999.

title: microsoft pays for using internet explorer name
body: microsoft, the world's software giant, has settled a trademark lawsuit, agreeing to pay 5 million unitedstates dollars for the right to continue using the name internet explorer for its strategically important browser software.  on the second day of a jury trial in chicago, microsoft reached a settlement with lawyers for synet, a defunct illinois software company that claimed the right to the internet explorer trademark.  the company first used the name for its internet browser in 1994, about one year earlier than microsoft did.  microsoft argued that internet explorer is a common descriptive term, meaning a device to explore, and could be used widely by software makers in the industry.  analysts said that if a jury had decided synet in fact had the right to the internet explorer name, microsoft could have been forced to spend an estimated 30 million unitedstates dollars to remove the words from its software, packaging and manuals.  synet founder dhiren rana, a british immigrant, claimed his company was forced to ask for bankruptcy protection in part because its legal battle with microsoft cost too much.  microsoft's internet explorer, which the company gives away for free and distributes as part of its various windows operating systems, is at the core of the efforts by the government to show that the software giant is extending its monopoly into the internet market.

title: americans are more internet savvy: study
body: widespread internet use in the unitedstates has produced more internet savvy americans of all generations, said a new study by mci telecommunications.  an on-line internet skills assessment revealed that the skill levels of americans rose to an average score of 82 percent, up from 78 percent last year.  the second mci great american net test also found that the skill levels between men and women are fairly even, with 82 percent for women and 80 percent for men.  in terms of age category, the so-called baby boomers (age 40 to 60) and the generation xers (age 24 to 39) scored the highest, an average 84 percent.  the higher internet skill level is good news for the country, mci said, quoting the unitedstates bureau of labor statistics as saying that the top three fastest growing occupations are technology-related. many other unitedstates industries will also seek employees with new media, internet-based technology skills.  respondents who access the internet at home or work are doing better than those who access the internet at school.  the interactive on-line test covered a three-month period, beginning from march 30. the test takers had to use the search technology of the world wide web to find answers to nine questions, including pop culture, world geography, arts and literature, science and technology, and history.  the mci study also found that most americans believe the internet will still be around in the year 2100.  according to mci, there were less than 300 computers in the unitedstates being connected to the internet in 1981 and the figure rose to 90,000 in 1989. more than 30 million computers may have been linked to the world wide web today and the number could double by the year 2000, the telecommunications company said.

title: australian stocks end firmer
body: fund-inspired "window dressing" and another massive surge in rupert murdoch's news corp shares helped the share market close the financial year on a high note tuesday.  news corp provided much of the boost after announcing earlier tuesday that it would float off a part of its unitedstates entertainment business under the fox group banner which analysts suggested could raise up to 2.4 billion unitedstates dollars for debt repayment and possible acquisitions.  news' two shares surged over eight percent (ordinary shares up 1.08 australian dollars to 13.18 australian dollars and preferred ones up 94 cents to 11.44 australian dollars) after a bigger rise in the unitedstates market overnight.  the all ordinaries index ended 47.3 points firmer at 2,668.4, all industrials jumped 86.9 to 4,689.0 and all resources managed to climb 14.8 to 1,037.4.  brokers said the broad gains were inspired by "window dressing" by the major funds which drove up leading share prices ahead of tuesday's close of the financial year.  the bank sector was mixed, however, with leader national australia bank down five cents at 21.30 australian dollars, westpac bank up seven cents to 9.85 australian dollars, the commonwealth bank of australia up 41 cents at 18.84 australian dollars and anz bank down nine cents at 11.14 australian dollars.  diversified resources and mining company bhp was the only major firms to enjoy a benefit from window dressing tuesday, with a rise of 46 cents to 13.65 australian dollars, after renewed speculation that embattled chairman jerry ellis may resign.  global miner rio tinto shed much of monday's boost with a 34 cent fall to 19.20 australian dollars.  gold stocks were the exception after broad rises in the mid-ranking producers in line ahead of the 3.30 unitedstates dollar rise in gold bullion by 16:20 (local time) tuesday to 295.80 unitedstates dollars.  overall 553.9 million shares changed hands worth 716 million unitedstates dollars, with rising stocks outnumbering falling ones by 729 to 584.

title: backgrounder (5): hong kong -information center
body: hongkong, the regional entrepot of finance and trade, is marked by the high degree of import and application of advanced technology, particularly that related to information industry.  taking advantage of its status of free port, hongkong maintains economic links with over 100 countries and regions, making it a pivot of information, and now it is trying to build itself into "the most informed city in the world" as described by the hongkong telecom.  wired by satellite, optical fibers, cables, microwaves and other media, hongkong has formed an information network, particularly economic information network, both locally and globally.  hongkong is the first major city in the world to have a fully digitized telephone network and the amount of its outgoing international phone calls is much higher than both the unitedstates and japan. hongkong now has a telecommunications network comprising over 300,000 kilometers of optical fiber.  about one-sixth of hongkong's population or 1.1 million people have subscribed to paging services --the highest per-capita rate in the world. and a total of over 1 million subscribers to cellular phone services also is among the highest levels of penetration in the world.  a recent market survey showed that the home penetration rate of pc is over 50 percent and there are more than 850,000 internet users in hongkong.  in march, the world's first-ever interactive tv (itv) was launched in hongkong, making it possible for people to see films, listen to music or deal with financial affairs at any time with clicks of a few buttons at home. and just two weeks ago, the internet service was added to the itv network, enabling users to get access to the worldwide web at a surprisingly high speed.  an international conference on the future of information and communications technology in asia had just concluded in hongkong.  organizers of the conference said the city provides a dynamic, technology-rich environment, whose government sees technology as a critical component of hongkong's successful future. also, the regional hub provides an open location in which to examine the various models of technology throughout asia.  since the 1960s, hongkong has brought in unitedstates and japanese investment in electronic industry, which has become the second largest industry in hongkong.  technology advancement is a key factor of economic growth in hongkong. a research on the manufacturing sector in hongkong shows that technology development accounted for an average of 42.9 percent in the sector's production during the period of 1969 to 1982.  hongkong's technology development is market-oriented and characterized by high efficiency. for instance, it usually takes a mere three months for general electronics and plastics from product design to production.  there are several prestigious academic institutions in hongkong, including hongkong university, the chinese university of hongkong, hongkong university of science and technology, and they are well equipped and have absorbed talents from all over the world.  political and social stability ensures hongkong favorable working and living conditions. in addition, hongkong's ability to develop technology-rich products has been well-complimented by the abundant outcome of the ever-increasing scientific research in china's inland areas.

title: australian stocks end firmer
body: investors retreating to the blue chip securities on the australian stock market led a stronger finish for the local bourse monday.  by the close of trade, the all ordinaries index had risen 11.2 points to 2,621.1, around the midpoint of the day's trading range.  "there was strong buying in selected blue chips," morgans broker simon reed said.  investors would be looking to low risk, "fairly safe" stocks in the last couple of days before the end of australia's financial year of 1997-1998, he said.  rupert murdoch's media group news corp led the charge and was "shining after a strong performance on wall street over the weekend," reed said.  news corp climbed 22 cents to 12.10 australian dollars with the preferred shares adding 16 cents to 10.50 australian dollars.  it helped the all industrials index to add 38.4 points to 4,602.1 while a big slump in bhp shares dragged the all resources index 13.6 points lower to 1,022.6 points.  diversified mining giant bhp plunged 51 cents to 13.19 australian dollars.  the banking index rose 44.6 points to 5,724.0, with national australia bank shares stacking on 29.9 cents to 21.35 australian dollars.  the commonwealth bank of australia rose eight cents to 18.43 australian dollars and anz bank climbed 10 cents to 11.23 australian dollars but westpac bank bucked the trend, slipping four cents to 9.78 australian dollars.  in the gold sector, the index dropped 15.4 points to 1,030.8 while the gold bullion spot price dipped 20 unitedstates cents to 293.50 unitedstates dollars per ounce in late monday afternoon.  national turnover was 435.43 million shares worth 672.29 million unitedstates dollars with falls outnumbering rises 641 to 585.

title: australian stocks claw back earlier losses
body: the australian share market clawed back earlier losses to finish just marginally negative thursday despite a solid rise on wall street overnight.  the benchmark all ordinaries index closed 0.8 points easier at 2,592.0, while asian markets firmed and the dow jones industrial average jumped 95.41 points to 8,923.87.  brokers said the local bourse would have been off around 20 points if not for gains among market heavyweights news corp. and telstra and if amp had been factored into the equation.  "we opened a few points better initially but as the yen and the australian dollar weakened a little, our market did the same," reynolds co.'s peter struk said.  "i thought we would have followed tokyo and hongkong up today but we couldn't even manage that, so it's been a very disappointing day in virtually all stocks," he added.  the all industrials index rose 9.9 points to 4,529.3 and the resources sector dropped 11.2 points to 1,032.1.  media giant news corp. was higher on reports that unitedstates phone giant att had finalized a 46.8 billion unitedstates dollars bid for unitedstates cable concern tele-communications ltd., a massive premium to tci's previous market valuation.  among other industrials, retail giant coles myer tumbled 23 cents to 6.33 australian dollars. fellow retail stock woolworths gained four cents. qantas dipped 11 cents and lend lease lost 49.4 cents.  the gold index forfeited 7.7 points to 1,043.5 as the precious metal was trading 85 cents an ounce lower at 292.50 unitedstates dollars.  the banking index dropped 19.3 points to 5,631.5, as nab dropped 49.7 cents, anz gained 15 cents, cba improved 2.6 cents and westpac also found two cents to finish.  overall, national turnover was 411.56 million shares valued at 1.54 billion australian dollars (939.4 million unitedstates dollars) with falls outnumbering rises 625 to 572.

title: big asian companies increase web site use
body: seventy-five percent of the largest 1,000 companies in asia have established a presence on the world wide web of the internet, said the international development corp.(idc).  idc, the leading unitedstates provider of information technology data, analysis and consulting, said in a new report friday that this is up from 57 percent since october 1997 when the firm conducted the first-ever study of asian corporate web site adoption.  in comparison, approximately 81 percent of the unitedstates companies with at least 100 employees have established web sites, according to idc.  "in just eight months there has been an 18 percent increase in the number of web sites created by large corporations in asia," said the idc report. "the importance of the internet as a business tool is rapidly gaining wide acceptance in asia's corporate culture, asia's web sites have entered a new phase of maturity." asia's information technology vendors should be encouraged by the findings, said idc. asia's internet service providers have recently experienced increasing costs and decreasing income due to equipment and backbone access fees being charged in unitedstates dollars and subscriber income trickling through in troubled local currencies.  the idc survey also looked for the ability to complete business transit through the web site as well as the quality of asian web sites in terms of layout, navigation, download speeds, ease of navigation and accessibility. "all areas showed improvement over the eight month study gap," idc said.  corporate web sites in asia are now showing company financial information, providing online customer support and using online registration facilities, according to idc.  idc believes that the top 1,000 companies in asia which are ranked by sales revenues would increasingly use the web as a medium for marketing communications and this offers significant opportunity to vendors of internet-related products and services.

title: american parents concerned about net safety for children
