title: BRITAIN LEADS IN INTERNET USAGE IN BUSINESS
body: THE UK'S COMPANIES ARE BEATING THEIR AMERICAN COUNTERPARTS IN PREPARING TO EXPLOIT THE INTERNET, ACCORDING TO A NEW SURVEY BY MORI. THE SURVEY, RELEASED SUNDAY BY INTENTIA, THE GLOBAL SOFTWARE GROUP, CONFOUNDS THE GENERAL BELIEF THAT BRITAIN AND EUROPE ARE YEARS BEHIND THE unitedstates IN THEIR ADOPTION OF THE INTERNET. MORI INTERVIEWED 700 DIRECTORS IN EUROPE AND THE unitedstates ON THEIR USE OF THEIR INTERNET AND THEIR PREDICTIONS FOR FUTURE USE. BRITISH DIRECTORS ARE FORECASTING THAT A HIGHER PROPORTION OF THEIR SALES WILL MOVE ONTO THE INTERNET THAN THEIR AMERICAN COMPETITORS. THE SURVEY SHOWED THAT DIRECTORS IN BRITAIN BELIEVE THE WEB WILL BRING IN 15 PERCENT OF ALL SALES BY 2001, EQUIVALENT TO MORE THAN 40 BILLION POUNDS. THIS IS A HIGHER PROPORTION THAN IN AMERICA (14 PERCENT) AND CONTINENTAL EUROPE (12 PERCENT). IT ALSO SHOWED THAT BRITISH BOARDROOMS ARE THE BEST PREPARED WHEN IT COMES TO DEALING WITH E-COMMERCE. 95 PERCENT OF ALL BRITISH BOARDS HAVE NOMINATED ONE DIRECTOR TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR E- COMMERCE COMPARED WITH 91 PERCENT IN THE unitedstates

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: CHINA OPENED ITS FIRST METAL WEBSITE TODAY. THE NEW WEBSITE, METALCHINA.COM, WAS ESTABLISHED BY TWO MAJOR SHARE-HOLDING COMPANIES UNDER THE INFORMATION CENTER OF CHINA'S NON-FERROUS METAL INDUSTRY. BY USING ADVANCED COMPUTER TECHNOLOGY, THE WEBSITE WILL ENABLE CLIENTS TO BROWSE INFORMATION EVEN FASTER. INTERNET USERS ARE NOW ABLE TO OBTAIN AN ARRAY OF INFORMATION ON METALS. THE WEBSITE INCLUDES HEADINGS SUCH AS "MARKET FLASH", " INTERNATIONAL METAL SALES" AND "METAL PRICES". "THE INTERNET HAS BECOME A MAJOR SOURCE OF GETTING INFORMATION FOR BUSINESSMEN, BUT REGRETTABLY, CHINA STILL LACKS SUCH WEBSITES THAT PROVIDE PROFESSIONAL INFORMATION," SAID SHEN GUANLING, GENERAL MANAGER OF QINGDAONET CORPORATION, WHO, WITH A COLLEAGUE, SET UP THE WEBSITE. ZHANG JILIN, DEPUTY MANAGER OF THE ANTAIKE CO., SAID THAT THE COMPANY WILL FULLY UTLIZE ITS INFORMATION RESOURCES TO PROVIDE THE BEST AND MOST EFFICIENT SERVICE FOR ITS CUSTOMERS.

title: HKE120951 -- AUSTRALIAN STOCKS CLOSES STRONGER
body: THE AUSTRALIAN STOCK MARKET KEPT AN ALL-TIME HIGH THURSDAY AS NEWS CORP AND OTHER KEY BLUE CHIPS IGNORED A LULL ON WALL STREET. THE BENCHMARK ALL ORDINARIES INDEX ENDED 27.8 POINTS OR 0.89 PERCENT STRONGER AT 3136.6 - ITS HIGHEST CLOSE SINCE THE APRIL 27 RECORD FINISH OF 3145.2. NEWS CORP STACKED ON 70 CENTS OR 4.58 PERCENT TO CLOSE AT 10.22 unitedstates DOLLARS. KERRY PACKER'S PBL GAINED 17.9 CENTS TO 7.36 unitedstates  DOLLARS. TELSTRA FINISHED 5.8 CENTS STRONGER AT 5.72unitedstates DOLLARS AND CW OPTUS WAS UP 5.4 CENTS TO 3.13 unitedstates DOLLARS. AIRLINERS QANTAS REVERSED ITS WEEK-LONG PLUNGE SPARKED BY THE MOVE BY RICHARD BRANSON'S VIRGIN AIRLINES TO ESTABLISH A BUDGET RIVAL ON KEY AUSTRALIAN ROUTES, PUTTING ON 14 CENTS TO 2.5 unitedstates  DOLLARS. NATIONAL TURNOVER REACHED 700.65 MILLION WORTH 673.36 MILLION U.  S.DOLLARS, WITH 733 RISES, 666 FALLS AND 442 STOCKS STEADY.

title: HKE120241 -- AUSTRALIAN STOCKS CLOSE STRONGER
body: RUPERT MURDOCH'S NEWS CORP LED THE AUSTRALIAN SHARE MARKET TO A SHARPLY HIGHER CLOSE THURSDAY, HELPED BY STRONG PERFORMANCE BY MINING GIANT BHP AND A HIGHER CLOSE ON WALL STREET OVERNIGHT. THE BENCHMARK ALL ORDINARIES INDEX CLOSED 36.3 POINTS, OR 1.19 PERCENT STRONGER AT 3,074 POINTS. THE ALL RESOURCES INDEX WAS THE BIGGEST GAINER STACKING ON ALMOST TWO PERCENT OR 23.8 POINTS AT 1,304.5 POINTS WHILE THE ALL INDUSTRIALS INDEX JUMPED MORE THAN ONE PERCENT OR 56.3 POINTS TO 5,329.2 POINTS. AMONG THE BANKS, THE NATIONAL AUSTRALIA BANK ROSE 22.3 CENTS TO 23.00 AUSTRALIAN DOLLARS, THE COMMONWEALTH ENDED 18 CENTS HIGHER AT 26.18 AUSTRALIAN DOLLARS WHILE THE ANZ MOVED 1.5 CENTS HIGHER AT 11.23 AUSTRALIAN DOLLARS. WESTPAC FINISHED 10 CENTS WEAKER AT 10.66 AUSTRALIAN DOLLARS. NATIONAL TURNOVER WAS 949.25 MILLION SHARES WORTH 1.597 BILLION AUSTRALIAN DOLLARS (1.054 BILLION unitedstates DOLLARS). RISES OUTPACED FALLS 718 TO 675 WITH 455 STEADY.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: A MINOR PLANET DISCOVERED BY A CHINESE RESEARCHER HAS BEEN NAMED AFTER THE HOMETOWN OF ITS FOUNDER BY THE PURPLE MOUNTAIN OBSERVATORY BASED IN NANJING, JIANGSU PROVINCE. THE MINOR PLANET, BEARING THE INTERNATIONAL SERIAL NUMBER 3611, WAS NAMED "DAPU" WITH THE APPROVAL FROM THE MINOR PLANET CENTER UNDER THE INTERNATIONAL ASTRONOMICAL UNION (IAU) AND THE INTERNATIONAL MINOR PLANET NOMENCLATURE COMMITTEE (IMPNC). THE PLANET WAS DISCOVERED ON DECEMBER 20, 1981, BY RESEARCH FELLOW YANG JIEXING, WHO IS FROM DAPU COUNTY IN THE NORTHEASTERN PART OF GUANGDONG PROVINCE. THE AVERAGE DISTANCE OF THE PLANET TO THE SUN IS 418 MILLION KM.  IT WILL TAKE 4.65 YEARS FOR THE PLANET TO CIRCLE THE SUN.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: THE CONSTRUCTION BANK OF CHINA (CBC) TODAY SIGNED A COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE ADMINISTRATION OF RADIO, FILM AND TELEVISION TO SET UP CHINA CABLE TV NET, A BANK SPOKESMAN SAID. UNDER THE AGREEMENT, THE CBC WOULD PROVIDE LOANS, SETTLEMENT, INTERNET BANKING AND OTHER SERVICES TO THE CABLE TV INFORMATION NETWORK CENTER, WHICH WOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION, OPERATION AND MANAGEMENT OF THE CHINA CABLE TV NET. IN THE INITIAL PHASE OF THE DEAL, THE CBC WILL LEND 300 MILLION YUAN TO THE CENTER TO BE USED AS CURRENT CAPITAL. CHINA'S VARIOUS CABLE TV NETWORKS NOW COVER 50 PERCENT OF THE COUNTRY'S TERRITORY AND 70 PERCENT OF ITS CITIES. THEY BOAST 80 MILLION CUSTOMERS AND 200 MILLION VIEWERS, NUMBERS WHICH CONTINUE TO INCREASE BY 50 MILLION A YEAR.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: MOTOROLA RECENTLY INTRODUCED INTO THE CHINESE MARKET A NEW-GENERATION MOBILE PHONE CAPABLE OF CONNECTING WITH THE INTERNET. USING THE NEW DEVICE, CODED "L2000WWW", PEOPLE CAN GET ON-LINE AS WELL AS SEND AND RECEIVE email. THE WORLD'S TELECOMMUNICATIONS SECTOR HAS WORKED OUT A TECHNICAL STANDARD CALLED THE WIRELESS APPLICATION PROTOCOL (WAP) TO SUPPORT THE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION NETWORK AND THE INTERNET. THE NEW MOBILE PHONE, BASED ON THE WAP, THUS BECOMES ANOTHER MAJOR TERMINAL CAPABLE OF CONNECTING WITH THE INTERNET, AND WILL BOOST THE GROWTH OF THE "WIRELESS INTERNET," SAID CHEN JIAXING, VICE PRESIDENT OF MOTOROLA (CHINA). SINA, ONE OF THE MAJOR CHINESE WEBSITES, NOW IS TESTING EQUIPMENT FOR ITS COMPATIBILITY WITH WAP AND INTENDS TO PROVIDE INTERNET SERVICE FOR MOBILE PHONE USERS, SAID YAN YUANCHAO, CHIEF ENGINEER OF SINA.

title: HK DEVELOPS WEB SITES ON COMMUNITY FACILITIES
body: hongkong HAS DEVELOPED TWO WEB SITES WHICH PROVIDE PEOPLE WITH INFORMATION ON COMMUNITY FACILITIES, SAID hongkong'S DIRECTOR OF LANDS ROBERT POPE TODAY. "THESE WEB SITES CONTAIN ABUNDANCE OF INFORMATION THAT IS OF INTEREST TO MEMBERS OF THE COMMUNITY AND ALLOW FREE ACCESS TO EVERYBODY," POPE SAID. THE GENERAL PUBLIC CAN OBTAIN LOCATION MAPS WITH INFORMATION ON PUBLIC FACILITIES INCLUDING POLICE STATIONS, FIRE STATIONS, HOSPITALS, CLINICS, SCHOOLS, POST OFFICES, RECREATIONAL AND SPORTS VENUES FROM WWW.CENTAMAP.COM/ AND WWW.YP.COM.HK/HKCITYMAP/. ALSO AVAILABLE IS INFORMATION ON COMMERCIAL FACILITIES SUCH AS RESTAURANTS, SUPERMARKETS, BOUTIQUES, CHEMISTS, LOCKSMITHS, AND PROPERTY LISTINGS AS WELL AS ADD-ON COMMERCIAL INFORMATION ON THE TWO COMPANIES WHICH COOPERATED WITH THE GOVERNMENT IN DEVELOPING THE SITES. POPE EMPHASIZED THAT THE DIGITAL BASE MAP WAS MULTI-PURPOSE AND COULD BE EXPLOITED MUCH MORE TO BETTER SERVE THE COMMUNITY.

title: BEIJING MISS INTERNET SELECTED
body: MISS INTERNET OF BEIJING WAS SELECTED LAST EVENING, AND SHE WILL GO ON TO THE NATIONAL CONTEST NEXT MONTH IN SHANGHAI. AS PART OF THE 2ND INTERNET CONTEST OF CHINA, "MISS INTERNET" AND THREE OTHER CONTESTS, "INTERNET KNOWLEDGE," "ENTERPRISE INFORMATION" AND "HOME ONLINE SHOPPING", BEGAN IN AUGUST. THE INTERNET CONTEST IS JOINTLY SPONSORED BY THE CHINESE YOUTH DEVELOPMENT FOUNDATION, CHINA TELECOM, AND THE INFORMATION ADVANCEMENT DEPARTMENT ATTACHED TO THE MINISTRY OF INFORMATION INDUSTRY. THE CONTEST AIMS TO POPULARIZE INTERNET AND PROMOTE THE APPLICATION OF THE INTERNET INCLUDING E-COMMERCE, SAID AN OFFICIAL WITH THE ORGANIZING COMMITTEE. THERE ARE NOW FOUR MILLION INTERNET USERS IN CHINA, BUT ONLY 15 PERCENT OF THEM ARE WOMEN, HE ADDED.

title: IBM AIMS AT TRANSMITTING WEB CONTENTS TO CELL PHONES
body: IBM CORP. SAID TUESDAY IT HAS FORMED A NEW DIVISION THAT WILL WORK WITH BUSINESS CLIENTS TO ENABLE THEM TO TRANSMIT THEIR WEB CONTENTS TO CELL PHONES. IBM PLANS TO TARGET COMPANIES SUCH AS BANKS THAT PROVIDE FINANCIAL SERVICES AND FIRMS USING INTERNAL BUSINESS APPLICATIONS, ACCORDING TO A REPORT FROM THE COMPANY. THE NEW DIVISION WILL USE A WIRELESS STANDARD CALLED WIRELESS APPLICATION PROTOCOL (WAP) WHICH WAS DEVELOPED BY MOTOROLA, ERICSSON AND NOKIA TO ALLOW INTERNET TEXT TO BE ACCESSED TO MOBILE PHONES, SAID THE REPORT. "WAP PHONES ARE REACHING THE MARKET NOW AND THERE ARE NOT THAT MANY SERVICES OUT THERE, BUT THE MARKET WILL EXPLODE AND DEMAND FOR OUR SERVICES WILL GROW," SAID MARK BREGMAN, AN IBM E-BUSINESS EXECUTIVE. "WE WANT TO BE IN THE RACE EARLY ON. WE'VE ALREADY GOT 100 CUSTOMERS IN THE PIPELINE." "IT'S STILL VERY EARLY DAYS FOR WAP BUT IT'S A BIT LIKE THE INTERNET IN THE 1980S. SO ONCE IT TAKES OFF, IT WILL MOVE VERY RAPIDLY," BREGMAN SAID.

title: CHINA'S FIRST IP PHONE CONFERENCE SYSTEM DEVELOPED
body: CHINA'S FIRST INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) PHONE CONFERENCE SYSTEM HAS BEEN DEVELOPED IN SHANGHAI, THE DEVELOPER ANNOUNCED TODAY. DURING A TEST TELECONFERENCE, CHINESE ENTREPRENEURS HELD TALKS AND SENT FAXES THROUGH THE INTERNET. THEY SAY THE SPEED OF THE IP PHONE IS HIGHER THAN THAT OF AN ORDINARY PHONE. EXPERTS PRAISED THE SYSTEM, DEVELOPED BY THE PRESTIGIOUS FUDAN UNIVERSITY, AS BEING EASY TO RUN AND COST-EFFECTIVE FOR BUSINESSES.

title: WIPO LAUNCHES VIRTUAL BOOKSHOP ON INTERNET
body: THE WORLD INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ORGANIZATION (WIPO) TUESDAY LAUNCHED A VIRTUAL BOOKSHOP TO SELL ITS PUBLICATIONS ON THE INTERNET. THE CLIENTS WILL GO TO ITS WEB SITE FROM WHICH IT IS POSSIBLE TO SELECT AND ORDER PAPER VERSIONS OF BOOKS AND PERIODICALS AND CD- ROMS, SAID WIPO IN A PRESS RELEASE. SOME 100 PUBLICATIONS IN A VARIETY OF LANGUAGES MAY BE ORDERED NOW FROM THE ELECTRONIC BOOKSHOP, WITH THE CONTENTS RANGING FROM INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY, COPYRIGHT, NEIGHBORING RIGHTS, PATENTS, MARKS AND TRADE-RELATED INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY TO LICENSING/FRANCHISING, INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS AND ARBITRATION/MEDIATION. THERE ARE ALSO A NUMBER OF DOWNLOADABLE FREE-OF-CHARGE GENERAL INFORMATION PRODUCTS. WIPO'S ELECTRONIC BOOKSHOP, EQUIPPED WITH A VIRTUAL SHOPPING CART FEATURE, ALLOWS THE SHOPPERS TO SUBMIT ORDERS AND TO PAY ON- LINE WITH MAJOR CREDIT CARDS. IT FUNCTIONS VIA A SECURE SERVER, USING THE SECURE SOCKET LAYER PROTOCOL (SSL) WHICH MEANS THAT THE INFORMATION IS ENCRYPTED AS IT IS TRANSMITTED OVER THE INTERNET.

title: BELGIUM SHOWS FASTEST INTERNET GROWTH IN EUROPE
body: BELGIUM SEES THE FASTEST GROWTH IN THE USE OF INTERNET IN EUROPE, A RECENT SURVEY RELEASED BY FABRIMETAL SAID SUNDAY. ON A LIST OF 16 WESTERN EUROPEAN COUNTRIES, BELGIUM RANKED THE 7TH POSITION THIS YEAR WITH 312,000 INTERNET ADDRESSES, WHILE IT RANKED THE 9TH IN 1998, ACCORDING TO THE SURVEY. MEANWHILE, BELGIUM IS ALSO ONE OF THE LEADING EUROPEAN COUNTRIES WITH FASTER ACCESS TO THE USE OF CABLE AND DIGITAL PHONE LINES, THE NEW INTERNET-RELATED TOOL OF TECHNOLOGIES. THE SURVEY SAID THAT THE LEADING COUNTRIES IN EUROPE IN INSTALLING INTERNET-RELATED CABLE MODEMS ARE THE NETHERLANDS, FRANCE, AUSTRIA AND BELGIUM. THE TELEPHONE TECHNOLOGY CALLED DIGITAL SUBSCRIBER LINE, OR DSL (ALSO CALLED ADSL OR XDSL FOR ITS VARIANTS), IS BEING INTRODUCED TO EUROPE TO IMPROVE THE EXISTING PHONE LINES TO SPEEDS OF 1.5 TO 8 MEGABITS PER SECOND. MOST EUROPEAN COUNTRIES ARE TESTING THE ESL SERVICES. ALCATEL SA, THE LEADING DSL MANUFACTURER IN EUROPE, SAID THAT OPERATORS IN SWEDEN, BRITAIN, FRANCE, AUSTRIA, SPAIN, ITALY AND BELGIUM ARE AMONG THOSE INSTALLING DSL EQUIPMENT. RECENTLY, BELGIUM HAS DEVELOPED DIGITAL CABLE LINES FOR INTERNET THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY.

title: HKE -- SCOTLAND-ENGLAND GAME TO GO LIVE ON NET
body: THE FIRST GAME BETWEEN SCOTLAND AND ENGLAND FOR THE EUROPEAN SOCCER CHAMPIONSHIPS PLAYOFF WILL BE BROADCAST LIVE OVER THE INTERNET, BRITISH SKY BROADCASTING AND THE SCOTTISH FOOTBALL ASSOCIATION SAID THURSDAY. IT WILL BE THE FIRST LIVE WEBCAST OF AN INTERNATIONAL FOOTBALL MATCH. FANS IN THE UK AND IRELAND WILL BE ABLE TO WATCH FREE, APART FROM THE COST OF THE TELEPHONE LINE, PROVIDED THEY HAVE INTERNET ACCESS. BSKYB SAID AN UNPRECEDENTED AMOUNT OF BANKWIDTH WOULD BE USED TO CARRY THE BROADCAST AND THE PICTURE SIZE WILL BE STANDARD FOR THE INTERNET, ABOUT 2INS BY 3INS. THE MATCH CAN BE ACCESSED ON WWW.SKYSPORTS.CO.UK/SKYSPORTS/ FOOTBALL/EURO2000.

title: HOLLYWOOD LAUNCHES DIGITAL FILM FESTIVAL
body: ORGANIZERS OF THE HOLLYWOOD FILM FESTIVAL AND THE INTERNET OUTFIT HOLLYWOOD NETWORK HAVE TEAMED UP TO LAUNCH A HOLLYWOOD DIGITAL FILM FESTIVAL, A MONTHLY ONLINE CONTEST STARTING IN JANUARY THAT WILL FOCUS ON DIGITAL MOVIEMAKING. "WE ARE TRYING TO BRIDGE THE GAP BETWEEN EMERGING FILMMAKERS, EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES AND ESTABLISHED HOLLYWOOD," SAID CARLOS DE ABREU, FOUNDER AND EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE HOLLYWOOD FILM FESTIVAL. FLICKS WILL BE VIDEO-STREAMED ON THE WEB AND VIEWERS WILL VOTE ON THEIR PICKS. EVERY MONTH, WINNERS WILL BE SHOWN THEATRICALLY AT PARAMOUNT STUDIOS, USING HIGH-END DIGITAL PROJECTORS PROVIDED BY BARCO, A SPONSOR OF THE ENTERPRISE. "FOR THE FIRST TIME, FILMMAKERS THAT SELECT TO MAKE MOVIES BY USING DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY WILL BE ABLE TO SHOWCASE THEIR WORK BOTH ONLINE AND IN HOLLYWOOD'S BACKYARD," DE ABREU SAID. EVERY FOUR WEEKS, HE SAID, A SELECTION COMMITTEE WILL CHOOSE UP TO THREE FILMS TO COMPETE ONLINE AS "DISCOVERY OF THE MONTH." THE WINNERS WILL QUALIFY AS FINALISTS IN THE FOURTH ANNUAL HOLLYWOOD FILM FESTIVAL, WHICH WILL TAKE PLACE NEXT YEAR AUGUST 2- 7.

title: IT COMPANIES HELP SMALL BUSINESSES LINK TO INTERNET
body: AS SMALL BUSINESSES BECOME MORE DYNAMIC IN CHINA, INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANIES ARE PAYING PARTICULAR ATTENTION TO THE MARKET. TWO OF THE LARGEST IT COMPANIES IN THE WORLD, IBM AND MICROSOFT, BROUGHT TO BEIJING THIS MONTH THEIR LATEST RESOLUTION SCHEMES ESPECIALLY SUITED TO SMALL BUSINESSES. CHINA NOW HAS MORE THAN 10 MILLION SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED FIRMS WHICH GENERATE 30 PERCENT OF THE TOTAL INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT. "WE ARE VERY CONCERNED WITH THE INTERNET AND INTRANET CONSTRUCTION OF SMALL BUSINESSES BECAUSE OF THEIR STRATEGIC POSITION," SAID CHEN YILIANG, PRESIDENT OF THE HP (CHINA) CO. LTD.  ". "THEY ARE LISTED HIGH ON OUR BUSINESS AGENDA." HP HAS SUPPORTED THE STATE ECONOMIC AND TRADE COMMISSION IN A PROJECT PROMOTING THE INTERNET CONSTRUCTION OF SMALL BUSINESSES SINCE MAY THIS YEAR. WANG ZHONGMING, DIRECTOR OF THE TRAINING DEPARTMENT OF THE SETC, SAID THE PROJECT AIMS TO INFORM SMALL BUSINESSES HOW TO USE ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY TO COMPETE ON THE INTERNATIONAL MARKET.

title: U.S. NEWSPAPER BANS TOBACCO ADS
body: THE BOSTON GLOBE, A UNIT OF THE NEW YORK TIMES CO., BECAME ONE OF A SMALL BUT GROWING GROUP OF unitedstates NEWSPAPERS TO BAN ADVERTISEMENTS FOR TOBACCO PRODUCTS ON THURSDAY, THE GLOBE SAID. "WE CAN NO LONGER JUSTIFY CARRYING ADVERTISEMENTS THAT PROMOTE A PRODUCT WHEN THE HARM IT CAUSES IS SO EVIDENT," THE GLOBE'S PUBLISHER, RICHARD H. GILMAN, SAID IN A WRITTEN STATEMENT THURSDAY. "EVEN THOUGH TOBACCO REMAINS LEGAL, ITS EFFECT ON PUBLIC HEALTH IS CLEAR," GILMAN ADDED. RELATIVELY FEW unitedstates NEWSPAPERS NOW REJECT TOBACCO PRODUCT ADS, THE GLOBE SAID. AMONG THOSE THAT WILL NOT ACCEPT SUCH ADS ARE THE GLOBE'S PARENT NEW YORK TIMES, THE HONOLULU STAR-BULLETIN, CHRISTIAN SCIENCE MONITOR, AND SEATTLE TIMES. THE GLOBE'S BAN IS EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY FOR ITS NEWSPAPER PAGES, AND JANUARY 1 FOR PRE-PRINTED SECTIONS PUBLISHED BY OTHERS AND CARRIED IN THE GLOBE.

title: internet cuts into new zealand post's profit
body: the internet rising popularity has cut the number of letters people are sending and contributed to a one-fifth drop in new zealand post's profits.  the state-owned postal service thursday unveiled a tax-paid profit of 11.7 million nz dollars (six million unitedstates dollars) for the second and third quarters of this year, 18.8 percent lower than for the corresponding two quarters of last year.  the number of letters sent dropped partly because of a switch from mail to email, nz post said in a media release.  it is reported that the internet usage has risen dramatically in the country, with half of new zealanders now claiming access to the internet, up from less than a fifth three years ago.

title: ne china province opens governmental web sites
body: the government of northeast china's liaoning province opened its website on the internet today.  now, when someone types ln.gov.cn into the internet browser, he will enter the on-line office of zhang guoguang, governor of liaoning, and can send him an email or have an on-line talk with him.  the province has also opened a multimedia website at lngov.  cninfo.net. the main contents of the websites include brief introductions to the province and provincial leaders, the governor's speeches, governmental documents, and explanations of laws.  during a tele-conference today celebrating the opening of the websites, the governor said that the internet can open government affairs to the public and improve governmental services.  it will also introduce liaoning to the world and attract overseas investors, the governor added.  governments at all levels in liaoning are scheduled to set up websites by the end of next year, and then a basic model of an " electronic government" will have come into being in the province.  now, more than half of the local governments at various levels in china have established websites.

title: japan to promote use of internet through millennium festival
body: the japanese government unveiled a plan late friday that it will hold a yearlong festival from late 2000 to promote the use of the internet, the kyodo news service reported.  the new millennium gate year festa is intended to encourage dissemination of information via internet from local governments and elsewhere, japan's economic planning agency chief taichi sakaiya told a late friday night press conference.  ideas for events will be solicited from local governments and the private sector, sakaiya said, adding that the government will seek appropriations from the second supplementary budget for this fiscal year for the initiative.  as part of an economic renewal plan to be formulated next week, the government is considering providing internet access to all public primary and secondary schools in japan, sakaiya said.  the top japanese economic planner said he hopes to see the use of the internet among the population increase by 10 percentage points from the current 10 percent.

title: australian stock market loses 0.5 percent
body: the australian share market ended the week down 0.5 percent on friday, pushed lower by market heavyweights national australia bank (nab) and news corp.  the benchmark all ordinaries index closed 15.7 points lower at 2919.8, after earlier slipping to 2911.8.  the all industrials index declined by 28.4 points to 5083.4 while the all resources index lost 5.3 points to 1211.7.  australia's largest bank, nab, continued to be punished for thursday's disappointing results, dropping 90 cents to 23.55 australian dollars.  the beneficiaries on friday were nab's fellow majors, westpac and anz. westpac gained 13.4 cents to 10.584 australian dollars and anz gained 20.1 cents to 11.521 australian dollars.  the commonwealth bank lost 26.4 cents to 26.516 australian dollars.  rupert murdoch's news corp shed 22 cents to 11.92 australian dollars.  national turnover was 481.82 million valued at 1.27 billion australian dollars (838 million unitedstates dollars), with 682 falls and 617 rises and 423 stocks steady.

title: number of internet users in south korea on sharp rise
body: the number of internet users has been rising sharply in south korea, with time spent on the internet also increasing.  according to the statistics issued by the ministry of information and communication, the number of internet users hit 3.  1 million at the beginning of this year and doubled to six million at the end of october.  meanwhile, the number of internet hosts for every 10,000 users increased from 43.6 at the end of last year to 63.2 at the end of june, 1999 statistics show south korean users spent an average of 37 minutes on the internet in june, ten minutes more than they did in december, 1998.  while more time was spent on the internet, the use of online communication services declined in comparison. in june, online communication users logged on for an average of 39 minutes daily, slightly down from 41 minutes recorded last year.  the statistics also revealed that more time is being spent calling overseas in the country, with 1,526 minutes per 100 persons spent talking to someone abroad in 1996, 2,095 minutes spent at the end of last year and 557 minutes in the first quarter of this year.

title: major news items in leading australian newspapers
body: the following are major news items in leading australian newspapers wednesday.  the australian: --australia would suffer a "loss of self-respect" if it rejected a republic, news corporation chairman and chief executive rupert murdoch said in an interview.  the sydney morning herald: --australian olympic minister michael knight has launched a snap inquiry into the sydney olympics ticketing fiasco, throwing a cloud over the future of top organizing committee officials, including the chief executive officer, sandy hollway.  the australian financial review: --the reserve bank of australia and federal treasury are at odds over the strength of the economy and the size of any slowdown early next year, with the latter unconvinced of the need to raise interest rates.

title: kuwaiti bank launches first internet shopping card
body: the national bank of kuwait (nbk), in cooperation with the international visa credit card co., launched on tuesday the world's first credit card to be used only for internet shopping.  general manager for consumer banking at nbk, adel al-majid, said "electronic commerce is the new market for the buying and selling of goods and the internet shopping card (isc) was mainly made to encourage customers to make safe purchases on the internet." nbk would guarantee all internet purchases made with the isc against any misuses, majid was quoted by the kuwait news agency as saying.  he said the isc includes spending limits, automatic insurance from nbk for all purchases made with the card.  isc users can also enjoy 5 percent discount on purchases through nbk-affiliated "souk al-watani (national markets)." there are about 420,000 internet users in the gulf arab countries, of which 66,000 are kuwaitis.

title: thailand's web serfers get lower service rate
body: a leading internet service provider of thailand announced tuesday it has adjusted its service charge rate for the subscribers, allowing them to surf the world of the cyberspace at the same price but more hours.  ksc commercial internet said that it has provided the new package of the internet service since november 1, allowing the premium subscribers to pay 800 baht (20.8 unitedstates dollars) per 40 hours of service usage, up from the earlier 20 hours.  the company also provided a new rate of service charge to the economy subscribers at 450 baht (11.7 dollars) per 30 hours, up from 15 hours.  meanwhile the company launched the campaign "free internet-free email" to grant its email users free email service and several hours free internet service.  in thailand internet users usually buy time of internet service from service provider.

title: dalian launches traffic website
body: the dalian traffic administrative bureau in liaoning province has recently launched its traffic website on the internet. the website address www. dlutc.gov.cn, will provide information on the city's traffic conditions. automatic traffic lights, video supervision, digital communication, wireless paging, data collection and analysis are part of the website's functions, said officials. the city's traffic has greatly improved in the past few years due to upgrading of technologies and advanced management. the average speed of buses in the city is above 35 km, and traffic jams rarely occur.

title: digital library services in jiangsu
body: east china's jiangsu province is introducing digital technique into its libraries to give more people access to the internet.  the province has recently initiated a three year digital library project which aims at building a regional information network.  supported by a computerized network, the digital library will include a number of databases on historical documents, cultural and scientific achievements, geographic and weather video materials. china's major networks will be linked to the project.  jiangsu province will also have a number of websites on education, electronic business, government affairs and information technology.

title: china's first on-line auction house opens
body: china's first on-line auction house started trading today, providing buyers with an opportunity to own a miniature titanic which was used for the movie, one of michael jordan's jerseys, and ancient chinese stamps. during a trial run a month ago, the website: www.a2z-mart.com, was heavily visited by surfers, according to the operators. any individual or business can freely register at the website and advertise purchase and sales information there, they said. the site also prepares special services for its clients by putting their information onto its homepage. cooperating with world-famous auctioneer greg manning auction inc. and spain's afinsa group, a2z-mart specializes in auctions and related services. the annual output value of china's fledgling electronic business has reached 40 million unitedstates dollars, and experts predict that it will reach four billion unitedstates dollars in the next several years. the number of china's websites has doubled in the past six months, and the recently announced overall price cut by the ministry of information industry is likely to further spur the development of electronic business.

title: two-thirds of u.s. net users plan online shopping for holiday season
body: a survey of unitedstates internet users released monday found that 68 percent of them plan to buy online this holiday season.  meanwhile, only 36 percent of those polled said that they purchased online last holiday season.  unitedstates leading marketing information provider the npd group polled 4,600 individuals. goods listed by those polled that they plan to purchase online during the holiday season include clothing, toys, video games, and beauty products like cosmetics and fragrances.  up to 69 percent of the internet users polled say that they will still buy apparel offline and 76 percent plan to purchase beauty products in bricks-and-mortar stores.  an earlier report from unitedstates market research firm dataquest expected worldwide electronic commerce this holiday season to surpass 12.2 billion unitedstates dollars, up from 4.5 billion dollars in 1998.  the unitedstates will dominate online holiday shopping with 70 percent of the world's e-commerce revenue during the holiday season.  europe is projected to account for 15.5 percent of the revenue, while asia-pacific gets 7 percent, according to dataquest.

title: major news items in leading indian newspapers
body: the following are major news items in leading indian newspapers friday.  the times of india: --moving at breakneck speed, the government of atal behari vajpayee thursday cleared a slew of long-pending legislations for tabling in parliament "as soon as possible" to put economic reforms on the fast track.  the hindu: --the ban on pakistan tv, imposed during the kargil conflict, is to be lifted, information and broadcasting minister arun jaitley announced thursday. the hindustan times: --the vajpayee government proposed introducing a new information technology bill that would allow the enactment of cyber laws to regulate internet-related activities, including electronic communication, e-commerce and information highways-based commercial transactions.

title: internet festival kicks off at beijing universities
body: a cultural festival aimed at wiping out internet illiteracy among university students kicked off here yesterday at china's prestigious beijing university.  a series of activities including lectures, a digital forum and on-line article soliciting, will be held on the campuses of 12 major beijing universities.  despite the surging number of internet users in the country, a staggering 23.8 percent of beijing university students have never used computer networks, including the internet, according to a recent survey conducted by the university.  the survey also found that those students who do have access to computer networks use them mainly for sending and receiving email.  to help students catch up with the information age, beijing university has allocated special funds to connect student dormitories with fiber optics and give every dormitory internet access.

title: confucius website launched
body: the world's first website devoted to confucius, china's ancient thinker and educator, is now on the internet. six sections, including an introduction to the life of confucius, confucian works, and well-known remarks of confucius, can be accessed at: http://www.china kongzi.com. the site is co-sponsored by the government of qufu city and the telecommunications bureau of jining city in east china's shandong province, where confucius was born and lived. the new site is part of a program to celebrate the 2,550th anniversary of confucius' birth. an exhibition on confucius has also opened in qufu recently and will remain open permanently. confucius (551 b.c.-479 b.c.) is regarded as one of china's greatest thinkers and educators, and the confucian school of thought that developed from his ideas has had a great influence on china's political, cultural and social life for thousands of years.

title: internet advertising spending up 80 percent
body: the advertising spending on 300 web sites rose 80 percent to 359.4 million unitedstates dollars in the first quarter of 1999, with computer and software makers, on-line and internet services companies leading the charge, according to a report released on friday.  microsoft corp. and ibm corp. were the leading advertisers, said intermedia advertising solutions.  credit card giant first usa, in the no. 3 spot, boosted its internet advertisement spending by 614 percent to 4.3 million dollars, followed by general motors corp., up 159 percent at 4.1 million dollars, and att corp., up 140.3 percent at four million dollars.  dell computer corp., in the 10th spot, registered the largest percentage increase in the three months, with spending up 2,787 percent from the 1998 period, at 2.6 million dollars.  "the numbers clearly indicate that the internet has become a viable advertising medium," joe philport, president of ias, said in a statement accompanying the findings.

title: nigeria to promote trade via internet
body: information on nigeria's petroleum, solid minerals and agriculture products would be launched on the internet very soon, according to the country's vice president atiku abubakar.  the vanguard, a major nigerian newspaper, wednesday quoted abubakar as saying that foreign investors wishing to get information on investment opportunities in nigeria will soon find it on the internet.  he, however, said that the date for the launching would be fixed by the minister of commerce mustapha abubakar.  nigerian air force currently is using the internet to sell its retired combat aircraft.

title: intel, microsoft form ties with beijing software company
body: senior executives from the beijing offices of computer giants intel and microsoft have announced they are forming marketing and technological ties with anyi, a beijing software company.  the decisions were made public here today at the debut ceremony for anyi's "2000 internet financial management software." anyi computer and accounting company, a financial and business management software company under the ministry of finance, developed its "anyi 2000" for internet application, said anyi president yan shaoye.  attending the ceremony were representatives from government departments and executives from some 400 companies.  it was learned that intel and anyi will jointly launch a marketing campaign to promote e-commerce technologies, and that microsoft has established a "strategic partnership" with the beijing-based software company by offering technological support and staff training.

title: u.s. online energy industry powered by exchanges
body: as online energy trade flows through internet marketplaces, new market forces will reshape the natural gas and electricity industries, a unitedstates research firm reported monday.  forrester research predicted that by 2004, electronic marketplaces in the unitedstates will propel online energy sales to 266 billion unitedstates dollars by bringing about higher levels of efficiency in wholesale markets and enabling energy buyers to understand market data on a deeper level.  forrester's report "the surge of online energy" found that the ability of energy buyers and sellers to find each other on the internet is radically changing long-established patterns of energy trade. in this new environment, the report said, price competition will supplant trade based on phone calls and personal relationships, pitting providers against each other in online bidding wars. to gain market share, providers will be forced to expand their geographic trading arenas, introduce new product-service bundles and employ innovative marketing and branding strategies.  according to forrester, new marketplace models will dominate online trade, including exchanges, aggregators, auction and bid system. the majority of online energy trade will executed via exchanges, because they fulfill buy-and-sell needs for online industry players. sales passing through exchanges will surge to 171 billion dollars in 2004 by providing wholesalers --the largest sector in energy --with real-time market information and quick fulfillment.  bid systems will win big in the commercial and industrial sectors, forrester said, as large companies increasingly use the internet to automate their request for proposal and request for quote processes.  by 2004, forrester expects bid systems to capture 16.5 percent of online business trade.  although there is little e-commerce activity in retail energy markets today, forrester said, the deregulation of electricity will pave the way for aggregators to streamline purchase by concentrating many energy catalogs for buyer groups. forrester expects aggregators to account for 25 billion dollars in 2004, or 11 percent of total retail business trade.  forrester's report is based on interviews with 50 firms that already buy or sell natural gas over the internet, in addition to technology vendors, energy intermediaries, energy experts and regulators. two-thirds of the companies interviewed indicated that they were lured online by the availability of real-time market-pricing information.

title: nepal opens greeting system on internet
body: nepal home page, one of the popular website for information and links related to nepal, has opened an electronic greeting card system that enables users to send and receive electronic greetings to and from any person on the internet, the kathmandu post reported wednesday.  the paper said that this system has been brought up for upcoming dashain and tihar festivals which falls on october 16-24.  the nepal home page is designed and maintained by the yomari information center of nepal.

title: hka092848 --hk's first internet data center launched
body: digital island, one of the leading providers of network services for globalizing e-business applications, announced here wednesday the launch of hongkong's first internet data center for global e-business as part of the company's expansion into asia.  underscoring digital island's commitment to the region, the company, headquartered in san francisco, california, established a permanent asia pacific headquarters in hongkong.  "our expanded presence in hongkong extends digital island's application hosting and content distribution service into one of the largest potential markets for e-business," said ruann ernst, president and chief executive officer of digital island.  idc research expects the asian e-business market to more than quadruple over the next three years to surpass 7.5 billion unitedstates dollars by 2001.  digital island's hongkong data center is designed to serve companies in the asia-pacific region with requirements for outbound content distribution, and companies elsewhere that want to penetrate that region, ernst said.

title: britain launches world's first virtual zoo
body: a british animal park on monday launched what was billed as the world's first virtual zoo. net surfers can zoom in on www.howletts.net to see wild animals roaming their enclosure at howletts wild animal park in southeast england, the reuters reported. six cameras enable internet users to observe the world's biggest captive gorilla colony, african elephants, siberian tigers and bongos, a species of african antelope. "howletts' crusade to preserve rare and endangered wildlife attracts global recognition," the agency quoted internet entrepreneur damian aspinall, son of howletts founder john aspinall, as saying. "we want people around the world to see the animals' excellent conditions in real time and learn about our unique breeding achievements. no other animal park or zoo can match this virtual live experience," he added.

title: somali company provides internet services
body: aerolite somalia telecommunications company has now started providing the internet services to its clients for the first time in somalia's history despite the lack of central administration.  the olympic computers network administrator, ibrahim abdulkadir sheikh, said monday the company has now launched its first ever campaign in installing the internet for all those interested people and agencies.  ibrahim said the first 25 people will have started enjoying the internet services this week in mogadishu, the country's capital, making the total number of those benefiting from the new services nearly 100 nationwide.

title: sixty percent of china's businesspeople use internet: survey
body: sixty percent of the businesspeople in china are using the internet, according to a recent survey conducted by the chinese edition of fortune magazine.  about 95 percent of those people in china who haven't yet used the internet plan to do so.  among the 60 percent of the businesspeople currently using the internet, 56 percent log-on at their offices, 43 percent go online at home, and 21 percent do so at both places.  ninetysix percent of those polled cited the internet as a useful source of business information.  sixtyone percent said that the companies they work for have homepages, among which industries sectors including transportation, law, tourism and hotels contribute are the majority. nearly 50 percent of the state-owned enterprises have homepages, while most, about 56 percent, of private and collective companies do not.  ninetythree percent believe that the internet will play an vital role in their business development in the future.

title: india ranks first in internet reliability in asia
body: a traffic report on performing index ranking internet service solutions on quality and reliability of their networks has placed india as number one in asia.  a report by andover news network is based on the data system maintained by the state-owned videsh sanchar nigram limited (vsnl), according to asia.internet.com.  compared with an average packet loss of 10 percent and response time of 560 milliseconds overall for asia, india has zero packet loss and a response time of 453 milliseconds.  vsnl chairman and managing director amitabh kumar said the growth of the internet in india will exceed 3 million users in a year's time.  there are now more than 1.5 million internet users in india.

title: india's nse to offer net trading from december
body: india's national stock exchange (nse) will offer internet-based stock trading facility in the country from december, according to a nse official.  ravi narain, nse's deputy managing director, said in calcutta tuesday, "whether the e-commerce legislation is put in place or not, we are going to start internet-based trading within three months from now." if things go as planned, retail investors can place their purchase and sell deals on the net in three months. the order will be automatically executed by the broker through a recognized stock exchange.  the system has benefits for both investors and brokers. the inter-mediaries will be able to accept small orders from a large number of retail or even institutional investors.

title: electronic flea market in shanghai
body: the sale of secondhand personal items via the internet is getting popular in shanghai. there are more than 20,000 registered subscribers, and well over 5,000 items have been posted for sale since the website address: www.eachnet.com was initiated on august 18. more than 700 items were sold through the on-line flea market where local trading and traditional ways of paying are combined, said local sources. to standardize performance of the on-line flea market, a system of evaluating the credibility of buyers and sellers is also functioning. on-line auctions will also be held as the method of electronic payment is improved, said the sources.

title: e-congratulations on prc's 50th anniversary
body: development of the internet has made it easy for chinese and overseas people to extend their best wishes to the folks at home on the 50th anniversary of the people's republic of china (prc). the website address www.prc50.gov.cn started on september 1 by the preparatory committee for prc's 50th anniversary has been flooded with congratulatory messages. on the day the site opened, well over 400 net surfers expressed their blessings and good wishes. some of them also said they hoped for an early reunification of the motherland.

title: survey: 1.5 million net users in india
body: the internet continues to be the fastest growing medium in india.  according to the indian readership survey 1999, as of june 30, there were 1.527 million internet users in the country.  on the reach of media in rural and urban areas, it said that while newspapers reached 32.9 percent of the population, television reached 47.2 percent, radio 17.7 percent and cinema 12.8 percent.  although television's reach has increased across all town classes, it is not very high.  the reach of television varies from 84.8 percent in 1 million population-plus cities to 29.1 percent for the below-1000 population towns.

title: britain sees doubling of online shopping
body: online shopping has doubled in the past year in britain, said an annual survey carried out by which?online, the internet arm of uk consumers' association.  the survey of 2,000 people across britain showed that 58 percent of those who had been online for more than two years had bought something.  it also found books, flights and holidays have taken over from computer hardware and software as the most popular products being sold.  it is estimated that 10 million people in britain, about one-sixth of the population, are now using the internet. but it appears that the high cost of phone calls continues to limit the amount of time the surfers spent online.  the survey showed that three-quarters of users surf the internet for five hours or less a week and visit on average 13 websites a week.

title: hong kong youngsters enjoy free internet service
body: youngsters in the hongkong sar can enjoy computer facilities and internet service free of charge as from this summer holiday, said the hongkong social welfare department on saturday.  according to the department, children and young people aged between six and 24 are welcome to visit any of the 125 youth and community service centers to enjoy the free service.  the service is provided under the four-year project of " enhancement use of information technology in community facilities" with a subsidy of over 27 million hk dollars (3.46 unitedstates million dollars).  commencing the service in late july, the project is aimed to provide more opportunities for children and young people, especially those coming from less well-off families, to get access to information technology outside school, and to develop their potential to face the challenge of the new information era.

title: xi'an launches investment website
body: xi'an, capital of northwest china's shaanxi province, has launched a new website in both chinese and english featuring 200 cooperative projects in need of funding. by accessing the site at (www.xainvest.gov.cn), internet users will be able to obtain detailed information about the city, its investment regulations, profitable policies for investors, and investment procedures. the city government of xi'an and related departments will be the major information providers for the new website.

title: school opens simulated e-commerce company
body: the beijing foreign trade school today set up a simulated version of an e-commerce company, giving students the opportunity to learn the intricacies of the emerging electronic business on the internet.  the "company," equipped with 40 computers, will be linked to other simulated counterparts across the world via the net.  e-commerce first emerged in developed countries and has flourished because of its cost-effectiveness and efficiency. so far, there are reportedly 2,700 simulated e-commerce firms in europe alone.

title: website for second-hand vehicles unveiled in india
body: bombay-based indian auto giant mahindra's information technology arms tuesday launched a website for trading second-hand vehicles in internet.  according to a pti report wednesday, the website will evolve itself into an electronic exchange of used vehicles in india.  the website has been developed in a short span of one month and has 2,000 vehicles from 25 cities including 700 from delhi listed on it.  it will soon enter into valued-added services like insurance and vehicle registration.

title: merchant bank of china opens on-line services
body: merchant bank of china, one of the country's major banking institutions, opened its full-scaled on-line services today by signing e-business contracts with three domestic clients.  bank president ma weihua told xinhua that in 1997 his bank became the first in the country to open a website, and has since been developing its on-line business step by step.  to date, the bank has on-line services including payment, stock trading and shopping. by the end of july, 371 institutional clients had enjoyed the bank's on-line services, with a total trading volume of 2.7 billion yuan.  customers now can even buy lottery and air ticket, make donations, and order hotel rooms via the internet, ma said.  official figures show that china now has some four million internet users, and many local enterprises are now doing on-line business.

title: gender gap exists in u.s. internet usage
body: men and women in the unitedstates approach the internet with a different mind-set, according to an on-line survey released wednesday.  most women tend to check email and gather information about a topic of interest on the web more often than men, while men are twice as likely to go to the web to transfer or download files than women, said the survey report from pc data, a leading internet research firm specializing in web audience measurement.  the firm had reportedly surveyed more than 2,800 internet users in early august.  eighty percent of women are more likely to surf the web with a specific task or objective in mind than men, and are more likely to use page links as both a navigation method and a source for site information. men are more likely to use search engines for navigation and site information.  in addition, men and women shop for different items on the web.  men are more likely to purchase computer software and hardware.  women are more likely to use the internet to shop for greeting cards and music. both men and women are equally interested in shopping for books on-line.

title: website for national day celebrations
body: an official website through which china's national day celebration activities will be broadcast live was put into service today. the website, "www.prc50.gov.com," was jointly developed by the preparatory committee of celebrations for the 50th anniversary of the founding of the people's republic of china, people's daily, xinhua news agency, china central tv station, and the beijing municipal information industrialization office. internet surfers visiting the website will be able to gain some knowledge about the notable economic, social and cultural achievements that china has made over the past five decades, and immediate up-to-date information about the arrangements and plans for celebration activities to be held. the planned grand ceremony, the military parade and the mass parade on october 1, will be broadcast live through the internet.

title: israeli companies trying to develop technology for internet touch sensation
body: as shopping over the internet gains popularity, more and more consumers want to know how the products feel that they are thinking of buying.  in order to meet this demand, a number of israeli high technology companies are working on realistic tactile sensation technology, the latest issue of israel business today magazine said.  this technology will give an internet user the ability to feel the texture of a pair of corduroy pants or to test drive a new car, feeling how it takes the curves, or accelerates.  using this technology, almost all touch sensation can be simulated, the magazine said.  companies working on realistic tactile sensation are reportedly following up on work originally done by stanford university and the unitedstates national aeronautics agency for force feedback technology.  israeli companies are using broadband technology and fast internet transmission, in a hope to achieve the super quick date exchange rates needed to bring this new sensation technology to market.

title: e-commerce threat to uk revenues
body: internet shopping by britons could cost the inland revenue of the british government up to 10 billion pounds (16 billion unitedstates dollars) in lost taxes each year, according to a report published on monday.  the taxman is already missing out on possible vat payments from the huge amounts of music and software bought and downloaded electronically from suppliers based overseas, the report said.  a report by the institute of directors (iod) says that as the internet encourages more people to buy goods from overseas, the tax shortfall will spiral. the report follows a survey from the nop research group, which found that the uk is undergoing an e-commerce explosion.  it found that almost 1.5 million people in the uk shopped on the internet in the four weeks to 1 june this year, spending 239 million pounds (382 million unitedstates dollars).  this was a 44 percent increase on the numbers identified in a similar survey in december.  and spending on online shopping in the uk will rise from about 3 billion pounds (4.8 billion unitedstates dollars) this year to about 9.5 billion pounds (16 billion unitedstates dollars) by the end of 2001, nop suggested.

title: mideast prone to internet crimes
body: the middle east, particularly the gulf region, could be an easy target of internet crimes, said the gulf news daily on sunday.  financial and other crimes perpetrated through the web could affect the middle east more than other regions due to the relative inexperience of internet end-users in the region, experts warned.  they added that the perceived threats posed by the net, including fears of lower company productivity due to staff surfing the net during office hours, or fears of credit card fraud, has partially slowed the move toward e-commerce.
