body: financial organizations in hangzhou, capital of east china's zhejiang province, have begun providing banking services over the internet.  people with accounts can do their shopping and make payments through the "internet banks", which provide information on different kinds of goods. businesses connected to these banks are mostly bookstores and supermarkets.  they also help account holders get information about their accounts and other banking services and deals between enterprises can be handled in a similar way.

title: china opens cultural-relics website
body: china has created its first cultural-relics website on the internet. as an official website, china cultural relics releases information, communicates with other organizations and publicizes china's achievements in cultural relics protection, an official with the state bureau of cultural relics said here today. internet surfers will be able to obtain a wide array of information on relics protection in china, the official said. the website also makes available four important laws and regulations concerning cultural relics, such as the law on protection of cultural relics, rules for the implementation of the law on protection of cultural relics, administrative regulations on underwater cultural relics protection, and a dministrative measures governing archeological work involving foreign interests. some specific information, including world heritage sites in china, key units for cultural relics protection, famous historical and cultural cities and substantial archeological finds, are also listed on the website, at: http://www.nuch.gov.cn.

title: india railways launches website
body: indian railways officially launched its website on the internet here tuesday to make its functioning transparent and provide relevant information to the public.  "the website will not only provide useful information including train schedules to people across the globe but also play a significant role in enhancing efficiency and professionalism in the organization," railway minister nitish kumar said at a launching ceremony.  the increasing use of latest information technology would enable the railways to meet the needs and aspirations of the people and play a crucial role in the process of development, he said.  he said greater attention would be paid to induction of high-tech equipment in the railways which cover 62,000 kilometers.  the website covers subjects like evolution of indian railways, passenger services, information of tourist interest, corporate overview, salient features of railway budget 1998-99, time-table inquiries, special trains and purchase and tenders details.  kumar said the computerized passenger reservation system now catered to about 95 percent of the total reservation work load.

title: u.s. to launch world's largest online college bookstore
body: an online bookstore will offer american college students up to 110,000 textbook titles and other required course material, follett corporation, a unitedstates company announced tuesday.  follett corporation, which has provided products and services to the educational marketplace for 125 years, said that the new service will be launched when the site efollett.com goes live in early january.  the company's high education group operates 585 campus bookstores in the unitedstates and canada.  in january, students at 450 academic institutions can make online ordering.  follett will have all 585 stores it operates online by the end of february. the company expects to add more than 500 independent campus bookstores as its partners by the fall.

title: china radio international joins internet
body: china radio international (cri) is offering five language training programs --english, german, spanish, standard chinese (putonghua) and cantonese --on the internet. the programs commenced on december 26 on the new cri website (www.cri.com.cn.). the homepage will also offer color photographs and special features such as "china's implementation of reform and opening-up over the past 20 years" and "welcoming macao's return to the motherland." the homepage is also linked to a number of websites such as "china", "china's tibet" and "china society for human rights studies", as three magazines run by the state council's information office.

title: new zealand bank puts accounts online for customers
body: bankdirect, an auckland-based bank, is acclaiming a new zealand first for a new service that allows customers to use their personal computers to see where their money is going.  the latest issue of new zealand infotech weekly quotes general manager jane freeman of the bank as describing the move as also a "significant development in internet electronic banking".  from this week, customers with computers running microsoft money software are able to download their accounts and analyze transactions by category.  customers can, for example, find out how much they have spent on shopping in a supermarket over a given period with a few keystrokes. according to the weekly, bankdirect has "endless plans" to extend its internet service.

title: on-line bookstore to open in shanghai
body: the "shanghai book city -visa on-line bookstore" will open in shanghai at the end of december and become the first in china to sell books over the internet.  internet surfers holding visa credit cards will be able to visit the on-line bookshop's website and browse and purchase whatever they like. the store then will deliver the books ordered to the buyer's home as soon as possible.  the on-line shop was jointly developed by the shanghai branch of the bank of china, the bank of china credit card inc. ltd., and the visa international service association.  the ibm standard electronic security system will be applied to the website to eliminate transaction risks.  the shanghai book city is a 27-storey building in downtown shanghai covering 40,000 square meters of floor space.  it holds more than 150,000 books and audio and video products and electronic publications.

title: shandong hospital plugs into internet
body: the provincial hospital of east china's shandong province has completed an information-technology project which allows it to provide medical and public health services on the internet.  a wide range of information about medical treatment and considerable amounts of medical data is now on-line for use by patients, doctors and medical experts worldwide.  patients will also be able to 'surf the worldwide web' for information about domestic and foreign hospitals, as well as for help on existing and new treatments for illnesses.

title: finnish firm integrates telephone service with internet
body: finland's leading telecom company sonera on wednesday launched a new communications network incorporating functions of the modern internet and the traditional telephone grid.  for the first time, internet multimedia applications as well as intelligent telephone services can be used and managed by the end user through one web interface, which offers potential cost savings for customers, the company said.  the new network provides "a unified platform for next generation communications applications that combine voice and data," said sonera's chief technology officer mika uusitalo.  sonera's new service, now in pilot phase until next spring, covers major cities in finland and neighboring sweden. nationwide coverage in both countries is planned for next year.  sonera ltd. employs 8,500 people with subsidiaries and associated companies in 14 countries.

title: s.korean presidential security office to go on-line
body: the presidential security office of south korea will open its own web site on the internet next monday, a spokesman for the office said thursday. the web site opening is part of the efforts by south korean president kim dae-jung to shake off the authoritarian image formed in the past governments, the spokesman said. organization, functions and duties of the presidential security office will be put on the web site. the web site will create a "dialogue forum" to which the public can send questions and suggestions regarding the office's activities. it will also offer some basics of "self-defense" techniques for women and youths. the web site, which is linked to the presidential palace chong wa dae web site, located at www.cwd.go.kr, can also be contacted directly at www.cwd.go.kr/security.

title: icrc launches new web site for online donation
body: the international committee of the red cross (icrc) has launched a new web site in english, www.helpicrc.org, and in french, www.helpcicr.org, to enable internet users to make contributions directly by credit card. "we get so many requests on our main site from people wanting to know how to give us money that we decided to set up a special site just for them," said ilona pongracz from the icrc's promotion and private fundraising division here tuesday. the icrc said that an encoding system for credit card numbers guarantees the security of all electronic donations. it will open a site in german soon.

title: new web site helps parents police internet
body: parents who have only just figured out how to switch a computer on have been given a helping hand with the launch of the "australian families guide to the internet" friday. developed by the australian broadcasting authority (aba), the site, located at www.aba.gov.au/family, provides parents with information on risks, parenting tips, suggested rules and information on technical tools. "the objective of the site is to provide parents and carers with information and tools so that they can guide their children toward a rewarding, productive and safe experience of the internet --even if they don't know much about the internet itself," aba chairman david flint said in a statement. "the internet is opening up a new world for children and is likely to change the way we communicate, entertain ourselves, study and work in the future. "this is a challenge for parents who may be struggling to keep abreast with these technological changes." and for parents who are still looking for that elusive switch, the aba has also produced a brochure with the information in a printed form.

title: latin american internet market to grow 16 percent
body: latin america's internet market is expected to grow 16 percent by the year 2000, compared to 10 percent at a world level.  but latin america cannot maintain the 20 percent growth rate it registered in 1997 in comparison with 1996, and the market is expected to grow 15 percent in 1998.  the paper said there were two million internet accounts by the middle of this year, and four million users of the information superhighway in the region.  brazil ranks the first among all the countries of the region with one million accounts and two million users, followed by mexico with 201,000 accounts and 403,000 users; and colombia with 130,000 accounts and 260,000 users.

title: parents seek medical aid for baby via internet
body: the parents of an eight-month-old child in hainan province, southern china, have sent an sos signal to the world through the internet seeking a cure for their baby's ailing heart. the baby was born with an opening three centimeters in diameter in his left chest. through a thin dark red membrane over the opening, the baby's beating heart is visible. according to the parents, the baby is often short of breath, his face has a greenish hue, and he easily catches cold. doctors in hainan say they have no reliable cure for the baby, and the success rate for surgery in cases like this is only about ten percent. with the help of the hainan digital telecommunication bureau, the parents have set up a website seeking domestic and foreign medical assistance. the website address is: http://www.hk.hi.cn/sos/sos.html. local sources say the telecommunications bureau has received many calls along with faxes and email expressing concern and sympathy, but so far, no information about medical aid.

title: clinton calls for internet help in adoption
body: unitedstates president bill clinton on tuesday called for internet assistance to bridge foster care centers and families to help 100,000 children join families.  "the internet holds the potential to shorten their wait, to make an on-line link between foster care centers and families looking to adopt," the president said at a white house ceremony.  "technology has given us an important tool and we should use it," he added.  clinton directed the department of health and human services to work with the courts and nonprofit agencies on a national internet registry of children legally eligible for adoption.  of the agencies that already have online services, the largest posts photos of just 1,000 waiting children.  house commerce committee chairman tom bliley took the ceremony as an occasion to press for an increase in the adoption tax credit, saying he would reintroduce legislation next year to increase the credit for adoption costs to 10,000 unitedstates dollars and make it permanent law.

title: internet site for late chinese president
body: china recently opened a site on the internet for late president liu shaoqi to mark the centenary anniversary of the birth of this great proletarian revolutionary. the website (www.lsq.org) was developed by the party literature research center of the communist party of china (cpc) central committee, and is the first to publicize the old generation of chinese proletarian revolutionaries. the site includes a biography, pictures, and research and information on liu shaoqi. with a large volume of information and pictures, the site will play an important role in introducing chinese revolutionaries to the world.

title: ugandan business directory launched on internet
body: uganda's pioneer business directory has been launched on the internet in a bid to open up the whole business community to the international market.  the ceremony was performed by minister of state for primary education francis babu here wednesday, uganda news agency reported.  once registered with yellow pages, the business community will not have to move all over the world to transit business physically. it can be accessed by 100 million people every day.  the minister urged the business community to move away from the old system to the electronic age.  there is no need to travel to dubai to order goods when they can be ordered and delivered through the use of the internet, he was quoted as saying.  stephen lange, the managing director of yellow pages, said the directory is being used as a reference book on uganda since it was started in 1990 with the largest information on investment, tourism, industry, government organizations and the private sector.

title: u.s. online retailing enjoys growth: study shows
body: while still in an emerging state, the online retail market in the unitedstates is enjoying robust growth, according to a study released wednesday.  the study, conducted by the trade association for unitedstates online retailers --shop.org --based on polls of 127 online retailers in seven categories, revealed that annual growth stood at 200 percent and the top 10 publicly traded online retailers have witnessed year-on-year revenue growth in excess of 160 percent.  it also found that while many consumers are visiting online retailers, few are buying.  online revenues generated by north american-based retailers for the first six months of 1998 were 4.4 billion unitedstates dollars, less than 1 percent of overall retail revenue, according to the study.  however, full year online revenues for retailers will surpass 13 billion.  online retailers are investing heavily now to expand their reach and customer bases, shop.org said in a related report. some 65 percent of the revenues generated through online services are reinvested in marketing and advertising, compared with 4 percent for most traditional stores.

title: chinese top film awards on internet
body: china's top film fair will be available over the internet when it is held in the city of chongqing, november 18-22. the 7th "golden rooster" and "one hundred flowers" festival has an internet address at: http://www.cq.cninf o.net/dyj. visitors can get detailed information about previous film fairs and awards and check news reports on the fair and visit a chat-room.

title: german internet market grows five-fold in
body: almost a billion unitedstates dollars worth of goods and services will be sold over the internet in germany this year --five times the volume of last year. this is the prognosis of one german-based union of internet businesses, which is published on sunday in cologne.  the basis of the estimate is a survey of members of the "eco electronic commerce forum" (eco forum e.v.), which conducts more than 80 percent of data transactions in germany.  according to eco, the german economy will invest over 300 million marks for commercial use of the internet this year.  private users will spend over 150 million dollars.  online advertising, media, tourism, banks, and insurance companies are other major contributors to the explosion in internet spending in germany.  the computer industry will benefit the most from the internet boom. producers of internet hardware and software earned almost 250 million dollars this year from customers who wanted to own the most up-to-date equipment.

title: uk sees dramatic rise in internet use
body: the last six months has seen an upsurge in the amount of adults using the internet in the uk, especially women, according to a new survey.  over a million more people have started to use the web, jumping from 5.9 million six months ago to 7 million now, said the survey carried out by internettrak.  when the survey first took place two years ago, a mere 14 percent of uk internet users were women.  that has dramatically risen to 40 percent of first time users now, and the figures are even higher for younger users, where 47 percent of 14 to 17 year olds are female, the survey has found.  "the large increase in the number of users in the last six months clearly demonstrates that the web is rapidly becoming a day-to-day information source in the uk," said shelaine green, european marketing director of yahoo, one of the companies to commission the survey.  one of the main reasons for the recent increase of uk internet users would be the drop in cost to surf the net with internet service providers beginning to give free access, analysts said.

title: compaq to develop direct-sales policy
body: unitedstates compaq computer, the largest manufacturer of personal computers in the world, will start selling its machines directly by telephone and over the internet at prices lower than those now charged by local dealers, sources close to the company said wednesday.  the aggressive schedule will help the huston-based computer maker reach the fast-growing small and medium-size business pc market.  the company is taking the step to fend off a potent rival, dell computer, which has always marketed its machines directly and now threatens compaq's market lead.  compaq has been losing market share to dell, pc market analysts said. the no. 3 computer giant has grown faster and been more profitable because of the efficiency of its direct-scales model.  meeting the challenge from dell, compaq adopted direct-sales policy to its largest customers earlier this year after it acquired digital equipment corp., which has a large direct-sales force.  the company tried to bypass dealers with an online catalog in 1993 but scrapped the plan in the face of dealer resistance.

title: shanghai opens 1st electronic on-line shop
body: two local companies in shanghai on tuesday opened the city's first on-line shop that accepts credit card payment from internet shoppers.  the buyers pay their bills by entering information such as credit-card number, purchaser's name, and merchandise code number.  the transaction is completed automatically via a coded payment module connected with outlets of the shanghai branch of the agricultural bank of china, the issuer of two credit cards that are accepted by the electronic shop.  the shop, which specializes in compact discs, is jointly operated by the shanghai edi industry co., ltd. and the china book import and export company.  the shop is expected to accept cards issued by other local banks as well as international cards such as visa and master card.

title: surgery to be done on internet
body: one of the world's top sports surgeons will do a knee operation at 1 p.m. today on the internet. richard steadman, an american surgeon, will repair a ligament in the left knee of unitedstates skier kristin nolen on the american health network. "by webcasting this and other surgeries, we are trying to educate the public about their medical options," said j. tod fetherling, president of ahn interactive. "but we are also demystifying the surgery process, allowing anyone with web access to see the magic behind the medicine." the net address is www.ahn.com.

title: china plans to carry meteor storm on internet
body: china plans to provide coverage of the coming meteor storm in the constellation leo on the internet. it will be available at "shanghai online" at www.online.sh.cn. for more than three hours, with photos transmitted directly through a radio telescope link-up to minimize transmission time and to improve picture quality. internet users and astronomy buffs will be able to see the rare phenomenon at the same time as it appears in the sky in a very clear picture, the organizer promises. the meteor storm is expected to occur between 2:00 and 5:00 am beijing time on november 18. it will be the first such storm visible in the eastern hemisphere this century. shanghai is close to the best observation position. shanghai online's special meteor storm site will track the movement and provide historic information. people will also be able to express their own views on the site. a meteor storm in the constellation leo was first recorded by the chinese in 902 ad.

title: chinese, u.s. companies to build medical info highway
body: china jinwei medical networking engineering co. ltd. and stm wireless of the unitedstates today signed a strategic cooperative agreement to build a medical information network in china by the year 2000.  the envisaged information highway will adopt wide-band multimedia satellite transmission technology and function as a central data base for national medical and public health information.  the network will be installed with 1,500 sets of the latest equipment supplied by the stm, according to pei donghong, chairman of jinwei, who said the new network will provide long-distance medical treatment and consultation for up to one million people a year.  pei said that jinwei will also develop on-line business in the field of medical instruments and medicines.  the chairman of stm noted that his company has decided to base its asia-pacific maintenance center in beijing to facilitate cooperation with china.  jinwei put its medical network into operation last year and has since set up ground satellite reception stations in dozens of major hospitals across china.

title: bilingual web site launched in hong kong
body: china internet corporation (cic) and america on-line jointly launched a bilingual web site here monday.  the web site, dubbed aol.com.hk, provides both chinese and english news and information ranging from entertainment to travel, money, computer, sports and shopping. internet surfers are able to make use of the new linkage to visit all aol.com sites around the world.  jack davies, president of aol international, said that the opening of aol.com.hk is the first step toward building up a strong presence in the chinese-speaking market. the unique web site is aimed at meeting the surging demand for chinese internet applications and content. cic, a leading provider of chinese information, has created the china wide web, a nationwide business information network; aol is the world leader in interactive services and content. tung chee hwa, chief executive of the hongkong special administrative region (sar) met representatives of the two companies here monday, praising them for their contributions to the development of internet technology, information and commerce in hongkong.

title: shanghai gm on internet
body: shanghai gm, a joint venture between the local automotive industry and the unitedstatesa.-based super carmaker general motors, recently set up an internet website.  the shanghai gm's homepage has both an english and a chinese version.  the website aims to provide information to potential clients on the latest progress of the joint venture, which is scheduled to manufacture its first buick cars by the end of this year, according to shanghai gm co., ltd..  official statistics show that china has more than one million internet subscribers, and this number is growing at a rate of 40 percent a year.

title: uk launches scheme to connect schools to internet
body: british prime minister tony blair friday formally launched the country's national grid for learning, which aims to give schools throughout britain access to online information and teaching materials.  tony blair announced that by the year 2002, the british government will invest 700 million pounds (1.16 billion unitedstates dollars) in computers for schools focusing on the internet.  the cash will be used over the next four years to ensure every school in the uk is connected to the internet and most children leave school "computer literate".  "the investment announced today will prevent a generation of children emerging who don't have these skills -the information poor," the prime minister said.  tony blair said that the grid would be like having "the best library in the world in our classrooms." the prime minister also challenged businesses to play their part in developing educational hardware and software for schools.  however, the task of getting every school online remains huge.  statistics show that only one in five teachers in the uk has been trained to use computers and many schools are struggling to meet the demands of information technology.

title: xinhua launches asian games website
body: the xinhua news agency opened a website on the internet today to introduce the asian games with text and images on the history and latest news about the games. internet users can view the website by accessing: www.asiangames.xinhua.org the website has 15 program titles including asian games news, looking forward to bangkok, china and the asian games, history of the asian games, asian games photos, records of the asian games, sports organizations in asia, and competition results. the xinhua news agency launched its website: www.xinhua.org on november 7, 1997 for news and information, and since then has created sites for the world cup, unitedstates president clinton's visit to china, a reemployment project, a review of 20 years of reform, the anti-drug campaign, and flood-fighting and disaster relief.

title: eu favors new internet domain name registry
body: the european commission welcomed thursday the progress made regarding the formation of a new system for registering internet domain names.  the system, as proposed, would be managed by the internet corporation for assigned names and numbers (icann).  to discuss the matter, european commissioner martin bangemann, in charge of telecommunications and information technologies, sent a letter to unitedstates secretary of commerce william daley.  besides welcoming the progress in preparing the launch of the icann, bangemann took note of the nomination of an initial board of directors for the operation, including three european members.  he said the european union (eu), with the european commission as its executive body, has an interest to ensure a geographically and functionally balanced representation in the icann.  the icann would also have the mandate to organize and manage the internet numbering system and internet protocols.

title: china internet corp. to host annual meeting in beijing
body: china internet corporation (cic) is scheduled to host its third annual conference on november 10 in beijing.  the conference will bring together over 35 of the world's leading internet experts to focus on the latest trends, technology and news affecting china's developing internet market, cic announced here monday.  more than 1,000 delegates are expected to participate in the conference, drawn from governmental and media agencies including china's ministry of information, the state council leading group on internet, cctv, xinhua news agency, together with industry professionals throughout the country.  vicky hung, vice-president for business and product development, said: "the cic-china.com conference is acknowledged as the leading authoritative forum on the development of china's internet market." the conference will provide an ideal platform for global players in the internet industry to meet with the key decision makers in china's burgeoning internet field, he said.

title: china's less-developed regions turning to internet for help
body: a company in a remote part of northeastern china recently struck a 10.64 million unitedstates dollar deal with an american client with the help of the internet.  the company is one example of less-developed inland parts of china using the internet to increase international economic and trade exchanges. these areas include the provinces of sichuan, shanxi, yunnan, henan, and hunan, the inner mongolia and xinjiang regions, and the city of chongqing.  internet provides low cost, fast, and direct service. hunan announced over 1,000 investment projects on its web-site right after it was introduced and a porcelain factory there, which was affected by a sluggish market recently got new business opportunities on the internet.

title: finnish chamber of commerce opens internet links
body: finnish prime minister paavo lipponen began his visit to china today by becoming the first official to access the new website the finnish chamber of commerce established at the embassy of finland. the website was initiated by commercial counselor pertti hekkala as part of an effort to remove obstacles related to distance and transportation by using internet technology. the website provides a virtual communication channel. the internet links provide the chamber of commerce with its first office in china, finland's major trade partner amongst developing countries. recent reports indicate that trade between china and finland has grown by 20 percent annually over the past six years. some 100 finnish companies conducting business in china have posted information on the new website. lipponen cut the ribbon at the opening ceremony and expressed hope that the "website will promote commercial ties between china and finland." the website could be found at "www.fincham.org" on the internet.

title: hainan puts agricultural information on internet
body: hainan, china's southernmost island province, has set up an agricultural information homepage on the internet recently.  zhou dawei, secretary-general of the hainan provincial association for agricultural exchanges, said that market information is very important to hainan, as most of its agricultural markets lie outside the island.  wang said that his association plans to cooperate with enterprises in setting up an information network for china's tropical agriculture.

title: internet pioneer jonathan postel dies
body: jonathan postel, an internet pioneer, died at the age of 55 in a los angeles hospital over the weekend following a heart surgery, his friends and colleagues said tuesday.  postel, who was often called "the father of the internet," began his work linking computers in the 1960s when he was a graduate student at the university of california in los angeles.  he was director of the controversial internet assigned numbers authority, which assigns internet addresses throughout the world.  he remained active in internet policy matters until his hospitalization.  on october 2, he presented what he called a consensus solution from the internet community to the clinton administration --a plan to put management of the addressing system into the hands of a private non-profit group.  "jon postel was an important historical figure in the development of the internet," one of his colleagues, network solutions inc. chief executive officer gabe battista, said in a statement.  he said postel's work over the past decades "played a significant part in the worldwide growth and development of the internet as we know it today."

title: air macao inaugurates internet home page
body: air macao has inaugurated its home page in the world wide web to better inform its clients, according to a press release issued by the airline company tuesday. internet visitors worldwide can get access to the web site of http://www.airmacau.com.mo to obtain the latest information about the company and other relevant data. the contents of the home page include general information of macao, air macao corporate information, passenger information and feedback, cargo, in-flight service and fleet information. a chinese version of the home page will be ready soon.

title: internet links famous brand enterprises
body: southwest china's sichuan province has established an internet website listing the famous brand products manufactured by local enterprises.  the province established the website to introduce its products to the international market. east china's jiangsu province opened a similar website earlier this year.  the website will carry information on 230 famous products manufactured by 216 local enterprises and local enterprise technology to 70 million users in 180 countries and regions.  the website has already attracted some 600 hits, some 70 percent of which originated overseas.

title: dalian's fashion festival available on internet
body: a click of the mouse, and you will be able to once again attend the tenth dalian international fashion festival, which closed weeks ago.  a website opened recently on the internet provides more people with easy access to this year's largest chinese fashion festival.  the fashion festival in the northeast china port city of dalian which started ten years ago has become an important annual international event attracting growing numbers of overseas traders, who this year accounted for a record 63 percent of all participants.  the website will make the festival a continuous international event, said wang zhenjiao, a dalian computer network center official, adding that the site has already received a large amount of email from abroad.  on-line service provides people with the history of the fashion show and the lastest information on fashion trends, competitions and symposiums.  the website also has been linked with other similar websites around the world.

title: microsoft to market new type cordless phone
body: microsoft corp. plans to market a new type cordless-telephone handsets that plug into personal computers, the wall street journal reported tuesday.  this is the company's efforts to build a line of consumer-electronics products linked to its windows operating system software.  the report said the new consumer-product line includes a 269 unitedstates dollars audio speaker system and a 350 unitedstates dollars universal remote control device.  microsoft's cordless-phone system takes advantage of the processing power of a user's pc to manage an array of voicemail options, caller-id capabilities, and voice-recognition features.  for example, users can enter names and phone numbers in the address-book feature of the internet explorer web browser and then place calls using voice commands.

title: sweden's internet transaction growing fast
body: sweden's retail trade in books, cds and banking is growing rapidly over the internet even though the service is still in its infancy, according to swedish market research company stelacon.  total purchasing over the internet by swedish households is expected to reach 500 million to 600 million swedish kronor (62.5-75 million unitedstates dollars) this year, twice as much as in 1997.  a total of 875,000 homes, or 21 percent of all swedish households, had access to the internet by may 1998. among them, 23 percent enjoy shopping services over the internet.  thirty-five percent of the "wired" population has purchased books via the net; 23 percent have purchased cd albums; 15 percent have purchased computer programs; 6 percent have purchased tickets; and 6 percent have purchased alcoholic beverages.  banking over the internet is also increasingly popular. a survey conducted by a bank industry newsletter found that about 430,000 swedes currently obtain some form of bank services over the internet.

title: electronic business driving demand for web jobs
body: a boom in electronic business in the unitedstates is driving demand for professionals skilled in computer web technology and management, and this is leading to higher salaries.  average earnings for unitedstates web professionals this year were up 9 percent over 1997, according to a new survey by toppmeyer research for network computing magazine, which released the results tuesday.  the survey of 391 internet industry employees in june and july found that their average annual earnings to be 59,600 unitedstates dollars, up from 54,800 dollars last year.  the growth in electronic commerce and corporate intranets -used for internal company information, human resources, tech support and employee training, among other things --is driv

title: china offers new exhibition website
body: china recently introduced its first website listing upcoming exhibitions, introductions to various centers and online exhibits.  the website has attracted the participation of enterprises in the sector and several domestic exhibition centers.  the shenzhen exhibition association registered the website domain with internic in may this year.

title: hk has 575,000 internet users
body: statistics from a market research group have showed that there are 575,000 internet users in the hongkong special administrative region (hksar) of china, the south china morning post reported tuesday.  the typical internet user in hongkong is young, affluent and male, but spends little time shopping online. email is the most popular internet application, used by 61 percent of users, the local newspaper reported, citing a study by market research group ac nielsen.  other popular uses of the internet include general surfing (47 percent), product or service information search (41 percent), online newspaper reading (34 percent), and program downloading (31 percent).  most established regional retailers regard virtual stores as another sales channel that could give them an edge over competitors, chia hork-hwa, a senior consulting and marketing specialist for eastern consulting group was quoted by the post as saying.  however, chia said that internet shoppers might be less loyal than those who shop at store-front businesses and that confidence is a key issue in attracting online customers.

title: shanxi holds commodity trade fair on internet
body: north china's shanxi province recently opened a website on the internet to hold a year-round commodity trade fair.  the site was jointly established by the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation and shanxi province.  over 20 industrial firms have offered to sell their products via the internet in the first three days of operation.  "it will simplify export procedures, cut down production costs and raise efficiency," said a provincial trade official.  earlier, the province opened an international business program on the internet with seven data banks containing 300,000 items on sino-foreign investment cooperation.

title: china to launch first charity website on internet
body: china's first charity auction website will be available on the internet on september 23. the website, jointly established by the china charity foundation (ccf), beijing municipal telegraph bureau and wisdom science and technology enterprise, will be used to collect funds for china's flooded areas from sales of the works of chinese painters and calligraphers, as well as items provided by antique collectors. the website can accessed via two addresses --www.china-charity.org and www.chinacharity.cn.net. related information will be available at the email address: info.china-charity.org. the ccf will use funds raised from the auctions to set up a charity fund for china's flood victims. serious flooding, which hit central, eastern and northeastern parts of china this summer, caused massive economic losses. the ccf has donated 470 million yuan (57 million us dollars) to the flood relief effort.

title: thailand develops software to erase child porn
body: a bangkok-based non-governmental organization has successfully developed an anti-virus software with a german firm to block child pornography on the internet.  the software is capable of identifying all files that contain child pornography sent on the internet and also erasing similar files from computers, the bangkok post reported on sunday.  the paper quoted foreign ministry spokesman kobsak chutikul as saying that the organization, end child prostitution, pornography and trafficking of children (ecpat), had begun distributing the software, with the cooperation of thai interpol.  ecpat has been persuading internet service providers to use the software and will encourage general internet users to install it in their computers, kobsak said.  the spread of pornographic materials on the internet prompted the united nations to hold a meeting in stockholm in 1996 and sign a declaration against child pornography.  ecpat has closely monitored the situation ever since, kobsak said.  un figures show that there are now about 650,000 prostitutes worldwide below 16 years of age.

title: vietnam to further open access to internet
body: vietnam will further open access to internet as a development step, the vietnam investment review reported in its latest issue.  "we now understand that limiting access to internet is an isolationist policy," the weekly quoted a senior communist party official as saying.  dang huu, head of the communist party's science and education department, said the current limitation on access to internet use discouraged communication and technology development in vietnam.  vietnam has nearly 11,000 internet users with a growth rate of 20 percent, which is still below that of many other developing countries.  foreigners working in vietnam always complain of the "information firewall" which was designed to bar "inappropriate" information from entering the country through internet.  many companies have to turn back to fax after mails being barred from transferring on internet, the vietnam investment review reported.

title: first web department store in shanghai
body: shanghai, china's leading financial and commercial city, has just opened its first on-line department store.  the yixiang shopping center launched its internet site on september 1, offering about 1,000 items for sale to web users.  the number of commodities for sale on the site is expected to increase to 10,000 by the end of the year.  the yixiang web shopping system was jointly developed by the shanghai commercial information center and china textiles university.  since 1996, shanghai has set up a number of shops on the web, including a bookstore, flower shop and drugstore.  some local observers believe that the number of department store customers in shanghai will decline by 20 to 30 percent by the end of the century due to the growth of on-line shopping and electronic businesses.

title: simultaneous raids on child porn ring conducted
body: police in 21 countries conducted simultaneous raids wednesday on a suspected child porn ring which has exchanged pornographic pictures of children over the internet, german police said.  the operation, coordinated by the british police authorities via the interpol, started at 0400 gmt across european countries including germany, britain and france, as well the unitedstates and canada.  the raids followed investigations in britain which pointed to over 180 individuals suspected of exchanging a large quantity of child pornographic pictures over an internet "chat room," the german federal criminal agency in wiesbaden said.  german press reports quoted the british police authorities as saying that more than 100,000 pornographic pictures had been seized and dozens of suspects detained in the international swoop.

title: china's technology export website
body: some 3,500 types of china's transferable technology can now be seen on the internet, on the website the online technology export fair of china. the items include machinery, chemicals, electronics, building materials, aviation and space technology, bioengineering, and some of the country's most advanced carrier rocket and agricultural cloning technology. shi guangsheng, the minister of foreign trade and economic cooperation (moftec), said at the opening ceremony today that this was the first time for china to use e-business to show technology for exports. moftec began to release commodity information in early july on "chinamarket" on the internet, and in a month it had attracted more than 10 million visits. shi said he hopes to increase technology exports in this way. the nation's technology business grew in the 1990's more than 40 percent per year on average, far greater than the growth of general trade. the online technology export fair can be reached at www.techfair.com.cn, or though the official moftec site, www.moftec.gov.cn.

title: conspirators arrested for internet fraud
body: law enforcement departments in central china's hunan province recently cracked a case of fraud involving use of the internet.  in june this year, liu zheng and five co-conspirators listed false information via the internet in the name of xing yuan corp.. the conspirators defrauded a company in shenzhen, south china's guangdong province, of 150,000 fabric bags valued at 200,000 yuan (24,000 us dollars).  the conspirators sold the bags to neighboring counties and cities in need of flood relief materials, and have since squandered over 90,000 yuan received as a result of the fraudulent internet transaction.  the hunan public security bureau investigated the case for some 20 days and arrested the six co-conspirators in early august.

title: 1 million australian households have home internet access
body: about 1 million australian homes, or 14 percent of all households in australia, are hooked up to the internet, according to official figures released here tuesday.  the number of households with internet access grew by 14 percent between february and may, a survey by the australian bureau of statistics (abs) found.  the abs said more than 970,000 households had home internet access, representing 14 percent of all households and 34 percent of the households with computers.  it said the bulk of the increase was in households which already had computers.  the abs said 94 percent of the adults accessing the internet from home used it once a week or more often.  the abs said 409,000 adults bought goods and services over the internet in the 12 months to may.

title: tibetan information goes on line
body: internet users can now visit the famous qinghai-tibet plateau--often called "the roof of the world"--without going all the way to the tibet autonomous region. china today brought on line the first internet website providing comprehensive information about tibet. it is especially useful for foreigners who want to know what is happening in today's tibet and its famous scenic spots. the website can be accessed at http://www.chinatibet.org.

title: henan museum goes on line
body: internet users are now able to visit one of china's best museums without going all the way to this capital of central china's henan province.  the henan provincial museum has created a website on the internet to become the country's first major on-line museum.  the zhengzhou museum, whose modern building was completed in may, computerized its data management last year, and now provides on-line views of its exhibits and museum publications and guidebooks.  the museum is famous for its collections of bronze and oracle bones with inscriptions from the shang dynasty (16-11th century bc) and glazed tri-color pottery figures from the tang dynasty (618-907).

title: beijing opens web site for cultural information
body: beijing cultural hot lines," a public web site, became operational here today to help internet surfers look up information about the capital's culture, libraries, online cinemas and tourist resorts.  internet surfers can read up-to-date information about beijing's cultural institutions, art troupes, and related laws and regulations after entering the web site.  moreover, they can find information about available books at the online library, major art performances and upcoming movies. they also can make a virtual tour of beijing.

title: more nigerians to have internet access
body: nigeria's national telecommunications company nitel is working to provide internet access to all parts of the country by the end of this year.  the punch newspaper sunday quoted buba bajoga, managing director of the nitel, as saying that an internet gateway with an initial capacity of 5,500 pots is now being constructed in lagos.  "when the project is completed, nitel will provide internet service nationwide with lagos as the gateway for international connectivity," the official said.  the project is being executed at a cost of 5.2 million deutsche marks (about 2.9 million unitedstates dollars) exclusive of the gateway, he added.

title: top level domain for all citizens to make debut next month
body: a new top level domain for all citizens, .ac, will make its debut on august 3, announced the internet society (isoc) here monday.  all citizens will be welcome to register in .ac, said isoc.  a number of delegates at the annual internet conference of the isoc, known as internet summit, have shown interest in the new domain and said they are getting ready to register in the newest domain on the net.  before, some of the world's leading domain registration companies have already signed up to offer .ac domain names, international shorthand for academic community.  "here in japan, we have .ac.jp for academic institutions, but there is great demand from both lecturers and students to have personal, friendly and affordable domain names," said takeshi saigoh from the research institute, network trend technology.  "these domain names can be used at college and in later life to keep in contact with college friends," he said. "we welcome the introduction of .ac domain names to meet this demand and see the opportunities for students around the world to use the internet as their communication tool for life."

title: china's construction industry connected by internet
body: china's construction industry now has a website on the internet at www.ccia.com.cn that provides general information about the industry. the information covers the real estate sector, hot investment items, popular concerns, and human resources and is updated constantly. the site was opened by the china construction industry association and a beijing technology company, and is designed to increase contacts between the construction industry in china and in other parts of the world.

title: internet offers information on nanjing massacre
body: information covering historical materials concerning the nanjing massacre will soon be available on the internet. japanese invaders ignited war in shanghai on august 13, 1937, and seized nanjing, the then capital of china, in december. some 300,000 people were massacred and over a third of the city's houses were burnt to the ground. the program, found at internet address: http: // www. jsinfo. net/njm, will provide users worldwide abundant photographs, documents and materials about the historic event. the program will also provide an introduction of the museum built in memory of the nanjing massacre and the lathest research results of chinese historians. endithem 14/07/98 01:15 gmt nnnn

title: famous chinese gardens available on internet
body: computer users around the globe will be able to get a glimpse of the picturesque gardens of the city of suzhou in east china's jiangsu province on the internet.  the recently installed website features the chinese version of an introduction to suzhou's gardens, the lotus festival at zhuo zheng yuan (the garden of the humble administrator), and miniature versions of the suzhou gardens built in the unitedstates, canada and singapore.  tips on how to enjoy scenic sites of trees and rockery will be added to the web page this month.  the english version also will be available on-line later this month.

title: overseas investment website opens in wuhan
body: economic and commercial information concerning wuhan, capital of hubei province, was linked today to the internet. the city's new website --www.whforeighinvest.gov.cn --is designed to tell the world about wuhan's investment environment, projects soliciting overseas funding, preferential policies, the use of overseas investment, and an introduction to development zones. the website is one of the measures taken by the city government to maintain and enhance overseas investment momentum during the asian financial crisis, city officials said. by this may, the city had utilized 5.061 billion us dollars of overseas investment. there are 3,391 enterprises involving overseas investment currently operating in the city.

title: hk official emphasizes potential for e-commerce
body: hongkong is witnessing the emergence of some innovative use of the internet, secretary for information technology and broadcasting k. c. kwong of the hongkong special administrative region (hksar) said tuesday.  the official pointed out that there is tremendous potential for the further development of electronic commerce (e-commerce) in hongkong.  "the reason is simple, we have an excellent communications backbone on which business applications could be built," kwong told a telecommunications and information technology forum.  to encourage the development of such business applications on the internet in hongkong, kwong said, it is important for the sar government to provide the right environment.  in particular, he said, the government should take the lead in using the internet for the delivery of public services on-line, known as electronic service delivery.  "our aim is simply to create an environment and to provide a ready access means to pump-prime the development of electronic commerce in hongkong," he said.

title: kasparov to launch internet site
body: world chess champion garry kasparov of russia said monday he will launch an internet site for chess lovers eager to watch real-time matches and a chance to take on grandmasters.  speaking in a press conference here, kasparov said the club kasparov site will go live by october with chess news, coverage of events, answers to questions by chess champions and instructions for newcomers to the game.  he noted that "chess belongs to computers, it belongs to the internet. there is no other game that can be played real-time on the internet." "the club will be open to all and aim to satisfy the curiosity of all people in chess," kasparov added.

title: surfing net from home overtakes use at work in britain
body: for the first time people using the internet from home in britain outnumber those net surfing at work, according to a new research.  the findings, coming from the latest internet monitor, a quarterly survey of 1,000 internet users, showed that 4.4 million people in britain have used the internet in the last six months, of which 40 percent or 2.2 million people logged on from home.  around 36 percent accessed the internet from work with the remainder logging on at internet cafes, clubs and libraries.  the results mark a watershed in the evolution of the internet as it switches from being a tool for business to being a medium for domestic consumers.  the increase in home use has been matched by a growth in people using the internet for home shopping, with one million people buying something over the internet in the last six months.  the average internet shopper spends around 40 pounds (66 unitedstates dollars) per month and more than half feel confident about using their credit card over the internet, the research has found.

title: uk national exporters database goes on-line
body: the uk's first ever government-supported national exporters database was launched friday on the internet.  the database has an initial 52,000 entries although it is expected this number will increase as the service becomes more widely marketed.  the database will be operated by the dialog corporation plc on behalf of the government and comprises phase one of an expanded tradeuk project, the department of trade and industry said.  from september tradeuk will also include a revised export sales leads service which will deliver leads from foreign office commercial staff abroad to uk exporters via the internet.  welcoming the new service on its launching, lord clinton-davis, the minister of trade, said: "it is a prime example of our determination and commitment to see uk firms take advantage of the significant advances in information technology, especially the internet." it is believed that the database will enable any uk exporter to have a detailed entry on a database which potentially can be seen by any buyer in the world.

title: using information technology for foreign trade in china
body: china's traditional industrial base, liaoning province, in the northeast, is making an effort to introduce advanced information technology to its foreign trade.  the liaoning international information center for foreign trade, which was established in 1996, has registered with the internet, where it has 7 web sites, according to zhang guixin, deputy director of the provincial department of foreign trade and economic cooperation.  the province did 15 billion unitedstates dollars worth of foreign trade in 1997 and can now do international business via email, international web fax, and web video-phone, zhang says, and liaoning is active in helping the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation set up china's international electronic business network.

title: isoc to host training workshops for developing countries
body: the unitedstates-based internet society (isoc) will host training workshops for more than 250 developing countries' professionals from july 11 to 19 in geneva and in rio de janeiro of brazil, isoc said friday.  this marks the first time the workshops will be held in two locations simultaneously, isoc also said.  the courses, which will be taught in english, french, spanish and portuguese, is to take place just 10 days before the eighth isoc annual conference, also known as the internet summit, in geneva next month. the network training workshops, held annually since 1993, train individuals in the technical and operational aspects of establishing and managing network systems.  in the last five years, graduates have set up internet connections and networks in asia, the former soviet union and in more than 20 african countries.

title: internet society to open permanent office in geneva
body: the unitedstates-based internet society (isoc) is to set up its permanent regional office in geneva, said the isoc wednesday.  the very immediate work of the office is to prepare the isoc's annual conference, also known as internet summit, scheduled for july 21 through 24 in geneva.  its future tasks will include providing enhanced the isoc's visibility, physical representation and coverage of europe, middle east and africa, recruiting new members, creating new chapters and revenue raising activities.  one of the main sponsors for the internet summit in late july, geneva financial center foundation, has pledged 150,000 unitedstates dollars to support the geneva-based permanent office.  explaining why it has chosen geneva, the isoc said the city is a logical choice due to its strategic geographical location in relation to the targeted areas.  geneva also hosts key international organizations such as the world trade organization, the international telecommunication union, and the world intellectual property organization.

title: intel exploring southern chinese market
body: intel corporation, a world leader in semiconductor, is working on expanding its market share in south china's guangdong province, one of the most developed areas in the country.  the corporation will produce network software suitable for small and medium enterprises in guangdong, the company's vice-president said at the '98 intel demonstration show which opened in guangdong's capital of guangzhou today.  in the past few years, the number of internet users has increased at an amazing speed to 1.1 million so far, and a tenth of those are in guangdong, according to lin rongde, a guangdong economic and trade official.  the intel show was organized by intel and guangzhou's feihua telecommunications engineering co. and will provide on-line services for internet use.

title: u.s. internet economy to nearly quadruple by
body: the internet-related spending of businesses and consumers will hit 124 billion unitedstates dollars this year and over half a trillion dollars in 2002, according to a research paper.  the massachusetts-based international data corporation (idc) said in its latest research report that in just four short years, 100 million americans are expected to get access to the web on a regular basis.  the report received here on thursday said: --by 2002 unitedstates businesses will spend over 200 billion dollars on internet technology deployment, or 20 percent of all spending on technology. by the end of 1998, that spending will reach over 62 billion dollars.  --the availability of venture capital to invest in internet companies will nearly double this year to over 8 billion dollars.  --total purchase of goods and services over internet in the unitedstates will close in on 250 billion dollars in 2002.

title: internet paging system opens in shanghai
body: the shanghai guomai communication co. ltd., the largest paging firm in shanghai, recently opened a new service to allow its users to page via the internet.  anyone who calls up the guomai site on the internet can page a local subscriber in shanghai via the net.  so far, more than 4,000 local users have subscribed to the net-paging service.  the company also has linked its email service with the net paging business. the pager tells the user when the subscriber's email box receives a letter.

title: american computer maker eyes electronic business
body: seeking to increase its market share in china, american computer maker ibm will host a two-day seminar on how businesses can use the internet to streamline operation and increase sales, the english language newspaper china daily reported today.  named e-business metropolis, it will unfold on july 1 in the top three cites of china --beijing, shanghai and guangzhou.  the two-day program will include seminars and various e-business exhibitions, ibm said yesterday at a press conference in beijing.  seminars will cover the development of and prospects for e-business, specific e-business solutions provided by ibm for different types of businesses, and case analysis of e-business successes.  in addition, the company will offer public exhibitions on electronic banking, electronic shopping and electronic offices.

title: using internet for investment in southern china
body: china's guangxi zhuang autonomous region has used the internet to help 500 investment projects look for investors worldwide.  the region established a web site to provide investment information in january as a guide to investment projects, guangxi, guangxi's scenic spots, and its resources.  several hundred chinese and overseas companies have visited the site or sent email to guangxi.

title: world cup internet site receives 18 million hits
body: international soccer governing body fifa said here on thursday that the official world cup website on the internet has received millions of hits so far. the site (www.france98.com) became one of hottest sports website by recording 18 million hits so far, said fifa spokesman kaith cooper. the number has exceeded that registered by the website set up by the organizers of the olympic games in 1996, cooper said.

title: world cup internet site receives 18 million hits
body: international soccer governing body fifa said here on thursday that the official world cup website on the internet has received millions of hits so far. the site (www.france98.com) became one of hottest sports website by recording 18 million hits so far, said fifa spokesman kaith cooper. the number has exceeded that registered by the website set up by the organizers of the olympic games in 1996, cooper said.

title: toronto launches internet program for the homeless
body: canada's largest city of toronto has launched an internet program, offering email service to help those living on the streets.  the inner-city initiative, called voice to screen, allows the homeless to log on to the internet, learn how to surf websites for places to live or work and send or receive email for a small fee.  yet, the homeless around the three community centers that offer the service were reported to be unconvinced that logging on to the internet would make any difference in their daily struggle to survive.  "i am interested in getting more money from the rich and making them pay for the poor," a homeless woman was quoted as saying by reports tuesday.  the new internet program is funded jointly by the industry department of canada, the city of toronto and non-government organizations.  it is "an extraordinary innovation that will have an impact," said one proponent of the program.  but critics argue that such a plan fail to address the no.1 problem facing the homeless, a lack of affordable housing.

title: nigeria to hook all varsities to internet
body: nigeria will hook all its higher education institutions to the internet by the end of this year, education minister alhaji danda birmah has said.  birmah disclosed this at the weekend while commissioning a new building at the yaba college of technology in lagos.  the minister said the move demonstrates the importance government attached to information technology in the approaching 21st century.  nigeria's liberalization of the telecommunications sector has resulted in a flourishing business in internet service provision in recent years.  recently the country became one of the first nations in africa to have a 128 kilobits per second access to the internet.

title: beijing logs price information on internet
body: beijing's municipal bureau for price management has logged local price information on the internet.  the program is expected to provide a basis for government policy makers and to better serve society.  most of the information placed on the internet is free of charge.  related information cover wholesale and retail prices of farm produce and sideline products, some 10,000 kinds of western medicine and more than 6,000 traditional chinese medicines, medical names, size, producers and distributors.  prices on more than 10,000 building materials and materials for decoration, charges of beijing's administrative units and pricing laws and regulations, the commodity price index and price analysis are also included in the information initiated on the internet.  li jiali, director of the beijing municipal bureau for price management, said that his bureau will extend greater efforts to perfect the existing information network and data bank and add more information on such things as gardens, public traffic, hotels and education.

title: internet use on increase in uk
body: almost one in four of the uk population now has access to the internet and a growing number are using the net to research products to buy, according to a research published wednesday.  the survey, carried out by opinion pollster nop, showed that the total number of british internet users reached 10.3 million in the first three months this year, or 23 percent of the adults, though many are only using the net for email.  web-surfing is less common, but 13 percent of the population, or 5.9 million people in the uk, have now used the world wide web, more than double the number a year ago.  the survey also found that the web is becoming a crucial research tool for consumers, with two million people using the net to investigate products and prices before buying.  web users were found to be particularly affluent, with 46 percent having a household income of more than 25,000 pounds (40,775 unitedstates dollars) and 70 percent owning their own home.

title: internet use rises in canada
body: more canadians are hooking their home computers up to the internet, a new survey said wednesday.  the study of 2,013 canadians in late march and early april indicated 20 percent of households had access to the internet, a sharp rise from 13 percent in a similar survey last november.  the new figures confirmed earlier findings of the demographics of internet users: predominantly males aged 18 to 29 and 45 to 59.  in the meantime, the spread of personal computers in the country is not growing nearly as fast.  the survey shows 40 percent of canadian households own computers, a slight increase from the 36 percent level indicated by the statistics agency last year.  it also found that most computer owners earn more than 24,000 unitedstates dollars a year.  the survey, conducted by environics research group inc., is considered to have a margin of error of plus or minus 2.2 percentage points, 19 times out of 20.

title: organisers to boost ticket sales on internet
body: the commonwealth games organisers said monday they planned to use the internet to improve poor ticket sales restricted by the commonwealth games federation (cgf) rules.  according to the rules, ticket sales overseas must be done through ticketing agents appointed by the respective commonwealth games associations.  only 60,107 tickets out of 1.2 million available have been taken up so far.

title: chinese artists contact overseas chinese counterparts via internet
body: the works of 10 chinese and overseas chinese artists and musicians were moved out of the theater and concert halls to the internet today, to introduce chinese art to millions of internet surfers around the globe.  for the next two months visitors to the web site "window on shanghai" can hear introductions to these people in standard chinese spoken by broadcasters from the shanghai people's radio station, as well as records of their songs and pieces of music. they can also view graphic works by chinese at home and overseas chinese artists on the web site.  the 10 artists and musicians include chinese composer zhu jian'er, peking opera actor shang changrong, chinese violin player min huifen, young chinese singer liao changyong, french-chinese artist zhao wuji, american-chinese artists ding shaoguang and lu jiren, and shanghai artists he youzhi and wang jieyin.  "window on shanghai" was opened on new year's day 1996, as an authoritative source of information relating to shanghai. about 300,000 internet surfers all over the world visit the site every day.

title: mci said to be selling internet division
body: the mci communications corporation, the second largest telecommunication provider in the unitedstates, is said to be looking for buyers of its fast-growing internet business.  the unit should fetch around 500 million unitedstates dollars, and british telecommunications p.l.c. is among the companies expected to be involved in the bidding, the new york times reported today.  bidders also include some smaller companies like ixc communications inc. and the williams companies inc., it said. but mci had not solicited bids from its main competitors, the att corporation and the sprint corporation.  the company declined to comment on the selling, it said.

title: wto ministerial conference broadcast live on internet
body: internet users around the world can watch and listen to speeches by world leaders and trade ministers at the second wto ministerial conference and the commemoration of the 50th anniversary of the multilateral trading system on may 18-20. speeches by brazilian president fernando henrique cardoso, british prime minister tony blair, cuban president fidel castro, south african president nelson mandela and unitedstates president bill clinton will be broadcast live on the internet. internet users can get access to the wto website at http://www.wto.org. they can send email to enquirieshwto.org if they have any questions.

title: britain lags in european electronic commerce race
body: britain is lagging behind its european partners in adopting the internet for business, according to a survey from uk market research company already.  the survey, based on interviews with 900 business in the uk, france, germany, spain, italy and the netherlands, has found that 60 percent of companies questioned now have access to the internet.  it revealed that spain is leading europe in electronic commerce, with 46 percent of companies linked to the internet already conducting business on-line.  spain is followed by france and germany with the figures of 33 and 20 percent, while the uk, italy and the netherlands appear to be lagging with figures less than 20 percent.  however, the uk and the netherlands are ahead in using the internet for recruitment. one in five uk companies with internet access is now recruiting new staff through the internet, far more than among other european businesses.  nearly a quarter of european companies with internet access are already earning revenues, the survey showed, suggesting that european companies have begun to recognize the importance of electronic commerce and to close the gap with their unitedstates counterparts.

title: china and u.s. companies to establish software download center
body: china internet corp. (cic) announced today it plans to establish a national software download center with unitedstates computer companies.  in a press conference today, cic and netscape communication corp. also announced the launch of free internet guide services for china's interior areas and hongkong.  these are the cooperative results of a unitedstates computer industry trade mission which arrived here wednesday.  the high-level delegation, organized by the unitedstates department of commerce and the unitedstates embassy to china, aims to establish ties with china's computer companies and seek opportunities for cooperation.  john mcphee, delegation director and acting deputy assistant secretary for unitedstates technology and aerospace industries, said that the visit is part of unitedstates president bill clinton's goal to expand and enhance unitedstates-china business and technological exchanges.  mcphee said he is pleased to see the cooperation between cic and unitedstates partners such as netscape and america online.  the unitedstates delegation, consisting of nine computer companies including netscape and america online, has toured hongkong, shenzhen, guangzhou and shanghai.

title: china's hi-tech information available on internet
body: the chinese capital has established a hi-tech platform linking various domestic networks and internet. the information service allows net surfers to access and exchange the latest hi-tech information. its web site's address is http://www. ctmnet.com.cn. china's technology market is now developing rapidly, and is worth 30 billion yuan annually, and that figure is expected to reach about 80 billion yuan by the end of the century.

title: shanghai street tour available on internet
body: dropping in on the web site www.shanghaicommerce.com on the internet can provide a panoramic view of shanghai's renowned nanjing boulevard, as famous in its own way as oxford street in london and broadway in new york city. as one of 10 projects aimed at building shanghai into an information center, the web site recently passed appraisal by experts. now, approximately 180 shopping malls, collection shops and brand-name stores with 100 years of history in the most bustling downtown area in shanghai, built in 1815, have a presence on the web. a "surfer" at an internet bar in the municipality's jinlingdonglu street said: "window shopping on the web is easy and interesting, and i can obtain up-to-date commercial information as well." indeed, apart from its role as a guide for tourists and shoppers, the system will also provide the latest commercial news, prices and trade quotations as well as commodity surveys.

title: china's ocean information available on internet
body: china's ocean information has been entered on the internet, enabling net surfers to learn more and exchange opinions.  the china ocean information network (coinet) has opened a web site with 256 internet protocol addresses. its two domain names are nmdis.gov.cn and coi.gov.cn.  the coinet, releasing information in both chinese and english, provides information consulting and exchange services, and offers support for governments at all levels in ocean management and research.  coinet provides information on oceanic economy, science, policies, laws and regulations.  the site also offers normal network services including information search and email communication.

title: namibia's mobile phone internet users increase
body: the number of internet users in namibia more than doubled last year and the country's cellular phone subscribers also grow sharply, according to a united nations report released recently.  the report of the u.n. international telecommunication union (itu) said that the number of namibian computers linked directly to the worldwide web jumped from 262 in 1996 to 640 in 1997, ranking namibia the second most on-line sub-saharan african country, only after south africa.  cellular phone users in namibia grew from 6,644 to 12,500 in the same period, south african press association (sapa) friday quoted the report as saying.  more than 15,000 new telephone lines were installed between 1996 and 1997, a 100 percent increase in the number of conventional phone lines installed in the previous year, the itu said.  the namibian government is drafting a new telecommunications policy which is expected to pave the way for further liberalization of the sector, the sapa report said.

title: school children in n. greece encouraged to use internet
body: greece's macedonia and thrace ministry has begun a pilot program which allows children at 110 schools in the two northern greek regions to surf the internet via the site of the ministry.  macedonia-thrace minister philipos petsalnikos said that purpose of the program was to help school children to master new technologies including computer science fifteen percent of primary and secondary schools in the regions were already using the internet and some had created their own web page at the ministry's site.  to face the challenges of the next century, greece attaches great importance to the new technologies.  the greek government is now doing its utmost to realize the target of allowing all primary and secondary school children to use internet in five years.

title: uganda gives nod to third internet provider
