body: five firms have agreed to pool 3.75 million unitedstates dollars to sponsor an on-line education program in california, the unitedstates.  the program, the california virtual university (cvu), will list, via the internet, 500 courses offered at any of the state's 301 accredited colleges and universities.  so far, 65 schools have joined the program offering college degrees from certificates to doctorates.  as enrollment at california's higher education institutions is expected to grow by half a million over the next 10 years, the cvu will play an important role in offering local residents the education they need without adding additional students on campus.  california governor pete wilson has proposed in his 1998-1999 budget that the program be expanded with 14.1 million dollars. he also proposed that all public high school students receive computing training and all public high schools be linked to internet within four years.  on-line education programs, or computer-mediated distance education, have been in the ascendant in the unitedstates.  approximately 40 percent of the country's colleges and universities have or are developing distance education programs to supplement their array of education offerings.  the idea is that wherever or at any time, students can log into a virtual classroom where from desktop or laptop, email assignments can be sent and received.

title: hk launches new on-line financial information service
body: hongkong telecom ims netvigator, a major internet service provider in hongkong, today announced the launch of hongkong stock express 2.0.  this new version of hongkong stock express --the flagship service of netvigator financial express (nfx) --provides a more speedy and comprehensive real-time, on-line financial information service for investors to better manage their investments and capitalize on market opportunities.  built with java technology, nfx hongkong stock express 2.0 offers an easier and faster access to real-time quotes of all listed local stocks and warrants.  the service also features a complete range of new real-time, on-line financial tools, which help investors keep better track of stock performance and market changes.  "we are very pleased to introduce the upgraded nfx hongkong stock express 2.0 on-line financial service to our customers," said william lo, managing director of hongkong telecom ims.  he pointed out that the new nfx 2.0 version has been upgraded using some of the latest internet technologies and it includes new features and content.  "the new nfx hongkong stock express 2.0 represents a major step of hongkong telecom ims netvigator toward the provision of a total financial intelligence engine for investors to proactively plan and manage their investment," lo said.  nfx hongkong stock express 2.0 users can now better monitor and capitalize on market opportunities by building their own investment portfolios and making performance analyses with new tools such as real-time, on-line "stock information," "teletext," "news," "on-line charting" as well as the "personal portfolio" and "reports" functions.  the new nfx hongkong stock express 2.0 also features a standalone version, which has been designed to save significant download time.  to access all the financial information on nfx hongkong stock express 2.0, users simply have to double click on the netvigator financial express icon and type in their user id and password, without having to go to the nfx web site or open their browsers.  in addition to the new hongkong stock express 2.0 service, hongkong telecom ims netvigator financial express has been offering a range of other value-added on-line financial information services covering the local and asian-pacific markets.  these include the shk stock monitor which provides a library of local stock and warrant trading information since 1988, asia financial express covering financial information of major asian-pacific markets, reuters's hongkong investor which provides an extensive mutual fund database, and nettrack financial service which provides an on-line financial newsletter and commentaries.

title: eu adopts policy for electronic commerce security
body: the european commission today adopted a policy framework concerning security on electronic commerce, especially transactions on the internet.  the executive body of the 15-nation european union has decided to pass into law the network security framework in the first half of 1998.  the framework is aimed at ensuring the functioning of the internal market for cryptographic products and services, establishing a european framework for digital signatures and stimulating a european industry for cryptographic services and products.  though rapid and efficient for worldwide communication exchanges at low cost, open networks such as the internet also fall prey to such insecurities as intercepted and manipulated messages as well as denied documents.  encryption is necessary for electronic commerce because consumers and financial institutions need to be confidant that no one can tap into a transaction.  but the same encryption techniques can also be used by terrorists, child pornographers or drug dealers to avoid arrest.  divergent legal and technical approaches in different countries, however, constitute a serious obstacle to the formation of the internal market of the 15-nation union by hindering the development of new economic activities linked to electronic commerce.  commission officials said today that europe is going to use, unlike the unitedstates, unlimited encryption even though the technology can benefit criminals.  though the policy paper did not specifically refer to the unitedstates global push for encryption, one commission official familiar with the policy framework said that the plan can be rightly interpreted in principle as a counterproposal.  commission officials argued that widespread availability of encryption can also prevent crimes.  the damage caused nowadays by electronic crime, in the form of industrial espionage, credit car fraud, toll fraud on cellular phones and piracy on pay tv encryption, is estimated in the order of billions of ecus each year.  there are, therefore, considerable economic and legal benefits associated with encryption, the officials said, adding that restricting the use of encryption could well prevent law-abiding companies and individuals from protecting themselves against criminal acts.

title: european ministers agree to limit state regulations on internet
body: european countries agreed in principle today not to impose new taxes or regulations on business conducted over the internet and instead they will largely allow the private sector to play a key role in determining how to run cyberspace.  in a non-binding declaration agreed after a two-day ministerial meeting in bonn, 29 european countries agreed that the potential of the internet could only be fully tapped if national governments reduced their intervention to the minimum level.  the declaration said private investment and standards should be given priority in building the internet; no new tax levies should be imposed on the commercial use of internet; the right to free expression should be protected; and data encryption technologies should be allowed.  but it also stressed that international agreements were needed to ensure that digital signatures on documents were legally acceptable.  the meeting was attended by ministers from the european union (eu) and the european free trade association nations as well as some eastern european countries. representatives from the unitedstates, canada, russia and japan attended the meeting as observers.  unitedstates commerce secretary william daley said the bonn declaration was close to suggestions made by unitedstates president bill clinton for an internet free trade zone, but there were also differences.  the unitedstates requires providers of encryption, or information scrambling, technologies to let the law enforcement authorities have a "key" in order to gather evidence against criminals. washington also keeps a tight control on the export of software with strong encryption.  because a majority of software powerhouses are in the unitedstates, the europeans fear that they will be put at a disadvantageous position in this area and that it will enable unitedstates intelligence services to read their sensitive data.  officials from the eu and the unitedstates are scheduled to meet in brussels wednesday to discuss the future of digital commerce. the talks will focus on issues such as intellectual property rights, the security of transactions, electronic payment systems, data protection and taxation on the internet.

title: germany, us lobby for tax-free internet
body: both german and unitedstates officials said here today that governments should not levy new taxes on business conducted over the internet and, instead, they should turn it into a "free trade zone." addressing an international meeting on internet opened in bonn today, german economics minister guenter rexrodt said, "we must support digital commerce and should not put it under new burdens." noting that trade over the internet could reach several hundred billion unitedstates dollars by the year 2000, rexrodt said governments should allow the international computer network to develop as free as possible in order to make full use of its economic potential.  rexrodt's unitedstates counterpart, william daley, today also warned against too many national regulations on the internet. "the internet should not become a national market," he said.  unitedstates president bill clinton issued a report last week deciding not to impose new taxes or regulations on business conducted over the internet and instead will largely allow the private sector to determine on its own how it will operate in cyberspace.  daley said the unitedstates and the european union (eu) have more common ground on this issue than their differences.  despite the support for a market-oriented approach, eu commissioner martin bangemann said at the meeting in bonn that the eu still favors a set of minimum international regulations to safeguard the internet against criminal content and to enable data protection.  the organization for economic cooperation and development meanwhile announced in bonn that it would organize a conference in canada in autumn next year to discuss necessary internet regulations.  the internet meeting in bonn was sponsored by the eu and were attended by 40 government ministers and 80 international companies and organizations. on tuesday, the eu ministers are expected to adopt a unbinding declaration to make clear their positions on the use of the internet.

title: on-line travel booking service to be available
body: american express and microsoft corporation today announced a new alliance to provide an on-line travel bookingservice that allows business travelers to make reservations from their personal computer.  the two companies have already begun developing, and the corporate on-line travel product with full roll-out is expected in the first half of 1997. all transactions will be backed by american express' worldwide customer service.  the on-line booking system will enable corporate travelers to make complete air, hotel and car rental reservations on-line. the system also will allow companies to capture travel data critical to expense management. in addition, corporations can include their negotiated fares and rates, as well as travel policy guidelines, into the system, making sure their employees take advantage of available discounts.  "this agreement with microsoft represents an important step forward in launching the next generation of travel services," said harvey golub, chairman of the american express company.  bill gates, chief executive officer of microsoft, said that "this agreement with american express represents an exciting opportunity for corporations to apply microsoft's intranet technologies to the challenge of managing corporate travel." on-line travel purchases are growing rapidly, according to a research company's survey about on-line shopping. the survey shows that now there are between 7.2 and 10.8 million pleasure travelers on the world wide web. this represents potential spending power of more than 10 billion unitedstates dollars on travel.

title: Chinese Websites to Increase Cooperation with Mass Media
body: About 36 major Chinese websites and websites of mass media organizations issued a joint statement here today calling for intensive cooperation to promote the healthy development of the web-based information service industry. The statement was announced at a meeting held in Beijing today which focused on the development of China's Internet industry. DOMESTIC NEWS; ECONOMICRepresentatives from the websites of Xinhua News Agency, the China News Agency, China Central TV, the China International Radio Station, China Daily and websites such as Sina.com, Sohu.com and Netease.com attended the meeting. Both the websites and the news agencies and newspapers noted the important role played by the web-based information service industry in modern society, and reiterated the principle of "self- discipline" among the websites operators needed to create a positive social environment. These website operators and the mass media websites will meet two times a year to discuss problems related to the development of China's web-based information service industry.

title: COPYRIGHT 1999 XINHUA NEWS AGENCY
body: A CENTER TO OFFER ON-LINE TRADING SERVICE FOR PETROCHEMICALS IS EXPECTED TO GO INTO OPERATION IN SHANGHAI PUDONG NEW AREA BY THE END OF THE YEAR. BUILT AT COST OF 30 MILLION YUAN, THE TRADING CENTER TRIES TO COVER ALL PETROCHEMICAL ENTERPRISES ACROSS THE COUNTRY, 260 OF WHICH HAVE SO FAR REGISTERED WITH THE CENTER AS ITS MEMBERS. THE CENTER HAS BEEN LISTED AS AN EXPERIMENTAL PROJECT FOR THE OPERATION OF E-COMMERCE BY THE COUNTRY'S ENTERPRISES. THE INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA AND THE COMMUNICATION BANK OF CHINA HAVE SIGNED CONTRACTS TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL SERVICES FOR THE CENTER. PETROCHEMICAL ENTERPRISES AND ADMINISTRATION DEPARTMENTS NATIONWIDE ARE URGED TO REGISTER AT THE CENTER, WHICH IS EXPECTED TO BECOME AN AUTHORITATIVE INFORMATION AND TRADING HUB FOR PETROCHEMICAL INDUSTRY IN THE COUNTRY.

title: WIPO LAUNCHES VIRTUAL BOOKSHOP ON INTERNET
body: THE WORLD INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ORGANIZATION (WIPO) TUESDAY LAUNCHED A VIRTUAL BOOKSHOP TO SELL ITS PUBLICATIONS ON THE INTERNET. THE CLIENTS WILL GO TO ITS WEB SITE FROM WHICH IT IS POSSIBLE TO SELECT AND ORDER PAPER VERSIONS OF BOOKS AND PERIODICALS AND CD- ROMS, SAID WIPO IN A PRESS RELEASE. SOME 100 PUBLICATIONS IN A VARIETY OF LANGUAGES MAY BE ORDERED NOW FROM THE ELECTRONIC BOOKSHOP, WITH THE CONTENTS RANGING FROM INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY, COPYRIGHT, NEIGHBORING RIGHTS, PATENTS, MARKS AND TRADE-RELATED INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY TO LICENSING/FRANCHISING, INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS AND ARBITRATION/MEDIATION. THERE ARE ALSO A NUMBER OF DOWNLOADABLE FREE-OF-CHARGE GENERAL INFORMATION PRODUCTS. WIPO'S ELECTRONIC BOOKSHOP, EQUIPPED WITH A VIRTUAL SHOPPING CART FEATURE, ALLOWS THE SHOPPERS TO SUBMIT ORDERS AND TO PAY ON- LINE WITH MAJOR CREDIT CARDS. IT FUNCTIONS VIA A SECURE SERVER, USING THE SECURE SOCKET LAYER PROTOCOL (SSL) WHICH MEANS THAT THE INFORMATION IS ENCRYPTED AS IT IS TRANSMITTED OVER THE INTERNET.

title: hk formulates initiatives to ensure internet safety
body: the hongkong government has laid down several initiatives to ensure safety in using internet, said director of the information technology services lau kam-hung tuesday.  the initiatives include the development of a public key infrastructure and the establishment of a certification authority recognition office by the end of the year, lau said at a seminar on internet-related data protection.  "with the public key infrastructure, not only the government services could be delivered securely over the public networks, a foundation will also be built for the delivery of electronic services of other organizations," the director said. the establishment of the certification authority recognition office is aimed to protect interests of electronic commerce customers and enhance the users' confidence in electronic transactions.  "the number of reported cases to the police on hacking for the first seven months of 1999 is 102 whereas in 1998 there were only 13 reported cases," lau said.

title: internet advertising spending up 80 percent
body: the advertising spending on 300 web sites rose 80 percent to 359.4 million unitedstates dollars in the first quarter of 1999, with computer and software makers, on-line and internet services companies leading the charge, according to a report released on friday.  microsoft corp. and ibm corp. were the leading advertisers, said intermedia advertising solutions.  credit card giant first usa, in the no. 3 spot, boosted its internet advertisement spending by 614 percent to 4.3 million dollars, followed by general motors corp., up 159 percent at 4.1 million dollars, and att corp., up 140.3 percent at four million dollars.  dell computer corp., in the 10th spot, registered the largest percentage increase in the three months, with spending up 2,787 percent from the 1998 period, at 2.6 million dollars.  "the numbers clearly indicate that the internet has become a viable advertising medium," joe philport, president of ias, said in a statement accompanying the findings.

title: india's nse to offer net trading from december
body: india's national stock exchange (nse) will offer internet-based stock trading facility in the country from december, according to a nse official.  ravi narain, nse's deputy managing director, said in calcutta tuesday, "whether the e-commerce legislation is put in place or not, we are going to start internet-based trading within three months from now." if things go as planned, retail investors can place their purchase and sell deals on the net in three months. the order will be automatically executed by the broker through a recognized stock exchange.  the system has benefits for both investors and brokers. the inter-mediaries will be able to accept small orders from a large number of retail or even institutional investors.

title: chinese farm produce information now available on internet
body: a government-funded farm produce information website has recently been set up in china's fujian province to provide farmers with up-to-date domestic and international information. during three months of trial operations, the website has provided more than 20,000 items of agricultural information, resulting in sales of more than 300 million yuan.  because many farmers do not have access to computers, local cooperatives are channeling the network information through their offices and sending it for news broadcasts on radio and tv and in newspapers.

title: china telecom to get more customers onto cyberspace beijing, june
body: china telecom plans to get more enterprises and families to enter cyberspace this year and to provide government offices access to the internet.  the company has over 2 million customers on line, nearly 100 of them, corporate bodies. it established an e-commerce certificate system last august and has provided platform for on-line securities trading, on-line shopping, and on-line medicare since november.  china telecom hopes to expand its cooperation with various enterprises and plans to provide services like website design, information updating, and technology training for its customers.

title: u.s. internet marketing firm gains access to china
body: a unitedstates company announced friday that it has received a license from the chinese government to market goods and services directly to the chinese populace through its web site.  chinamallusa.com inc., an e-commerce company established in 1997 for the purpose of marketing chinese and unitedstates products through the internet, said that it is the only foreign firm to receive such a comprehensive license allowing it to sell retail throughout the entire country.  to date, according to the company, only wal-mart, the unitedstates department store giant, has been granted a license to establish a retail store in china but that license is limited to operating in shenzhen, one of china's special economic zones.  china's retail market is huge, the company said, although there are only four million households currently on the internet.  the e-commerce company has so far established partnerships with two major beijing-based retail businesses, as well as ties with other three chinese companies.

title: major news items in leading british newspapers
body: the following are major news items in leading british newspapers tuesday.  the guardian: --the government's long-awaited draft freedom of information bill was published monday amid protests from campaigning groups and mps that it was toothless, flawed, and a retreat from labour's manifesto commitment to end secrecy.  the times: --nato is to ask non-alliance countries to help meet the target of 48,000 troops needed to secure the yugoslav province for the return of the ethnic albanians.  the daily telegraph: --the ongoing israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu is being showered with job offers as he mulls over how he is going to spend the rest of his life after retiring from front-line politics.  financial times: --the boom in online investing by ordinary ameircans is set to force the new york stock exchange to stretch its trading hours to as late as 10pm from this summer.

title: china opens high-tech industry information website
body: china has opened a high-tech industry information website, said an official from the ministry of science and technology here today. the network, in both chinese and english, offers information on the investment environment and business projects at china's 53 science parks, and nearly 100 high-tech industrial units. the network includes torch plan database worked out by the ministry to promote high-tech and new technology industries. those who log onto the site can discuss issues related to the growth of china's high-tech industry with experts, according to the official. so far, 16,000 high-tech ventures have been registered in the country's 53 science parks. their income from industrial production and trade exceeded 480 billion yuan (57.8 billion unitedstates dollars.) in 1998, and high-tech industry has created more than 2. 87 million jobs for china. the address of the website is: http://www.chinatorch.gov.cn.

title: shaanxi has over 50,000 internet users
body: the number of internet users has reached 50,400 in northwest china's shaanxi province, representing a five fold increase from the end of 1997's figure.  the increase is higher than the national average. the number of shaanxi's internet users accounts for 2.4 percent of the country's total, compared with 1.2 percent at the end of 1997. the province has input more than 200 information websites and data bases into the internet, according to a local source.  shaanxi has become a regional information center in the western part of china, authorities say. at present, more than 200 enterprises, institutions, social groups and government organs are making use of the internet.

title: us broker plans assault on new zealand sharemarket
body: unitedstates giant discount internet share broker etrade has signaled it will soon launch an assault on the new zealand stockbroking community.  according to the latest issue of the new zealand infotech weekly, etrade is formulating plans to start trading new zealand shares as a result of the decision of the new zealand stock exchange (nzse) to dump its dated share trading system, seats, in favor of a modern alternative, asts, which features an "open interface." asts is supplied by australia's computershare.  late last year, etrade's australian subsidiary launched a service allowing new zealand investors to trade australian shares over the internet.  etrade australia general manager marketing, bill wileman, was quoted as saying nzse's decision to replace seats with asts clears the way for etrade to extend the service to new zealand shares.

title: china puts trade information on internet beijing, march
body: china has recently opened a trade information website on the internet, the first of its kind, offering a 24 hour information service about chinese trade and business for the russian and east european markets. the website is jointly set up by a shenzhen and a harbin electronic technological corporation and the address is www. russiamarket.com. all the information on the website is offered in russian, which is hugely convenient for businessmen and enterprises in russia and east european countries, said chang chun, chairman of the shenzhen corporation. colored pictures of products are also available, he added. usually interested foreign countries can only get information about chinese trade and business at commercial fairs.

title: china puts trade information on internet beijing, march
body: china has recently opened a trade information website on the internet, the first of its kind, offering a 24 hour information service about chinese trade and business for the russian and east european markets. the website is jointly set up by a shenzhen and a harbin electronic technological corporation and the address is www. russiamarket.com. all the information on the website is offered in russian, which is hugely convenient for businessmen and enterprises in russia and east european countries, said chang chun, chairman of the shenzhen corporation. colored pictures of products are also available, he added. usually interested foreign countries can only get information about chinese trade and business at commercial fairs.

title: internet advertising to become new favorite in china
body: the internet advertising sector will be much favored in china amidst a booming computer market and the internet surfing craze, according to china commercial news.  with no time and space limitations, internet advertising has better opportunities for development compared with other advertising methods. internet surfers only need to click the mouse to get information, and through email, customers and the staff of enterprises can keep in direct contact with each other.  "but internet advertising is only at a nascent development stage in china, and it has not produced its due economic returns," an internet advertisement designer has said.  according to him, several factors stand in the way of development. the most obvious ones are the low-level of design ability and inappropriate distribution.  major players in the sector are now stepping up their efforts to upgrade technology in this regard and substantial achievements have already been made.  china's internet surfers are expected to hit 4.5 million by 2000, and experts believe internet advertising will become a favorite sector in the near future.

title: korean air launches on-line reservation service
body: korean air on wednesday launched an on-line reservation service, from which customers can book, pay for tickets and request delivery via its internet home page (http:/ /www.koreanair.co.kr), the company said. the airline has opened its on-line service for its direct routes to japan and china and will expand to southeast asian and european routes in the second half of the year. full service to all routes is scheduled in the first half of next year. those who buy tickets from the internet may receive a fivepercent discount off the list price before may 31 this year. customers can have tickets delivered to them within five days or pick up them at the airport at no extra charge.

title: china develops first e-business security authentication system
body: china's first electronic business security authentication system passed a technical appraisement here today.  the system, which was developed by the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation, has made it possible to provide secured digital signature and on-line application services to businesses.  "it has the functions of on-line application, delivery, cancellation and searching, and can be used in e-business," said the head of the assessment panel yang fuqing, a professor at the chinese academy of engineering.  it is the first system of its kind developed in china, she added, and china owns the copyright.  before the technical assessment, the system had already passed security tests and quality examinations, and had been used successfully since last october in the computer network linking moftec and china's foreign commercial organizations.  moftec deputy minister chen xinhua attended the assessment and declared that the system will play an important role in electronic bidding, and the administration of licenses and processing trade inquiries.

title: yahoo finds ad agency in china
body: the internet content provider yahoo has authorized the beijing-based infoshare technology co.  ltd. to be its exclusive advertising agency in china.  according to an agreement inked today between yahoo and infoshare, the latter will promote yahoo services in china and help chinese customers create on-line advertisements on yahoo's worldwide network.  infoshare is an internet service company funded by the china international electronic commerce center. the company designed and built the "made-in-china" web market and china's ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation web site.  a chinese textile exporter and a local town government have signed agreements with infoshare to display their ads and economic and investment information on yahoo's global network, according to reports.

title: intel plans to build encryption chip
body: intel corp. said monday that it plans to develop computer chips that can help scramble data to keep it secret, a report from the company said.  "these high performance chips are going to get internet commerce more safe," said michael glance, general manager of intel's platform security division. and it helps the overall computer industry, he said.  data scrambling technology, known as encryption, has mostly been the product of software companies, which add it to programs used to surf the internet such as browsers.  intel discussed the plans on monday at a security conference in san jose sponsored by rsa data security inc., of san mateo, california, the report said.  the unitedstates department of commerce, however, has imposed limits on export of the most powerful encryption technology, fearing it could fall into the hands of criminals and terrorists, who would be able to send messages to each other that law enforcement authorities won't be able to read.  the high-tech industry has long protested the restrictions, saying they were hurting business and accomplished little because foreign competitors were also selling the technology.

title: government departments join computer network
body: chinese government departments at all levels plan to establish public information web sites which list pertinent information and services, according to a recent issue of guangzhou daily.  some 100 government departments have already established web sites, and additional departments are expected to follow suit during 1999, according to a survey of 72 ministries and departments under the state council.  government departments have assumed control of over 80 percent of important information sources and more than 3,000 data banks, but have not as yet been able to take full advantage of the system due to inefficient communication channels.  the web sites will provide a new window enabling government offices to better serve the public and lead to the full realization of "government computerization".

title: china's first on-line hotel reservation network
body: visit our website and you can instantly book a room in any of the hotels listed," the china business alliance hotel reservation network said today, as china opened its first hotel reservation system on the internet.  cbanet, sponsored by the state information center and beijing's sitech group, enables people to book a reservation in over 300 hotels in more than 50 cities via computer.  detailed information about the hotels is available on the internet, with pictures of the rooms.  cbanet offers a wide range of choices, room rates, and locations, and people who use the electronic room reservation system can enjoy a 30 to 60 percent discount.  cbanet started trial operations in june and has already helped more than 15,000 people arrange their trips. the network will expand its coverage to 500 hotels in 100 cities by the end of this year.

title: internet firewall market among fastest-growing sectors
body: internet firewalls were one of the fatest-growing businesses last year, with revenues jumping 143 percent worldwide between 1996 and 1997, a unitedstates market analysis firm has announced wednesday.  the international data corp. (idc) predicted that the firewall market worldwide will reach 1.8 billion unitedstates dollars by 2002.  internet firewall is a security mechanism that allows limited access to a web site as well as approves traffic in and out in accordance with a thought-out plan.  idc said that the rapid growth of this market was driven by companies upgrading their firewall systems and by a demand for multiple internet firewalls to provide companies with high availability and throughput.  the unitedstates will remain the strongest market, said idc, adding that the european and asia-pacific markets will grow much faster.

title: asian business information website propels phenomenal growth
body: a leading on-line provider of free financial information on asia's listed companies reported on wednesday a hefty 1,200 percent increase of usage of its internet service in 15 months.  provided by investor relations asia, a hongkong-based on-line financial service company, the website was accessed roughly 77,500 times in january 1997 and by march 1998 the figure jumped to over 930,000. daily hits now average well above 30,000, the company announced wednesday.  the website, irasia.com, was launched in late 1996. it posts company profiles, annual reports, interim reports, press releases on close to 400 hongkong listed companies. it also provides data of almost 2,000 companies listed in the asia pacific region.

title: internet ad' revenue rises in canada
body: revenues from canadian firms selling advertizing space on the internet reached almost 10 million canadian dollars (seven million unitedstates dollars) last year.  a year earlier, online ad revenue in canada was only 1.6 million dollars, according to figures from the internet advertising bureau of canada, an organization of marketing professionals formed at the end of last year.  the bureau predicted revenue could more than double to 22.9 million dollars this year and 56.9 million in 1999.  it found that financial services led the way, generating 2.1 million dollars in ad's revenue. that is in line with growth in areas such as pc banking and electronic commerce.  ted boyd, vice chairman of the bureau, said the research results will help identify emerging trends and growth areas in the industry that were not measurable before.

title: global ad industry grows
body: global advertising industry is expected to grow six percent to 434 billion unitedstates dollars this year, unitedstates industry data show.  the industry has averaged the six percent growth rate for the last three years, according to unitedstates newspaper investor's business daily on saturday.  big ad agencies' revenue composition is changing with traditional business in radio, tv and printing media shifting to public relations, events, sports marketing and products promotion.  major multinational ad agencies have embarked on consolidation to expand business with current biggest players stationed in new york and london while new subgroup leaders are emerging.  despite its tiny portion of the industry, internet advertising sees a new, fast-growing perspective from a business of 600 million unitedstates dollars in 1997 to about 5 billion dollars by 2000, web-search firm yahoo predicted.

title: internet advertising triples last year
body: internet and online advertising spending in 1997 was triple the 1996 level, the internet advertising bureau (iab) said tuesday.  fourth quarter online advertising was valued at 335.3 million dollars, a sharp increase over 227.1 million dollars in the third quarter, the iab said. overall spending rose to 906.5 million dollars in 1997 from 226.9 million dollars the previous year.  "we really see that 1997 is a breakthrough year in internet advertising as the medium joined the ranks of traditional media," iab chairman rich lefurgy told reporters on a teleconference.  "we expect 1998 will be another breakthrough year," lefurgy said.  consumer-related products were the most heavily advertised category last year at 31 percent of the total online spending, the iab said. it was followed closely by computer products, 30 percent, with financial services, telecommunications and news media trailing behind.

title: u.s. computer companies to restrict release of personal data
body: unitedstates 14 largest computer data companies have reached an agreement over blocking public access to certain types of personal data.  signing the agreement are lexis-nexis and the nation's three main credit reporting bureaus, which represent 90 percent of the database market.  according to the agreement, the 14 companies will not release to the general public certain types of non-public information, including social security numbers, birth dates, credit history and a mother's maiden name. the companies also agree not to release unlisted telephone numbers obtained from non-public records and unlisted addresses from telephone companies.  however the restrictions would not apply to sensitive information that is derived from public records, such as birth certificates or state motor vehicle information. qualified subscribers, such as law enforcement agencies and private investigators, would still have access to all data.  "this is an important first step toward ensuring the privacy of users, while keeping government intrusion at a minimum,"said rep. billy tauzin, chairman of the house telecommunications,trade and consumer protection subcommittee.

title: eco-internet lead mild seven outdoor quest
body: team eco-internet maintained their lead in the mild seven outdoor quest competition after two of the four stages.  eco-internet finished first in the 20-kilometer trail run, and opened a 30-minute gap during the 40km kayak event down the tempestuous tranquil river. team scar ranked second ahead of the red bull.  the mild seven outdoor quest is a four-day adventure race being held in sichuan province, southwest china. four-person teams are contesting a variety of outdoor endurance sports from trail running to offroad inline skating.  the winner after 250 brutal kilometers of racing will receive the lion's share of 100,000 unitedstates dollars.

title: bombay stock exchange to have nationwide network
body: the bombay stock exchange (bse), the biggest and oldest bourse in india, will soon be going in for a nationwide network, bse sources said here today.  the country's department of telecommunication has finally cleared the proposal of the bombay bourse for setting up terminals outside mumbai (bombay).  "we will be expanding our trading terminals to 99 specified centers soon in the whole country," said bse president m.g.  damani.  the securities and exchange board of india (sebi) had cleared the bombay online trading system (bolt) last month allowing the bse to expand at centers other than the stock exchange ones.  the services to the clients of these centers would be provided by bse brokers by either directly opening a branch there or through sub-brokers, duly authorized and registered with sebi. all the contracts would be executed at mumbai and investors' grievances would be resolved by the bourse.  the bse would ensure that there is adequate monitoring and surveillance mechanism for these outstation terminals in order to oversee the trades, the sebi sources said.

title: trade fair available on internet
body: details of the ongoing '97 trade fair in this port city in east china's shandong province are reportedly available through the internet.  computer users at home and abroad can get the latest information related to the trade fair on the world wide web before september 1.  introductions to preferential policies provided by the province to investors abroad are also available on the web, 120 of the province's sino-foreign cooperative programs, as well as details of local foreign trade companies and big enterprises.  shandong provides electronic information concerning this year's trade fair to attract more overseas investors, according to a provincial official, adding that this is the first time for the province to open an online trade fair.  the '97 trade fair also offers its visitors free internet roaming services, said the official.

title: ethiopia starts to register internet clients
body: internet today began to register its clients in ethiopia, according to the country's newly established internet bureau.  head of the bureau fanta adane told local journalists that the internet electronic appliance in the country has the capacity to serve at least 5,000 clients.  he added that internet would enable clients to get access to necessary information across the world at low prices.  internet will enable individuals, enterprises and government institutions to exchange written documents, computer files, news stories and opinions within the network of the international computers federation and make advertisements which could get through within seconds, he said.  it costs only 23 seconds to get a piece of information from canada through internet while the time to receive information from european and asian countries is even shorter.

title: bse to resume debt trade in september
body: the bombay stock exchange (bse) is all set to resume debt market operations in a big way with 700 securities listed on the bourse in september, it is learnt here today.  the bse authorities have already firmed up plans for a separate debt segment "f" in addition to the existing a, b1 and b2 groups.  "f" stands for fixed rate instrument.  bonds, including bonds of the public sector undertakings (psu) and non-convertible debentures, will be listed initially in this segment of the market. "the exchange is doing this to revive trading in debt instruments and create a retail bond market," the bse sources said.  the bse also plans trade in government securities. the transparency and infrastructural strength of the bombay on-line trading system is likely to draw both retail and institutional investors to the debt market.  debt trading on bse was discontinued in early 1994 when the reserve bank of india issued a notification asking all participants to trade on a screen-based exchange. this was at a time when the bombay bourse was far from going on-line.

title: hke071820--reuters starts on-line information service in thailand
body: reuters, a london-based international news agency, has launched its first on-line thai-language financial information service in thailand, the local press said today.  the reuters' move was promoted by increasing interests in thailand's capital market and arising opportunities.  the newly launched reuters' information service provides brokers, investors and analysts with price index and economic news, including real-time business information, foreign exchange and interest rates announced by thailand's central bank.  it also offers business information on metal and energy prices and information from other important financial markets.

title: u.s. cracks down on on-line investor scams
body: securities regulators in the unitedstates are cracking down on alleged investor scams on popular on-line computer services.  officials in missouri, new jersey, oklahoma and texas announced actions and investigations against suspected swindles that have been promoted through electronic open forums known as "investor bulletin boards". meanwhile, the north american securities administrators association, the organization for state securities regulators, is tackling the growing problem of dubious investment schemes being pushed over electronic networks, the wall street journal reported.  some four million americans subscribe to three commercial on-line computer services --compuserve, prodigy, and america online. investor bulletin boards, where subscribers swap tips on subjects ranging from common stocks to rare coins, are among the most popular parts of the services.  securities officials said they are working with the three services to set up their own bulletin boards to warn users of problems and to answer questions about investments.
